001c8856-52f3-584e-ae67-7431d385a9b0.name: Greece wins Ottoman Empire and Bulgaria
001c8856-52f3-584e-ae67-7431d385a9b0.description: Under the leadership of King Constantine I and Prime Minister Eleftherios Venizelos, Greece defeats the Ottoman Empire and Bulgaria during the Balkan Wars.

00334ae2-a3e1-5c6e-a00b-92e87d25bd9b.name: Establishment of the Egyptian Geographic Society
00334ae2-a3e1-5c6e-a00b-92e87d25bd9b.description: The Egyptian Geographic Society is established by a decree of Khedive Isma‘il Pasha on 19 May 1875. Its first president is the German botanist, traveller and ethnologist Georg August Schweinfurth.

0058736d-24b6-593c-9fd7-8f4b1caed594.name: Columbian Exposition in Chicago
0058736d-24b6-593c-9fd7-8f4b1caed594.description: At the World’s Columbian Exposition in Chicago, the main Ottoman pavilion refers to the Sultan Ahmed Fountain, but it experiments with a different approach, being designed as an exhibition building.

009b8cc1-047c-576e-94f1-54b802648adb.name: Cavour prime minister of the Kingdom of Sardinia
009b8cc1-047c-576e-94f1-54b802648adb.description: Cavour (Camillo Benso, Count of Cavour, 1810–61), the architect of the diplomatic strategies that allowed Italian unification, becomes prime minister of the Kingdom of Sardinia (he will remain prime minister until his death).

00b2b358-d30d-5ce6-a0c9-1a8a80c98be6.name: Wiener Kongress
00b2b358-d30d-5ce6-a0c9-1a8a80c98be6.description: The Wiener Kongress (Congress of Vienna) saw the restoration of the political state (the 1792 Ancien Régime), realignment of the borders, and creation of a loosely arranged German Bund (Federation).

00f1a5f9-5e8a-5e3e-86b4-3cb03d129aa4.name: Muhammad Ali Pasha built Shubra Palace
00f1a5f9-5e8a-5e3e-86b4-3cb03d129aa4.description: Muhammad ‘Ali Pasha builds Shubra Palace on the site of a former kiosk where *wali*s went for recreation during the Ottoman era.

00f3a428-b3d8-5804-83c5-fe5c01c9d0d1.name: The first stage of the Nürburgring
00f3a428-b3d8-5804-83c5-fe5c01c9d0d1.description: The first stage of the racing circuit Nürburgring is constructed comprising the old “North loop” built around the village of Nürburg in the Eifel mountains.

013fdfc9-26b0-54fc-a7f3-5736cfa4be90.name: A new style of living in luxurious mansions
013fdfc9-26b0-54fc-a7f3-5736cfa4be90.description: A new lifestyle develops in the luxurious mansions inside the medina and also in the large properties of the surrounding area. Mirrors and consoles, chandeliers from Venice etc., are set alongside Spanish-North African furniture. All manner of interior items, as well as women’s clothing and jewellery, experience the same mutations.

0150d888-aaf3-5a0d-8e08-1bc069c2d2cb.name: The Italian army captures Rome
0150d888-aaf3-5a0d-8e08-1bc069c2d2cb.description: In 1870, taking advantage of French defeat at the hands of Prussia, the Italian army captures Rome, which becomes the capital of Italy. The Pope considers Italian rule on Rome to be illegitimate and bans Catholics from participating in Italian political life. In the following decades the ban is progressively lifted to counter socialist growth.

0196f315-e021-52d1-959c-0d44102d4182.name: Child labour under 12 years is forbidden in Austria
0196f315-e021-52d1-959c-0d44102d4182.description: Child labour under 12 years of age is outlawed in Austria.

01d8906a-4202-5036-886d-4f1a9cef4415.name: Napoléon III to Algeria
01d8906a-4202-5036-886d-4f1a9cef4415.description: First trip by Napoleon III to Algeria; the second will take place in 1865.

01df5363-ca0a-5b13-89f1-ae838c95c59e.name: Palace Schwetzingen
01df5363-ca0a-5b13-89f1-ae838c95c59e.description: "Palace Schwetzingen" is bulit and flourised under the Palatine Prince Elector Carl Theodor. The baroque castle complex includes more than 100 sculptures and a "Türkischer Garten" ("Turkish Garden") with a mosque, biult from 1779 to 1791, that makes it the earliest mosque- style in Germany and the largest structure of its kind in a german garden. It was designed by Nicolas de Pigage. However the oriental details are not for religious but for decorative purposes.

027ad714-6b90-5202-a74c-5dd8c3b532ba.name: Spanish community
027ad714-6b90-5202-a74c-5dd8c3b532ba.description: The Spanish community is France’s most important.

027e2fd3-5654-5062-9e8f-1016c66743f4.name: Street lighting
027e2fd3-5654-5062-9e8f-1016c66743f4.description: The city of Tunis benefits from the first installation of public street lighting. An English company builds a gasometer and installs the pipelines necessary to supply gas for street lighting of the city’s main arteries.

027e4a67-0c74-5728-b82f-84a50b9f65be.name: New bridge on the Nile
027e4a67-0c74-5728-b82f-84a50b9f65be.description: Khedive Isma‘il commissions a French company to construct the first bridge across the River Nile in Cairo, the Qasr al-Nil Bridge.

0294d636-37e3-51d1-8033-c64776a4a3a0.name: In Bucharest is built a fire tower by the plans of the chief-architect of the city, George Mandrea
0294d636-37e3-51d1-8033-c64776a4a3a0.description: In Bucharest a fire tower is built from the plans of the chief architect of the city, George Mandrea. It is both a watchtower, used by firemen to keep the city under observation to rapidly intervene in case of a fire, and a reservoir for water distribution in the eastern part of Bucharest.

030b4901-23bd-5749-84c7-52f9a0b909d0.name: Life expectancy
030b4901-23bd-5749-84c7-52f9a0b909d0.description: Average life expectancy, which in 1861 was 30 years, is now 47 years.

0331b04e-fc03-56d3-a05d-c0be867e7332.name: The Pardon of Bonchamps
0331b04e-fc03-56d3-a05d-c0be867e7332.description: *The Pardon of Bonchamps* by David d'Angers.

0373a36d-867a-52c2-9f94-bf0465174e45.name: Suez Canal and the route to India
0373a36d-867a-52c2-9f94-bf0465174e45.description: Under French direction the Suez Canal opens in 1869, improving the route to India. Britain then acquires a financial interest in the Canal in 1875. When in 1878 Cyprus becomes part of the British Empire, another fuelling station on the imperial route to India is achieved.

038768aa-1ca0-5043-a58a-67783336007e.name: Faruq left Egypt to Italy
038768aa-1ca0-5043-a58a-67783336007e.description: Having been forced to abdicate, On 26 July, Faruq leaves Egypt for Italy. He passes away in Rome in 1965 and his body is brought back to Egypt to be buried in al-Rifa‘i Mosque.

038c9a16-c67b-56c8-ae53-f9f366c12ac7.name: After the United States, the German Empire was the most popular country of immigration
038c9a16-c67b-56c8-ae53-f9f366c12ac7.description: After the United States, the German Empire was the most popular country of immigration.

03b3d925-8697-539f-88e3-e3490f56c9f4.name: Istanbul and Izmir occupied
03b3d925-8697-539f-88e3-e3490f56c9f4.description: Allied forces occupy İstanbul (16 March); Greece occupies İzmir (15 May).

03bb7b8e-75a7-58e7-8809-dba8da97c378.name: Foundation of the Madrid stock exchange
03bb7b8e-75a7-58e7-8809-dba8da97c378.description: Foundation of the Madrid stock exchange (Bolsa de Madrid), driven by the state's need to raise funds to cover, among other things, debts arising from the Carlist wars.

03d7e3e8-ba52-56ec-b55b-3d22ee255dc1.name: Astronomy teaching started in 1898 as an individual science
03d7e3e8-ba52-56ec-b55b-3d22ee255dc1.description: The teaching of astronomy as an individual science starts, taking advantage of the astronomy teaching experience acquired since 1837 at the Lisbon Polytechnic School. This school was meant to provide training for cartography surveys and military preparation.

0422605d-a6b0-510e-baaf-9546826eab8c.name: First proper British survey
0422605d-a6b0-510e-baaf-9546826eab8c.description: The first proper British survey of the southern and western waters of the Gulf begins at Ras Musandam.

04284ff2-8364-5f90-b177-6fc1806892ce.name: Inauguration of the Capuchin cathedral dedicated to Saint Louis IX King of France
04284ff2-8364-5f90-b177-6fc1806892ce.description: Inauguration of the Capuchin cathedral dedicated to Saint Louis IX King of France. The Capuchins had arrived in Beirut in 1628, practising their rites in the old Saint George church where the current Maronite cathedral now stands. Before moving to their present location the Capuchins built their first church, also dedicated to Saint Louis, in Beirut in 1732.

04318737-dac5-599e-bb20-1f09014a499d.name: The development of transport networks
04318737-dac5-599e-bb20-1f09014a499d.description: The development of transport networks: the creation of railway lines from 1832, expansion of the road network and construction of a large number of canals.

043269ed-ae73-503a-a3fa-c760f4a75e50.name: Franz Liszt was born in Austria and died in Bayreuth
043269ed-ae73-503a-a3fa-c760f4a75e50.description: Franz Liszt is born in Austria. He becomes one the leading composers and a piano virtuoso of the 19th century. He dies in Bayreuth.

044918b6-80dc-54fc-ab84-5cc456c739e9.name: Founding of the first company of blue jeans
044918b6-80dc-54fc-ab84-5cc456c739e9.description: Levi Strauss & Co founds the first company to manufacture blue jeans.

044b9669-40b4-5889-884b-19cca484644b.name: Death of Romanian composer Ciprian Porumbescu
044b9669-40b4-5889-884b-19cca484644b.description: 6 June: the death of Romanian composer Ciprian Porumbescu, at the age of only 29. One of the melodies he composed will be adopted for Albania’s national anthem in 1912.

04542783-0f79-581a-afc4-9ffd350ba514.name: British Occupation of Egypt
04542783-0f79-581a-afc4-9ffd350ba514.description: Britain also acquires indirect control over Egypt, with an occupying army and control over Egyptian finances and administration. Egyptian tourism flourishes and with it a superficial economic development – an affluent class, construction of railways and building projects. However, European cultural influences in Egypt are mostly French.

04fcdad1-3bbc-5153-8b97-ff4a90552812.name: Sheikh Saqr II bin Khalid bin Sultan al-Qasimi
04fcdad1-3bbc-5153-8b97-ff4a90552812.description: Sheikh Saqr II bin Khalid bin Sultan al-Qasimi, ruler of Sharjah, is also acknowledged as one of the greatest poets of his time. He is the grandfather of the current Sheikh of Sharjah (Sheikh Sultan bin Mohammad al-Qasimi).

05319fc0-cbc9-590b-ac39-9b115e242bd7.name: La damnation de Faust, by Berlioz
05319fc0-cbc9-590b-ac39-9b115e242bd7.description: Premiere of the opera *La damnation de Faust* by Hector Berlioz.

0532d1e2-aacc-5694-a7c8-33da6b9cb69d.name: The Relic
0532d1e2-aacc-5694-a7c8-33da6b9cb69d.description: Publication of *A Relíquia* (*The Relic*) by Eça de Queirós. The novel criticises the hypocrisy of the Portuguese society.

05cfd2d3-b5f8-5545-b2ae-fea520bc2720.name: Judicial reform
05cfd2d3-b5f8-5545-b2ae-fea520bc2720.description: 4 May: Judicial reform extends the administrative authority of Ministry of Justice over mixed courts.

065a4830-c42f-5ceb-b56b-68f9d7c1a8e4.name: The inauguration of the Eiffel Tower
065a4830-c42f-5ceb-b56b-68f9d7c1a8e4.description: The inauguration of the Eiffel Tower and the use of iron in architectural structures.

06639351-dc6a-553d-b0c0-514e52a2bb17.name: Deutsche Bank
06639351-dc6a-553d-b0c0-514e52a2bb17.description: The Deutsche Bank is founded by Georg von Siemens.

06717caa-42a6-5307-b330-e8cdef5fff88.name: Publication of Owen Jones's *Plan, Elevations, Sections and Details of the Alhambra*
06717caa-42a6-5307-b330-e8cdef5fff88.description: Publication of Owen Jones's *Plan, Elevations, Sections and Details of the Alhambra* (with an essay by Pascual de Gayangos on the history of the Nasrid Dynasty) in 12 volumes, using the new technique of chromolithography.

06f951b8-555c-5962-a422-c12f123be7a4.name: Greeks settled in Egypt
06f951b8-555c-5962-a422-c12f123be7a4.description: Many Greeks settle in Egypt during the second half of the 19th century. Khedive Muhammad ‘Ali supports Greek participation in the development of Egypt, especially in her contribution to the cotton industry.

0711ca7c-865a-5e43-8ffe-55ad0482435e.name: Qawasim lands are divided among his four sons
0711ca7c-865a-5e43-8ffe-55ad0482435e.description: Qawasim lands are divided among the four sons of Sheikh Sultan bin Saqr following his death. The number of Trucial States rises from five to nine.

074935a0-a167-56cf-be08-4020ba28b300.name: Triumph of *Nabuccodonosor* by Giuseppe Verdi
074935a0-a167-56cf-be08-4020ba28b300.description: Triumph of *Nabuccodonosor* by Giuseppe Verdi (1831–1901) at La Scala Theatre (Milan): it marks the appearance of a new operatic style, in which both voice and music show an entirely new heroic passion and strength.

07c7938d-56c2-5a44-a27c-4b3fe82787de.name: Ottoman railway policy
07c7938d-56c2-5a44-a27c-4b3fe82787de.description: Ottoman railway policy is formulated by the decree of Sultan Abdülaziz to establish a main line between İstanbul and Baghdad, with secondary lines to the Black Sea and Mediterranean coasts.

08062089-35bd-52de-9fff-a0a87f2b12bc.name: A school is built by the Jesuits in Ghazir (Kisruwan district)
08062089-35bd-52de-9fff-a0a87f2b12bc.description: A school is built by the Jesuits in Ghazir (Kisruwan district).

087950f1-7aba-598e-9cbb-48c720664666.name: Reign of Mulay al-Hasan I
087950f1-7aba-598e-9cbb-48c720664666.description: Reign of Mulay al-Hasan I: Mulay al-Hasan I maintains the political independence of the country. He attempted to adapt the country to its new circumstances and employed a policy of reforms, affecting all areas of political and economic life, to improve the management of public affairs.

088df141-881f-5650-8509-1dde7af54b03.name: Promulgation of the Fundamental Pact
088df141-881f-5650-8509-1dde7af54b03.description: Promulgation of the Fundamental Pact by Muhammad Pasha Bey: a “Declaration of Rights” in 11 points. The pact guarantees Tunisians and also foreigners their civil and political rights, security of persons and properties, equality before the law, etc.

08b43b51-da50-54c7-bcd1-2063e1dfc6c2.name: Good Taste
08b43b51-da50-54c7-bcd1-2063e1dfc6c2.description: *Bom-senso e Bom-gosto* (*Good Sense and Good Taste*) by Antero de Quental (1842–91) is an open letter published as pamphlet, replying to and ridiculing the poetry of António Feliciano de Castilho (1800–75) and urging young writers to take a revolutionary position instead. This controversy became known as the "Questão Coimbrã” (the Coimbra Question).

08c5f629-81da-5c98-a249-ee3df8c2508e.name: Cabralismo - an authoritarian regime ruled by conservative Bernardo Costa Cabral who rehabilitated the 1826 Constitutional Chart.
08c5f629-81da-5c98-a249-ee3df8c2508e.description: The period of Cabralismo, an authoritarian regime ruled by conservative Bernardo Costa Cabral who rehabilitates the 1826 Constitutional Charter but promoting the public infrastructures and fiscal code revision. Upper middle class and aristocracy regain state control and former privileges. Popular rebellions lead to the fall of his government.

08d1a7ca-84ec-50c6-911a-d5dd49035017.name: In the Egyptian Pavillon of the World Trade Fair exhibitio
08d1a7ca-84ec-50c6-911a-d5dd49035017.description: A copy of the decoration from the Tomb of Khnumhotep is exhibited in the Egyptian Pavilion of the World Trade Fair.

09123c44-173a-5b0d-b48d-e2d1bddd209a.name: Salama Hijazi
09123c44-173a-5b0d-b48d-e2d1bddd209a.description: The singer Salama Hijazi turns to acting with the Kirdahi and al-Haddad troupes. Through his contributions, many musical theatre troupes emerge such as Aziz Eed, Naguib al-Rihani and ‘Ali al-Kassar. As one of the first artists to travel abroad, Hijazi achieves worldwide acclaim for his musical and theatrical works. Warmly welcomed in Italy, Syria and Tunisia, he is granted awards of appreciation by many international governments. Hijazi’s statue stands at the Museum of Napoli.

093cccae-c341-509f-bea1-126df09af072.name: Clot Bey
093cccae-c341-509f-bea1-126df09af072.description: The French physician Antoine Barthelemy Clot, Clot Bey as he was known in Egypt, becomes the first director of the Medical School and Hospital in Egypt.

099e3dbc-0f28-51a2-b758-7ebc7a5f1ed0.name: First chair of archaeology is being appointed at the Christian-Albrechts University in Kiel
099e3dbc-0f28-51a2-b758-7ebc7a5f1ed0.description: The first Chair of Archaeology is appointed at the Christian-Albrechts-Universität in Kiel.

0a09f610-97fc-58f4-a63c-3c6b6e7e9c40.name: Archduke Maximilian visits Asia Minor and Egypt
0a09f610-97fc-58f4-a63c-3c6b6e7e9c40.description: Archduke Maximilian visits Asia Minor and Egypt.

0a135b62-5b93-5965-a31b-1a47b88c77ea.name: Marko K. Cepenkov
0a135b62-5b93-5965-a31b-1a47b88c77ea.description: Marko K. Cepenkov (1829–1920) was born in Prilep. Among the greatest collectors of Macedonian oral folk literature, during the 1860s he was prolific in recording folklore creations. The importance of his collecting activities lies not only in the volume but also in the diversity of folklore traditions recorded, including proverbs, sayings, tales, songs, riddles, charms, beliefs, dreams and interpretation, and children's games.

0a167285-6104-52c3-8a5f-e843a02321f2.name: Ambassador of Persia
0a167285-6104-52c3-8a5f-e843a02321f2.description: Visit by the Ambassador of Persia, Ferouk Kahn, to Napoleon III.

0a3a4aee-5239-5bf1-af89-d5e2d3fc39e7.name: Board for Advanced Studies and Research
0a3a4aee-5239-5bf1-af89-d5e2d3fc39e7.description: Creation of the Junta para Ampliación de Estudios e Investigaciones Científicas (JAE) (Board for Advanced Studies and Research), a public institution founded to provide scholarships for Spanish university students to attend European universities. Intended to promote contact with European culture and science, this public programme created a basis for reforms needed in education, culture and science. The JAE, ideologically related to the Institución Libre de Enseñanza (Free Institution for Education), was abolished by Franco’s government in 1938 and replaced by the Consejo Superior de Investigaciones Científicas (CSIC – Higher Council for Scientific Research) in 1939.

0a5a3bf6-40a6-56d9-a13d-d889796dd5a4.name: The number of motorvehicles circulating in Italy
0a5a3bf6-40a6-56d9-a13d-d889796dd5a4.description: The number of motorvehicles grows rapidly; by 1921 there are 30,000 motorcyles, 34,000 cars, 1,000 buses and 22000 trucks circulating in Italy.

0a7ee3a2-17d6-552a-8a81-edf7e7b0569d.name: Mahroussa Royal Yacht
0a7ee3a2-17d6-552a-8a81-edf7e7b0569d.description: The royal yacht *Mahroussa* is built for Isma‘il Pasha, the Khedive of Egypt.

0a80a03a-bbeb-5b69-b56e-02c5135daf25.name: Abolition and extermination of the Janissary Corps
0a80a03a-bbeb-5b69-b56e-02c5135daf25.description: 15–17 June: The abolition and extermination of the Janissary corps (the so-called Auspicious Incident) in İstanbul by troops loyal to Sultan Mahmud II. This act provides the conditions for institutional modernisation.

0ada0de1-ddcb-53e8-a8c6-870a907eb4c0.name: Annual per capita income
0ada0de1-ddcb-53e8-a8c6-870a907eb4c0.description: Annual per capita income increases by 18.5% during the decade because of industrialisation.

0aeefa71-422e-5d70-b8f3-a6b2f58117bb.name: Urbanism
0aeefa71-422e-5d70-b8f3-a6b2f58117bb.description: Georges Haussmann’s works in Paris cover all areas of city planning: streets and boulevards, reconstruction of buildings, parks and street furniture, drainage networks and water supply facilities, equipment and monuments.

0b2aeb81-4ed7-5251-810d-c607425edf1e.name: The Austrian archeologist Hermann Junker organized an excavation in Giza in Egypt
0b2aeb81-4ed7-5251-810d-c607425edf1e.description: The Austrian archaeologist Hermann Junker organises an excavation to Giza in Egypt.

0b5baa38-313d-5743-8d86-1d50e208ef0f.name: Planck Law on electromagnetic radiation
0b5baa38-313d-5743-8d86-1d50e208ef0f.description: Planck’s Law, which describes electromagnetic radiation.

0b842b85-2726-5d58-9a77-9008b5c8b9f8.name: The first product unit for electricity was founded in Athens
0b842b85-2726-5d58-9a77-9008b5c8b9f8.description: Founding of the first commercial unit for electricity in Athens. The Royal Palace was the first building in the capital to benefit from electric lighting.

0bb9e31d-d0ab-5e36-8698-dc77cd638991.name: Emperor Wilhelm II
0bb9e31d-d0ab-5e36-8698-dc77cd638991.description: Emperor Wilhelm II dismisses Bismarck; and so begins the era of the emperor’s personal regiment.

0c851661-bf13-59a8-a91c-6edaec43fd32.name: Feudal system abolished
0c851661-bf13-59a8-a91c-6edaec43fd32.description: The feudal system had been abolished under the Cádiz Constitution of 1812 but not completely enacted until 1837.

0c9eaebf-7927-59d1-80a6-ce6a065c7607.name: The Società geografica italiana is founded
0c9eaebf-7927-59d1-80a6-ce6a065c7607.description: The Società Geografica Italiana is founded. In 1869-70, it organises an exploratory expedition to East Africa, in 1875 to Tunisia and in 1876 to Ethiopia. Many other journeys to Africa, and also to Central Asia, South America and Papua follow. Such travels generally combined scientific purposes and political agendas.

0cc27085-c896-570a-b2c7-d027692f5ff8.name: Germany establishes German protectorates in Africa
0cc27085-c896-570a-b2c7-d027692f5ff8.description: Germany establishes protectorates in south-west Africa, Cameroon, Togo, East Africa and New Guinea.

0ce8b5bb-edc5-5298-9935-d76ec1c91265.name: Kulturkampf
0ce8b5bb-edc5-5298-9935-d76ec1c91265.description: As a consequence of the *Kulturkampf* the influence of the Catholic Church is limited in Germany.

0cfbd6f1-b472-564c-8466-22408122bdc3.name: Urban periphery
0cfbd6f1-b472-564c-8466-22408122bdc3.description: From 1870 onwards, as the peripheries around the big French cities like Paris, Lyon, Bordeaux and Marseille start growing, they develop into a real suburban belt around the city.

0d07fb57-3673-55e7-bb81-f29ea990f9c3.name: Delacroix in North Africa
0d07fb57-3673-55e7-bb81-f29ea990f9c3.description: Like many artists, the painter Eugène Delacroix travelled to North Africa, Morocco and Algeria, returning with many paintings and sources for inspiration.

0d1945ac-4fcc-5486-b818-17a76986f59d.name: Rebel clans allied to Sharif Hussein attacked Jiddah
0d1945ac-4fcc-5486-b818-17a76986f59d.description: Rebel clans allied to Sharif Husayn attack Jeddah (Jidda) and other seaports along the Arabian coast of the Red Sea.

0d5bddbf-871b-5e51-8af5-960886e25eae.name: Federation of Italian Cooperatives is funded
0d5bddbf-871b-5e51-8af5-960886e25eae.description: Federation of Italian Cooperatives is funded (from 1893 known as the League of Cooperatives).

0d64048c-5490-5201-ab6f-570fa8e1986b.name: L. Strauss
0d64048c-5490-5201-ab6f-570fa8e1986b.description: Levi Strauss, a German citizen in exile in America, requests the patent for blue Jeans.

0dafc2b8-f917-5fa7-8080-5ebe9e8de12e.name: Establishment of the Historical Commission of Romania
0dafc2b8-f917-5fa7-8080-5ebe9e8de12e.description: 27 April: the establishment of the Historical Commission of Romania, which is intended to publish critical editions of the Romanian medieval chronicles.

0dc18487-63ca-5bca-833e-1deec0c2fc99.name: Contesting the union of Transilvania with Hungary
0dc18487-63ca-5bca-833e-1deec0c2fc99.description: In 1892 a delegation of 237 Romanians sends Emperor Franz Joseph a Memorandum protesting against the discriminatory effects of the union of Transylvania with Hungary (1867). In 1893 the signatories of the petition are sent for trial at the end of which, in May 1894, they are sentenced to prison. However, in 1895 the Emperor amnesties them.

0dc35f57-3941-578f-8bcf-61efb8e2c339.name: For the International Exposition of Paris a book about Romania agriculture
0dc35f57-3941-578f-8bcf-61efb8e2c339.description: On the occasion of the International Exposition of Paris a book with information about Romania’s agriculture, commerce, industry and resources is published in Paris by a commission coordinated by Alexandru Odobescu.

0de38535-7b6d-5284-a895-071b90ea8da2.name: The discovery of the Jeita Grotto
0de38535-7b6d-5284-a895-071b90ea8da2.description: The discovery of the Jeita Grotto, credited to Reverend William Thomson. Further expeditions reveal the depth and the importance of the cave.

0e0d1fc5-dcae-5158-b58d-ec24933160a2.name: Currencies exchanged at a time
0e0d1fc5-dcae-5158-b58d-ec24933160a2.description: New currency is adopted when the Lebanese Bank is linked to the Syrian Bank.

0e23a24a-50e0-53c3-a43a-4889a370b6e6.name: In Milan, Luigi Cagnola completes the contruction of the Arch of Peace
0e23a24a-50e0-53c3-a43a-4889a370b6e6.description: In Milan, Luigi Cagnola completes the construction of the Arch of Peace, started during the Napoleonic age and inspired by the Arc du Carrousel in Paris. The stunning architectures of the Napoleonic age use arches, obelisks and allegorical groups of Roman and French classical inspiration.

0e8b123d-17ff-56ae-bf1b-5eb48430f904.name: Romania declares war on Austria
0e8b123d-17ff-56ae-bf1b-5eb48430f904.description: Romania declares war on the Central Powers: Germany, Austria and Bulgaria.

0e9cdec5-052c-56d2-ae93-1d20ebfa97bd.name: Eurico,O Presbítero
0e9cdec5-052c-56d2-ae93-1d20ebfa97bd.description: Publication of the novel *Eurico,O Presbítero* by Alexandre Herculano (1810–77). The story takes place during the period of the Arab invasion of Visigoth Hispania, led by Tarik in 711.

0ea22652-5af8-5f6a-a3a8-78e6845a20d0.name: Mountaineering on the Alps becomes a sport and tourist activity
0ea22652-5af8-5f6a-a3a8-78e6845a20d0.description: Mountaineering on the Alps becomes a sport and tourism activity. Local people had always climbed mountains. Since the end of the 18th century, scientists had started exploring the Alps for scientific purposes (Mont Blanc was first climbed in 1786). In 1857, Irish mountaineer John Ball starts climbing the Dolomites and writing guidebooks about them.

0eaf4ca2-9855-5e05-b23d-99d982efb8ca.name: New educational institutions
0eaf4ca2-9855-5e05-b23d-99d982efb8ca.description: Wealthy pearl merchants from the Arabian Gulf establish new educational institutions on the Trucial Coast. In addition to religious subjects, the schools – housed in purpose-built structures with proper classrooms – offer an expanded curriculum. In Sharjah, al-Taimiyyah (later al-Islah) and al-Nabudah schools are established.

0ed216f2-ded9-5a09-a2dd-d180b9ed48b6.name: Opening of Lisbon Botanical Garden
0ed216f2-ded9-5a09-a2dd-d180b9ed48b6.description: Opening of Lisbon Botanical Garden. During the 19th century Portugal aspires to reach the level of economic and social “progress” of other European countries in, for example, education and teaching. Natural History Museum and the Lisbon Botanical Garden were important institutions for scientific research and the exchange and circulation of ideas and natural knowledge.

0f0d5c1b-1cb2-5af7-be96-e97948cca894.name: Beirut Homs railway
0f0d5c1b-1cb2-5af7-be96-e97948cca894.description: In the reign of Yusuf Pasha, the train station in Beirut begins operating and is connected to the Syrian city of Homs with a single track. From the 1920s to the 1940s It formed the terminus of the Orient Express line.

0f2b9e54-538e-525b-b0ef-75c4f1074515.name: The Austrian archeologist Alexander Conze
0f2b9e54-538e-525b-b0ef-75c4f1074515.description: The Austrian archaeologist Alexander Conze organizes excavations in Samothrace.

0f7bab5a-5886-5e48-9639-4d8ef95478b5.name: Treaty of Maritime Peace in Perpetuity
0f7bab5a-5886-5e48-9639-4d8ef95478b5.description: A Treaty of Maritime Peace in Perpetuity is concluded between Britain and the Trucial Coast rulers. Britain assumes the right to police maritime peace and commits to protecting the sheikhdoms from external interference and attack.

101d0d66-2ec6-5ad5-a3eb-ff4c0dae78c3.name: Creation of the Wiener Werkstätte
101d0d66-2ec6-5ad5-a3eb-ff4c0dae78c3.description: The Wiener Werkstätte, an association of designers such as Joseph Hofmann and Koloman Moser is founded, covering all aspects of design from fashion to furniture.

104970b8-6551-5325-8f6c-6ed5952cd3ba.name: The book titled Mirror
104970b8-6551-5325-8f6c-6ed5952cd3ba.description: The book titled *Mirror* by Kiril Pejchinovic (1771–1845) is published in Budim. This great Macedonian educator was born in Tearce near Tetovo. The first books in Macedonian published in the early 19th century were on religious subjects, which was understandable given that they were written by people of the Church.

10663b25-28b7-5a56-932f-717d3b388be2.name: First world performance of the new opera by Verdi, *Aida*
10663b25-28b7-5a56-932f-717d3b388be2.description: 24 December: first world performance of the new opera by Verdi, *Aida*, set in ancient Egypt, at the Khedivial Opera House in Cairo.

10783369-6790-557c-869a-de230bbc10e8.name: In Bucharest are installed the first electric generators used to illuminate some important buildings
10783369-6790-557c-869a-de230bbc10e8.description: In Bucharest the first electric generators are installed and used to illuminate some important buildings of the city (the Royal Palace, the Cotroceni Palace, the National Theatre), Victory Avenue and Cişmigiu Park.

10951498-b929-5d63-9955-6058622ee6ea.name: Seventh exhibition
10951498-b929-5d63-9955-6058622ee6ea.description: The exposition known as the Universal World Exhibition of Art and Industry – the seventh World Expo/Fair and the second held in Paris after that of 1855; it ran from 1 April to 3 November 1867 on the Champ-de-Mars in Paris; 41 countries were represented.

10bf9640-3d11-572b-9725-3e5d4d8eccb4.name: Mulay Sulayman
10bf9640-3d11-572b-9725-3e5d4d8eccb4.description: At the beginning of his reign, Mulay Sulayman adopts a policy to isolate the country, excluding contact with the European and even Turkish worlds. He leant on the national brotherhoods and maintained mediaeval, feudal ways of life that eschewed Western technical innovations which he deemed to be dangerous. He nonetheless signed agreements with Portugal in 1823, England in 1824 and France in 1825, under pressure to change his position on account of the international situation. During the first third of the 19th century, Morocco was subject to systematic pressure from rapidly expanding European imperialism.

10da572e-23ec-5846-9acb-b85c441b2d74.name: Unionism
10da572e-23ec-5846-9acb-b85c441b2d74.description: Unionism (“workers’ and employers professional associations”) becomes legal in France.

10e3e94e-4c86-567d-b572-f947ff76e794.name: Karl of Hohenzollern
10e3e94e-4c86-567d-b572-f947ff76e794.description: Karl of Hohenzollern-Sigmaringen from south-western Germany is elected as Prince of Romania.

10f7cc32-ef14-59ea-a170-1accfa0ed6a8.name: The Valençay Treaty
10f7cc32-ef14-59ea-a170-1accfa0ed6a8.description: The Valençay Treaty ends the war between Spain and France. Return of King Fernando VII and absolutist restoration.

1114a73b-48bc-5cec-82c4-a1738c06305b.name: First Constitution of Serbia
1114a73b-48bc-5cec-82c4-a1738c06305b.description: The First Constitution of the Principality of Serbia (the Candlemas Constitution) is prompted by the autocratic rule of Miloš Obrenović, founder of the Obrenović Dynasty and Serbian Prince (1815–39; 1858–60). It is signed in 1835 in the city of Kragujevac, with the intention to limit the absolute power of Miloš, but under pressure from the *Porte* (Turkish Government), Austria and Russia the Constitution is abolished as early as the following year.

120e2be4-fbf3-5705-ab07-e367fb80ddf4.name: The German National Assembly approves the Constitution of the German Empire
120e2be4-fbf3-5705-ab07-e367fb80ddf4.description: The German National Assembly approves the Constitution of the German Empire.

1246abcf-0fc6-580d-9327-0ad802135949.name: Martyrs Square
1246abcf-0fc6-580d-9327-0ad802135949.description: Turkish authorities publicly execute 21 Syrians and Lebanese in Damascus and Beirut, respectively, for alleged anti-Turkish activities; the place of execution in each city will be renamed Martyrs' Square.

128b652e-a521-5fe9-aabe-b9b119cc56e3.name: First Italian railway line (Napoli-Portici)
128b652e-a521-5fe9-aabe-b9b119cc56e3.description: First Italian railway line (Napoli–Portici, 8 km). In the following years, other railway lines are inaugurated in other Italian states, e.g. Milano–Monza (1840), Pisa-Livorno (1844), Padova–Venezia (1846), Torino–Moncalieri (1848). Political fragmentation is an obstacle to the construction of long railway lines.

12ba8dd2-163b-5584-97bd-08a80d6e860b.name: Inauguration of the first public kindergarten in Lisbon and Porto
12ba8dd2-163b-5584-97bd-08a80d6e860b.description: Inauguration of the first public kindergarten in Lisbon and Porto by followers of the Froebel method. The pupils, aged from 3 to 7 years, are divided into four age groups, each with a classroom; the plan includes a games room, toilets, offices and a refectory. The method respected the learning rhythm of the children and created didactic tools.

12c38c45-0bcf-5c0c-8250-0ae0c129313d.name: Foreign tourists visiting Italy
12c38c45-0bcf-5c0c-8250-0ae0c129313d.description: The growth of a European middle class and the improvement of transportation make tourism possible for increasing numbers of European citizens. According to very tentative estimates, 450,000 foreign tourists visited Italy in 1897 and 900,000 in 1911.

12ef0f6f-44ad-59d3-9b4c-bb9d7b4e2f0e.name: Giovanni Agnelli founds the FIAT
12ef0f6f-44ad-59d3-9b4c-bb9d7b4e2f0e.description: In Turin, Giovanni Agnelli founds the car factory FIAT.

1315fea9-0b32-50d4-8167-65c27887ac55.name: Irish Free State
1315fea9-0b32-50d4-8167-65c27887ac55.description: Of the 32 counties of Ireland, twenty-six southern counties vote to secede from the United Kingdom to become the Irish Free State.

133dedf0-1730-57ee-b04a-8a73e8cc6622.name: Crisis and protectorate
133dedf0-1730-57ee-b04a-8a73e8cc6622.description: Crises, both within the country’s social structures and the national economy, are the result of the protectorate’s grip over all the regency’s administration.

1384525b-2940-54b6-8ebf-48819b421efe.name: Building of the Ring-Strasse  in Vienna
1384525b-2940-54b6-8ebf-48819b421efe.description: Vienna’s newly constructed Ringstrasse covers an area of approximately 2,400,000m2 (240 hectares).

1385d01a-905a-5a43-8356-0c896e7cd386.name: Finest Stories
1385d01a-905a-5a43-8356-0c896e7cd386.description: Ahmed Mithat Efendi (1844–1912), who introduced the novel from the Ottoman community begins to publish *Letaif-I Rivayat* (Finest Stories), which includes long stories and novellas.

1393c03d-c74f-5fbf-8bed-71ac52047f96.name: The archaeological area of Delphi
1393c03d-c74f-5fbf-8bed-71ac52047f96.description: Tourists flock to Delphi from all over the world attracted mainly by its archaeology. The guestbook of the Hotel Pythios Appolon provides a glimpse of the cosmopolitan atmosphere at Delphi during the first quarter of the 20th century.

139c03ed-8735-5765-989c-f29c68f05fe5.name: Building of the "Bagdadbahn"
139c03ed-8735-5765-989c-f29c68f05fe5.description: Building of the "Bagdadbahn" ("Bagdad railway"), a railway- section in the Ottoman Empire with a length of around 3200 km through Turkey, Syria and Iran. Together with the "Hedjaz railway" it was built under Abdul Hamid the second. He wanted to facilitate the pilgrimage, as people could travel from Damaskus to Medina and Mekka directly.

13be69a2-f1ae-55ba-8438-2df6c4563e9c.name: Invention of stethoscope
13be69a2-f1ae-55ba-8438-2df6c4563e9c.description: The stethoscope is invented by Dr René Laennec.

13dac36b-9fbb-5fa2-8583-815b08f81f34.name: German warships shell Russian ports
13dac36b-9fbb-5fa2-8583-815b08f81f34.description: 29 October: German warships, officially designated as Ottoman vessels, shell Russian Black Sea ports, an action that leads the Ottoman Empire to enter World War I.

13f09772-83c1-5950-834a-c8ed548ab089.name: Phillipp Reis invents telephone
13f09772-83c1-5950-834a-c8ed548ab089.description: Johann Phillipp Reis invents the telephone.

13f3a45c-e521-5c84-8cb0-1a0c4db2f33c.name: The development of the field of the classical archaeology is strongly being influenced by Heinrich Schliemann
13f3a45c-e521-5c84-8cb0-1a0c4db2f33c.description: The development of Classical Archaeology is strongly influenced by Heinrich Schliemann in the second half of the 18th century when for example he finds the “Gold of Troy”.

144af4db-27e8-512e-86e7-93a6d2ac316a.name: Reconstruction of the city of Sparta
144af4db-27e8-512e-86e7-93a6d2ac316a.description: In October, King Otto issues a decree for reconstruction of the city of Sparta. Over the ancient city Bavarian city-planners, headed by Fr. Staufert, design a city for 100,000 inhabitants based on the Ippodamia system, with wide roads and many squares.

14670826-d154-53d0-9149-b7009e74f781.name: Newspaper: Interpreter of Events
14670826-d154-53d0-9149-b7009e74f781.description: October: Journalists İbrahim Şinasi and Agah Efendi publish the first private Muslim newspaper *Tercümân-ı Ahvâl* (Interpreter of Events).

149c58fd-41d3-57ee-aec9-d4ade39856ee.name: Khayr al-Din conducts missions
149c58fd-41d3-57ee-aec9-d4ade39856ee.description: Khayr al-Din, the reforming minister of Tunisia, conducts various missions in Europe and to the Sublime Porte (Sublime Gate), the honorific title used for Istanbul during the Ottoman Empire.

14e456be-2287-5b9c-bde0-e7f1e952d116.name: Travelling became a great cultural and social phenomenon with Romanticism
14e456be-2287-5b9c-bde0-e7f1e952d116.description: Travelling became a great cultural and social phenomenon with Romanticism. The “Grand Tour” through the countries of the known world, namely around the Mediterranean, became a means of developing cultural and social skills. Travel became refined and even a simple journey to the countryside required such accessories as this travel case for meals.

16d0725b-4908-5c0b-b08f-8309478e18c0.name: The School of Posillipo
16d0725b-4908-5c0b-b08f-8309478e18c0.description: The painters of the School of Posillipo (Naples) develop a new style of more natural observation of landscapes and everyday life.

16e436e2-76c7-53af-a380-e4ad7f0d6779.name: Louis Philippe becomes king
16e436e2-76c7-53af-a380-e4ad7f0d6779.description: The July Monarchy: Louis-Philippe becomes “Citizen-King”, and economic growth is joined by increased poverty.

1757dfec-5a7d-5969-bd98-f81a57fa0be0.name: General Exhibition of Turin, construction of the Rocca and the Borgo Medievale
1757dfec-5a7d-5969-bd98-f81a57fa0be0.description: On the occasion of the 1884 General Exhibition of Turin, construction of the Rocca (castle) and the Borgo Medievale (medieval village) in Parco del Valentino (Valentino Park) in order to promote appreciation for 15th-century Piedmont architecture. In 1884, the Municipality of Turin buys part of this area, where it will later locate the Civic Museums.

177a2a10-8763-5bd6-91ac-d38f619f2abb.name: Impressionism
177a2a10-8763-5bd6-91ac-d38f619f2abb.description: Impressionist painters capture the effects of light in outdoor and everyday scenes.

17834dd3-8caf-573f-9a71-c1194bc77345.name: At the National Theatre in Iaşi is premiered the first Romanian operetta
17834dd3-8caf-573f-9a71-c1194bc77345.description: The premiere at the National Theatre in Iaşi of the first Romanian operetta, *Baba Hârca*, with a script by poet Matei Millo and music composed by Alexandru Flechtenmacher.

18348636-06c2-565a-8a91-f4223e057682.name: School of Fine Arts and an art gallery founded in Iaşi
18348636-06c2-565a-8a91-f4223e057682.description: 7 November: on the initiative of painter Gheorghe Panaitescu-Bardasare, a School of Fine Arts and an art gallery are founded in Iaşi.

186ea0b3-28bc-5331-86e0-704c5ef7795b.name: After the defeat of the Al Qawasim by the British
186ea0b3-28bc-5331-86e0-704c5ef7795b.description: After the defeat of the Qawasim by the British, a British Residency is established at Bushire on the Persian littoral to represent Britain’s political, economic and military interests there. Shortly after, a “Native Agent” is based in Sharjah as his representative. Native agents were generally non-Arab but Arabic-speaking Muslims from the Indian subcontinent or the Persian littoral of the Gulf, chosen for their loyalty to Britain and their in-depth local and regional knowledge. Their task was to monitor activities on the Trucial Coast and liaise with local powers on Britain’s behalf.

1893df01-89ac-5cc1-9796-46c8d86d812e.name: Founding of the Allgemeine Deutsche Verband
1893df01-89ac-5cc1-9796-46c8d86d812e.description: Founding of the Pan-German League (*Allgemeine Deutsche Verband*; since 1894 the General German Association or *Alldeutscher Verband*) to advance an active, nationalistic German foreign policy in Europe and overseas.

18b93719-ae33-55e3-a4bd-640d2059e998.name: Muhammad Sadiq Bey promulgates a constitution
18b93719-ae33-55e3-a4bd-640d2059e998.description: Muhammad Sadiq Bey promulgates a constitution limiting his powers. Tunisia’s first constitution is the culmination of the reformist policies of the 19th-century Husaynid beys.

190693b9-6cc3-54e6-93e5-fb8b42e5cbd2.name: Ministry of Post
190693b9-6cc3-54e6-93e5-fb8b42e5cbd2.description: 23 October: The Ottoman Ministry of Post is established in Istanbul.

19668414-b3d4-5611-b3e7-feac3db315c2.name: For the first time, a cholera epidemic hits Italy
19668414-b3d4-5611-b3e7-feac3db315c2.description: For the first time, a cholera epidemic hits Italy, killing more than 140,000 (26,000 in Palermo and 19,600 in Naples). Its causes remain unknown until the 1880s. Its spread is favoured by poor sanitation in urban centres. Cholera epidemics hit poor people especially and often occasion social unrest.

198cbf31-5ba7-56fb-a344-92c57255d6d4.name: The Classical era in literature
198cbf31-5ba7-56fb-a344-92c57255d6d4.description: The Classical era in literature (i.e. the work of Goethe, Schiller, Wieland and Herder) is characterised by a will to preserve beauty, maintain goodness in order to gain harmony, and sees nature as an entity. The centre for this movement in literature is the city of Weimar.

19c1b5fe-ab20-513d-bfe6-3dab7602b97a.name: Sufragettes
19c1b5fe-ab20-513d-bfe6-3dab7602b97a.description: Manifestation of French suffragettes for women’s right to vote.

19c80298-15ee-5af4-af31-ff41a9cdb71d.name: Telegraph
19c80298-15ee-5af4-af31-ff41a9cdb71d.description: By this year Portugal has 8,345 km of telegraphic lines and 443 telegraphic stations. The telegraph is an urban phenomenon hand in hand with city development. Due to the demand for telegraphic operators, several schools were created. Submarine cables assured the telegraphic service between Portugal and the United Kingdom, the United States of America, and Africa.

1a0fff83-c8f7-5769-b98f-49f9e93fa75a.name: The first railroad in Macedonia
1a0fff83-c8f7-5769-b98f-49f9e93fa75a.description: The first railway in Macedonia runs from Thessalonica via Skopje to Belgrade. Its construction, financed with foreign investments, began in 1871 and the track to Skopje is finished in 1873. The Skopje–Mitrovica line is completed in 1878. In 1888 it is connected to Serbian railways at the border crossing Zibevche near Vranje.

1a107d7c-3120-57f4-bfaf-5c2a871de713.name: The first Commercial Code
1a107d7c-3120-57f4-bfaf-5c2a871de713.description: 18 September: The first Commercial Code by jurist José Ferreira Borges grants free trade and distribution of goods, abolishing monopolies, privileges and real estate transfer taxes. Article 2 defines a commercial act and the nature of intervening actors.

1a226810-faa9-5bc6-8431-4a9c5f7125c3.name: Austrian engineers Karol and Rafael
1a226810-faa9-5bc6-8431-4a9c5f7125c3.description: Austrian engineers Karol and Rafael Hoffmann and Carol Maderspach initiate the extraction of coal in the Jiu Valley (south Transylvania), which was and still is the main coal-mining region of Romania.

1a2f1bf5-03f4-5776-b538-6c8a51882add.name: Treaty of Erzurum
1a2f1bf5-03f4-5776-b538-6c8a51882add.description: 28 July: Treaty of Erzurum, which ends the Ottoman–Iranian war and restores the previous border.

1ab81572-3f54-5b35-99a1-f877dcff13eb.name: Almost uninterrupted rule by Giovanni Giolitti
1ab81572-3f54-5b35-99a1-f877dcff13eb.description: Almost uninterrupted rule by Giovanni Giolitti, who allows more freedom of action to trade unions, introduces some social reforms and makes some openings for Socialists and Catholics.

1abad8aa-fe77-59c3-8da6-f5cc736a354d.name: First Balkan War
1abad8aa-fe77-59c3-8da6-f5cc736a354d.description: The First Balkan War begins in October 1912 between Serbia, Bulgaria, Greece, Montenegro and the Ottoman Empire; Montenegro is accused of igniting it by attacking Skadar. At the request of Turkey, an armistice is concluded in December 1912. Negotiations in London fail and the war continues into 1913. A Peace Treaty is signed in London in May 1913. Turkey surrenders all territories west of the Enos-Midija. The Serbian Navy withdraws from the sea; in November 1912, Albania is formed due to Austrian pressure.

1adf1060-6f94-584f-acd2-4bbe43e3fbbe.name: The Queen Regent, María Cristina, is forced to reinstate the 1812
1adf1060-6f94-584f-acd2-4bbe43e3fbbe.description: The Queen Regent, María Cristina, is forced to reinstate the 1812 Constitution after a military coup (*pronunciamiento*) in order to get support from the liberals in the First Carlist War. Under the Desamortización de Mendizábal Church properties are disentailed to fund the war. General Espartero takes over the Regency from the Queen in 1841.

1b52bd97-229c-5f88-85f4-b1d4c31010cd.name: Reproduced a traditional technique
1b52bd97-229c-5f88-85f4-b1d4c31010cd.description: Although it reproduces a traditional technique, the use of azulejo (ceramic tilework) meets the need for modernisation of shops and public buildings in main cities throughout Portugal at the beginning of the 20th century.

1b697cc9-a945-56a6-b5a2-6d7260042c76.name: famous ceramics decorated the interior of the Portuguese Pavilion
1b697cc9-a945-56a6-b5a2-6d7260042c76.description: At the Paris “Exposition Universelle” Bordalo Pinheiro’s (1846–1905) famous ceramics decorating the interior of the Portuguese Pavilion are a main attraction for the cosmopolitan visitor.

1b6deecd-ba59-5994-aafe-f0151f6c6f59.name: Creation of l’hôpital civil français
1b6deecd-ba59-5994-aafe-f0151f6c6f59.description: Creation of the French civil hospital provides a surgery and two general medical services to meet the needs of the European population from the outset.

1b8b8adb-0765-5dd6-ac4c-8713616d0bf1.name: Wartburgfest
1b8b8adb-0765-5dd6-ac4c-8713616d0bf1.description: Rise of the *Wartburgfest*, an assembly of radical students who want to implement the idea of a German National State.

1bd3562c-ff49-5451-a9fa-cdb07d01a5cc.name: Portugal started to use the first adhesive postal stamps on letters
1bd3562c-ff49-5451-a9fa-cdb07d01a5cc.description: 1 July: Portugal starts to use the first adhesive postal stamps on letters, postcards and parcels, in the reign of Queen Mary II. Bearing the Queen’ s effigy they are inspired by the first British stamp.

1bf4ff28-934d-5470-a3b9-80ff08b413a4.name: Alexander Graham Bell
1bf4ff28-934d-5470-a3b9-80ff08b413a4.description: In 1870, after attending universities in Edinburgh and London, Scottish-born Alexander Graham Bell (1847–1922) immigrates to Canada before becoming professor of vocal physiology at Boston. There, in pursuit of a device to help the deaf, Bell invented the telephone, which he patented in February 1876 only days ahead of other rivals. It was not until 10 March 1876 that the famous words “Mr Watson, come here; I want you” were transmitted by telephone. He formed the Bell Telephone Company in 1877.

1cb1a73c-1f2a-52c4-b820-73acf6f26d5d.name: Formation of the Kaiser-Friedrich-Museum
1cb1a73c-1f2a-52c4-b820-73acf6f26d5d.description: Formation of the Kaiser-Friedrich-Museum (now the Bode Museum), proposed by Wilhelm von Bode, and built by Ernst von Ihne and Max Hasak.

1ce79b34-0905-5efc-b275-132f1f449350.name: International Exhibition on Industry and Art
1ce79b34-0905-5efc-b275-132f1f449350.description: The “International Exhibition on Industry and Art” in London distinguishes Portugal with 165 Medals of Honor and 240 mentions.

1cf1a45e-7f75-5dc8-9bac-6e480514cbe8.name: Agriculture
1cf1a45e-7f75-5dc8-9bac-6e480514cbe8.description: An exponential growth in agriculture sees increased land cultivation, mechanisation and expansion of crops grown for fodder.

1cf3f727-91fc-5c41-a5f3-98a4ebe8afab.name: Foundation of the Romanian Chamber of Commerce
1cf3f727-91fc-5c41-a5f3-98a4ebe8afab.description: 27 October: foundation of the Romanian Chamber of Commerce and Industry.

1d748eb0-d69f-5887-909c-4b335ca834e9.name: Egon Schiele memeber of Bund Österreichischer Künstler
1d748eb0-d69f-5887-909c-4b335ca834e9.description: Egon Schiele (1890–1918) becomes a member of the Bund Österreichischer Künstler (Society of Austrian Artists).

1d80b430-81bf-54d8-a08e-a09e345a5bc5.name: Count of forced migration rising
1d80b430-81bf-54d8-a08e-a09e345a5bc5.description: Forced migration rises and more than 10 million people (within Europe) are displaced. Berlin temporarily becomes the centre for Russian immigrants.

1d8271ff-8e78-5d6d-a53e-4909fa160f7d.name: The Czech writer Franz Kafka is born
1d8271ff-8e78-5d6d-a53e-4909fa160f7d.description: The Czech writer Frank Kafka is born in Prague; he dies in Klosterneuburg, Austria, in 1924.

1da88d6b-1689-5e15-a063-1ba569f71505.name: Egyptian Olympic Athletes Club
1da88d6b-1689-5e15-a063-1ba569f71505.description: The Egyptian Olympic Athletes Club is built in Alexandria.

1dbc9be9-850b-5a22-ae90-93b2495c8430.name: Naturalism
1dbc9be9-850b-5a22-ae90-93b2495c8430.description: Naturalism, a literary movement that draws inspiration from descriptions of life, science and documentary observation, and which on occasion makes use of crude vocabulary to give it greater veracity, causes widespread offence. The movement was led by Émile Zola, with his Rougon-Macquart cycle.

1deaf7c6-d882-54cc-badc-15376551102d.name: The Manises pottery
1deaf7c6-d882-54cc-badc-15376551102d.description: The Manises pottery begins to produce objects in lustreware.

1e174e29-bbd7-5ec8-b16d-b2f6b7c3a8a3.name: First government secondary schools
1e174e29-bbd7-5ec8-b16d-b2f6b7c3a8a3.description: September: First government secondary schools (*rüşdiyye mektebi*) are established.

1e5a4156-59dc-5860-b506-6b8297c80c79.name: Issuing of the journal in Macedonian and Russian language Makedonski Golos
1e5a4156-59dc-5860-b506-6b8297c80c79.description: First publication of the Macedonian and Russian language journal *Makedonski Golos* (Macedonian Voice). Krste Petkov Misirkov and Dimitrija Chupovski, central figures of the Slav-Macedonian Scientific Literary Society, were largely responsible for its publishing.

1e6a1021-77f1-5529-ba17-ac06c6603479.name: Sharjah town is recorded as having fortified towers and walls
1e6a1021-77f1-5529-ba17-ac06c6603479.description: A survey of Sharjah records it as having fortified towers and walls, a large mosque, as well as single- and two-storey houses.

1ea44b84-b1fc-58d7-910d-642c6f489634.name: The Ottoman Bank
1ea44b84-b1fc-58d7-910d-642c6f489634.description: The Ottoman Bank is established by English capitalists with capital of ₤500,000 (equivalent to about US$52 million in 2007). Established on a small scale, the bank becomes an imperial bank by 1863.

1eafc06d-bfac-5233-a26a-a61abf603096.name: Construction of Mole Antonelliana
1eafc06d-bfac-5233-a26a-a61abf603096.description: Construction of the 167.5 m high Mole Antonelliana in Turin, initially conceived as a synagogue. It soon becomes the city’s landmark building.

1eb743a6-bcce-549d-b7a2-fd4b80ab879e.name: A small number of Lebanese people emigrate to the USA
1eb743a6-bcce-549d-b7a2-fd4b80ab879e.description: A small number of Lebanese people emigrate to the USA, the first of a wave of migration abroad.

1ede0208-8f4a-55b6-85d0-48831db2512f.name: Steamship company Şirket-i Hayriyye
1ede0208-8f4a-55b6-85d0-48831db2512f.description: The steamship company Şirket-i Hayriyye is founded.

1efa4fa9-de8d-5c0a-a288-28d272fc6adf.name: Restoration of the monarchy
1efa4fa9-de8d-5c0a-a288-28d272fc6adf.description: Restoration of the monarchy. A military uprising under General Martínez Campos in Sagunto against the Republic returns the throne to the Bourbon Dynasty, with Alfonso XII (son of Isabel II) as King.

1f0e0f75-5d99-5efc-a6ba-2180bdcb726c.name: Madrid Conference
1f0e0f75-5d99-5efc-a6ba-2180bdcb726c.description: The intention of the 1880 Madrid Conference, reflected in the agreements signed by Morocco under the reign of Mulay al-Hasan I and the countries of Europe, is to enhance the benefits of reform in Morocco and to provide a legal and regulatory framework for Mulay al-Hasan I. Following these agreements, the European countries won the right to own land and assets throughout Morocco. The agreements were the result of globalisation of Moroccan business.

1f482de8-b2a0-5984-aa89-545dc7e852df.name: Idealized by the Sociedade de Geografia
1f482de8-b2a0-5984-aa89-545dc7e852df.description: “Exposition Universelle”, Antwerp. Sponsored by the Sociedade de Geografia de Lisboa and Banco Nacional Ultramarino, the Portuguese Pavilion reflects a strong Islamic influence.

1fb6d132-3a76-562e-831f-e60b9f261aa7.name: Archeologist Alexandru Odobescu publishes in France
1fb6d132-3a76-562e-831f-e60b9f261aa7.description: Archaeologist Alexandru Odobescu publishes in France a book about the Pietroasa Treasure (a historical description and a study on antique silver work).

204873f3-71c8-59f4-885f-e45a15cb4d95.name: Urban redevelopment of Athens
204873f3-71c8-59f4-885f-e45a15cb4d95.description: Eduard Schaubert and Stamatios Kleanthis pioneer the urban redevelopment of Athens, initially under Ioannis Kapodistrias. They produce topographical plans of Athens and, in doing so, lay the foundations for the new capital.

208a70bb-c83c-5a38-b025-759b1636a4af.name: Promulgation of the Fundamental Pact by Muhammad Pasha Bey
208a70bb-c83c-5a38-b025-759b1636a4af.description: Promulgation of the Fundamental Pact by Muhammad Pasha Bey: a “Declaration of Rights” in 11 points. The pact guarantees Tunisians and also foreigners their civil and political rights, security of persons and properties, equality before the law, etc.

20b19ace-0d42-5650-8f21-d20ebb8ff796.name: The Generation of ‘68 writers
20b19ace-0d42-5650-8f21-d20ebb8ff796.description: The “Generation of ‘68” writers begin to publish after the 1868 revolution; the group is named by one of its members, Leopoldo Alas, known as Clarín. Their characteristics are middle-class consciousness and a realist style. Authors in this group include Pedro Antonio de Alarcón, José María Pereda, Benito Pérez Galdós and Emilia Pardo Bazán.

20cc656c-5a26-5698-8ebb-b461768495ba.name: Association of Ottoman Painters
20cc656c-5a26-5698-8ebb-b461768495ba.description: A Turkish group of painters, Association of Ottoman Painters, is founded by students from the Fine Arts Academy in İstanbul.

21072bfc-072d-55ef-aa81-43e1a700d455.name: Foundation of the Austrian Agricultural University in Vienna
21072bfc-072d-55ef-aa81-43e1a700d455.description: Foundation of the Austrian Agricultural University in Vienna.

211b4823-4a3a-57dc-9ec3-7647daef8911.name: Liberal regimes get implemented in the government
211b4823-4a3a-57dc-9ec3-7647daef8911.description: Liberal regimes, now with seats in government, herald a series of liberal reforms in all German states. After riots in Berlin, Prussian King Frederick William IV promises liberal and national reforms.

212a80b9-95be-5831-8674-0571c8cc7d35.name: Bazil G. Assan is the first Romanian in an expedition around the world
212a80b9-95be-5831-8674-0571c8cc7d35.description: Bazil G. Assan is the first Romanian to go on an expedition around the world, taking the route Constanța–Istanbul–Cairo–Ceylon–China–Japan–Pacific Ocean–USA–Europe.

213a880a-9ea7-5e70-9c3b-bf3fd002c1da.name: The French expedition to Algeria
213a880a-9ea7-5e70-9c3b-bf3fd002c1da.description: The French expedition to Algeria arouses strong emotions in Morocco. It was understood to be a direct threat, in particular following incursions by French troops into eastern Morocco. Mulay ‘Abd al-Rahman accepted the call of the people of Tlemcen and gave his support to the religious and military leader ‘Abd al-Qadir.

2178436e-281a-5b4b-838d-ef1c992da00d.name: Shahin Pasha Aqueduct infilled with earth
2178436e-281a-5b4b-838d-ef1c992da00d.description: Shahin Pasha Aqueduct, constructed under Muhammad ‘Ali and located between the Omar Shah and Tukuz Tamar (Darb el-Jamamiz) aqueducts, is infilled with earth.

218e7bcd-f19f-5d31-84fa-18bd0e8949ba.name: Credits for construction in Rome
218e7bcd-f19f-5d31-84fa-18bd0e8949ba.description: A credit-fuelled “construction fever” explodes in Rome and in the other urban centres.

2193f82e-a4ab-58ee-bad6-5d0251eb69e6.name: Process of Industrialisation in the Ruhrgebiet
2193f82e-a4ab-58ee-bad6-5d0251eb69e6.description: As the process of Industrialisation in the so-called Ruhrgebiet region develops, Polish miners and farmhands migrate to the Ruhr, which becomes a place known as Ruhrpoland.

21f88905-d3af-5022-abbb-80b3fc47b4f1.name: The first oil refinery in Romania
21f88905-d3af-5022-abbb-80b3fc47b4f1.description: March: the first oil refinery in Romania is built by Teodor Mehedinţeanu at Râfov, Prahova.

226663cc-0d22-5826-a339-733a6841fa82.name: Urban General Improvements Plan for Lisbon
226663cc-0d22-5826-a339-733a6841fa82.description: The "Urban General Improvements Plan for Lisbon" (Commission of 1876–81) designs wide, straight roads – modern boulevards – to define orthogonal blocks for buildings, with roundabouts, pavements, vegetation and street furniture namely at Avenida 24 de Julho, Avenida da Liberdade and covering the area from Picoas to Campo Grande.

22aa4a91-2805-54bd-90b6-4c52d9003f14.name: Era of eclecticism
22aa4a91-2805-54bd-90b6-4c52d9003f14.description: It was the era of eclecticism. The French Protectorate builds the regency’s infrastructure in the European classical tradition, constructing monuments in the impressive Greco-Roman style.

22b932b5-680c-554f-a87a-6b93adc2a209.name: Treaty of Sèvres and the Arab Revolt
22b932b5-680c-554f-a87a-6b93adc2a209.description: Squabbling among the allies (those that had betrayed the Arab Revolution) delays the signing of the Peace Treaty with the Ottomans, which is being negotiated at Sèvres in France up until 10 August 1920. The Treaty confirmed French and British possession of Syria, Lebanon, Palestine, Jordan and Iraq in the guise of League of Nations mandates. Sharif Husayn ibn ‘Ali is rewarded for his leadership of the Arab Revolt with international recognition of the Hijaz as an independent kingdom.

22e0337a-d083-5410-97a5-33b0ffbb8271.name: Establishment of the Austrian Lloyd
22e0337a-d083-5410-97a5-33b0ffbb8271.description: Austrian Lloyd, the main steamship company on the Mediterranean, with headquarters in Trieste, is established.

2305d7b6-00ab-52e6-8465-2a991867a6f4.name: Abdication of Napoleon I
2305d7b6-00ab-52e6-8465-2a991867a6f4.description: Abdication of Napoleon I on 6 April sees the end of the First French Empire (1804–14).

23415d77-cbe0-5611-9250-b42909c13baf.name: Curzon’s tour of the Gulf
23415d77-cbe0-5611-9250-b42909c13baf.description: The British Viceroy, Lord Curzon, visits the sheikhdoms of the Gulf to confirm treaties of protection that exclude other European powers. Iraq and Arabia fall under a British- Indian sphere of influence with the Indian rupee as the principal currency. Curzon’s policy lasts until 1970.

2347b51d-1602-533f-aa68-08739756b410.name: Arthur Schopenhauer publishes
2347b51d-1602-533f-aa68-08739756b410.description: Arthur Schopenhauer publishes *Die Welt als Wille und Vorstellung* (*The World as Will and Representation* is the title of the latest, 2008, English translation; the first was published in 1883).The second, expanded German edition appeared in 1944.

23613db0-b5b3-59fa-89a6-096917164454.name: Birth of the great Romanian sculptor Constantin Brâncuşi
23613db0-b5b3-59fa-89a6-096917164454.description: 19 February: birth of the great Romanian sculptor Constantin Brâncuşi, author of sculptures such as *Mademoiselle Pogany*, *The Kiss*, *Bird in Space*, and *The Endless Column*. His works are today exhibited in museums in France, the USA and Romania.

237db687-9988-5d40-9f97-50a536d5dc1c.name: the Portuguese Pavilion set up an emblematic and sophisticated scenario
237db687-9988-5d40-9f97-50a536d5dc1c.description: At the Paris “Exposition Universelle”, the Portuguese Pavilion sets up a sophisticated, emblematic scenario, portraying the monasteries of Batalha and Jerónimos, two of the magnificent symbols of the 15th and 16th Portuguese Discoveries.

239571e4-ad63-54f8-b782-50ec72fbaf35.name: The Ottoman government decides to build the Electric Tramway Station in Beirut
239571e4-ad63-54f8-b782-50ec72fbaf35.description: The Ottoman government decides to build the Electric Tramway Station in Beirut. The electric tramway passes through Beirut on seven tram lines built in 1891 heading to the coast and linking Beirut and Mameltein.

23c6ab90-5b01-5c84-9c23-7aa709098046.name: Ulysses by James Joyce
23c6ab90-5b01-5c84-9c23-7aa709098046.description: Irish writer and poet James Augustine Aloysius Joyce’s (1822–1941) best-known work *Ulysses* is published in this year.

23e78cfe-78a4-5b4e-9d94-c837eae6652a.name: Hermenegildo Capelo
23e78cfe-78a4-5b4e-9d94-c837eae6652a.description: Hermenegildo Capelo, Roberto Ivens and Serpa Pinto appointed to organise an expedition to southern Africa. After a briefing by Silva Porto in Bié, they chose separate itineraries. Capelo and Ivens focus on the Kwanza and Kuangu rivers and on the Yaka people. Serpa Pinto picks the Zambezi River and eventually reaches the Transvaal.

23f72c05-114e-55bb-a880-b4061dd2c65e.name: Construction of Antonio Gaudí’s buildings
23f72c05-114e-55bb-a880-b4061dd2c65e.description: Construction of Antonio Gaudí’s buildings related to Ildefonso Cerdá's Plan and the new urban space in Barcelona. Gaudí is the most important of the architects in the Catalan Modernismo/Modernisme movement, which relates to European movements such as Jungendstil and Art Nouveau. Inspired by nature, the style is mostly developed in architecture but also found in painting and decorative arts.

244bd1b7-cb77-5191-9d8e-f32ff1cdbea6.name: The first private newspaper
244bd1b7-cb77-5191-9d8e-f32ff1cdbea6.description: 3 July: The first newspaper in Ottoman Turkish published by a private individual, *Cerîde-I Havâdis* (Journal of News), begins to appear in İstanbul as a weekly, published by an English journalist, William Churchill.

245dcc81-1d79-587e-a43f-762b1133b4ce.name: Construction of first steamboats
245dcc81-1d79-587e-a43f-762b1133b4ce.description: Construction of the first steamboats. The first steamboat lines in the Mediterranean: Naples shipyards build the steamboat *Ferdinando I* (for the line Naples–Genoa–Marseille); Genoa shipyards build the steamboat *Eridano* (to be used in the Adriatic Sea).

2476a503-db5c-5c24-b19c-5d5859b96b05.name: The right to vote is extended
2476a503-db5c-5c24-b19c-5d5859b96b05.description: The right to vote is extended to all men above the age of 30 (or aged 21 if they completed primary school). The Pope allows Catholics to vote.

24ce7d30-4668-5fcc-96d3-9feef91bc970.name: Opening of the Archaeological Museum of the American University of Beirut
24ce7d30-4668-5fcc-96d3-9feef91bc970.description: Opening of the Archaeological Museum of the American University of Beirut. It is the third oldest museum in the Mashriq, after those in Cairo and Istanbul.

24db202f-9629-5a3d-93a8-0f8c518c8ab5.name: Ministry of Post
24db202f-9629-5a3d-93a8-0f8c518c8ab5.description: 12 October: The Ministry of Post is established.

24dbef7d-a076-5cf7-b112-75f9d0a8561e.name: Mapping of Palestine
24dbef7d-a076-5cf7-b112-75f9d0a8561e.description: Academic interest and geopolitical concerns combine to stimulate the state-of-the-art mapping of Palestine. There is strong interest in the lands of the Bible. In addition, following the opening of the Suez Canal, threats to British routes to India loom from the north, first from Russia and then from the Ottoman Empire and Germany.

24ed5e53-2968-5136-bffb-ec109f9d11f7.name: Creation of the first Romanian political parties
24ed5e53-2968-5136-bffb-ec109f9d11f7.description: Creation of the first Romanian political parties: the Liberal Party (1875), the Conservative Party (1880), the Radical-Democratic Party (1888), and the Social-Democratic Party of Romanian Labourers (1893).

255efa00-8d65-505e-9608-9fadaef21563.name: The Sanayeh Garden
255efa00-8d65-505e-9608-9fadaef21563.description: Khalil Pasha (1864–1923), commander of the Turkish Sixth Army during World War I orders the creation of the Hamidi Public Garden, which later becomes the Sanayeh Garden. It is one of the oldest public open-air spaces in the capital.

257547c5-9af9-5a76-a9e9-b24152811e5f.name: Era of literature Modern literature
257547c5-9af9-5a76-a9e9-b24152811e5f.description: The era of Modern literature (i.e. the works of Hesse, Hauptmann, Mann and Zweig) is characterised by pluralism, the merging of Art Nouveau, Symbolism, Impressionism, etc.

25aee763-fb62-518e-93a0-1cec0b803a2f.name: The railways law
25aee763-fb62-518e-93a0-1cec0b803a2f.description: The railways law, Ley General de Caminos de Hierro (Law of the Iron Roads) establishes principles for the railway and its public and private development. It specifies a rail width that is wider than the European rail. Its continued use still causes problems for rail connections between Spain and France today.

25bd1734-d238-57ab-8a7c-5426da8e2634.name: Lamberto Loria creates an Ethnography Museum in Florence
25bd1734-d238-57ab-8a7c-5426da8e2634.description: Ethnographer Lamberto Loria (1855–1913) creates an Ethnography Museum in Florence.

25c531bb-a556-5014-93f0-b947ead34a2b.name: Verdi composes the so-called popular trilogy
25c531bb-a556-5014-93f0-b947ead34a2b.description: Verdi composes the so-called popular trilogy (*Rigoletto*, *Il trovatore* and *La traviata*), consolidating his fame and reaching full musical and dramatical maturity.

25e0e574-52fe-570b-86eb-f8f06697e3a9.name: The so-called classical trilogy
25e0e574-52fe-570b-86eb-f8f06697e3a9.description: Construction of the so-called classical trilogy – namely the Academy of Athens, the National Library of Greece and the National and Kapodistrian University of Athens – which is designed by the brothers Theophilus and Christian Hansen.

2655e353-3ff2-5f9f-a612-88133867eb8a.name: Osman Hamdi Bey excavates in Lagina
2655e353-3ff2-5f9f-a612-88133867eb8a.description: Osman Hamdi Bey excavates in Lagina.

2670f9fb-9cbf-5780-a2b7-7d2d26993eaa.name: Period of art Impressionism
2670f9fb-9cbf-5780-a2b7-7d2d26993eaa.description: The painting by Max Liebermann, *Die Gänserupferinnen* (1872), exemplifies Impressionism in art at this time.

26da04ee-7f58-53c5-a266-2422fcc19d78.name: Great peace congress was held in Vienna
26da04ee-7f58-53c5-a266-2422fcc19d78.description: The Great Peace Congress is held in Vienna from 18 September 1814 to 9 June 1815. Clemens Wenzel Duke of Metternich organises the Austrian predominance in Italy. Austria exchanges the Austrian Netherlands for the territory of the Venetian Republic and creates the Kingdom of Lombardy-Venetia.

270b35ea-fc43-5bc2-b1d5-f1a5c802aac5.name: Simplon Tunnel
270b35ea-fc43-5bc2-b1d5-f1a5c802aac5.description: Simplon Tunnel between Domodossola (Italy) and Brig (Switzerland) inaugurated. The construction works had started in 1898. At the time, it was the longest tunnel in the world (19.7 km).

271a02e4-9f11-5cb0-b894-ad5a40aab6bf.name: Sanat al-Tabaa
271a02e4-9f11-5cb0-b894-ad5a40aab6bf.description: Sanat al-Tabaa: the year in which a relentless storm hits Qatar and the Gulf region, destroying many of the pearling and fishing fleets and killing more that 8,000 people.

2726498e-8ae6-550a-a8e2-33ec2901ddfe.name: Edification of Muntazah Palace
2726498e-8ae6-550a-a8e2-33ec2901ddfe.description: Muntazah Palace is constructed for Khedive ‘Abbas, which he uses as both a hunting lodge and residence for his companion.

27922346-44a8-58cd-979e-9fd3150b326c.name: Edification of the Mosque of Muhammad Ali
27922346-44a8-58cd-979e-9fd3150b326c.description: The Mosque of Muhammad ‘Ali is built between 1828 and 1848. Perched on the summit of the Citadel, the Ottoman mosque with its animated silhouette and twin minarets, the largest to be built in the first half of the 19th century, is the most visible mosque in Cairo.

27a22f85-618d-5d4a-9f4e-0aeba7773736.name: Creation of Khaldunia
27a22f85-618d-5d4a-9f4e-0aeba7773736.description: Creation of Khaldunia. The purpose of this institution located near the Zaytuna Mosque was to spread scientific knowledge among the Arab communities, and especially among students of Zaytuna University. Its name refers to the great Arab thinker Ibn Khaldun.

27c6f976-8957-56d2-bd6b-35ac9cd65b28.name: Ecole centrale des arts et manufactures
27c6f976-8957-56d2-bd6b-35ac9cd65b28.description: École Centrale des Arts et Manufactures, Paris.

27ceb2e4-98ae-5d32-9fde-fc2046e08cd3.name: Sustained economic growth
27ceb2e4-98ae-5d32-9fde-fc2046e08cd3.description: Sustained economic growth (except for short crises in 1900 and 1907–08); industrialisation makes a leap forward.

27e56737-6470-5b9d-ae36-50d281a632e7.name: Port of Beirut
27e56737-6470-5b9d-ae36-50d281a632e7.description: The foundation, under Wassa Pasha’s rule, of the port of Beirut on the eastern part of the Saint George Bay on Beirut’s northern Mediterranean cost, west of Beirut River. It is one of the largest and busiest ports on the eastern Mediterranean.

285ace5b-a097-5c50-938d-59f06ad60cd4.name: Timişoara is the first European city where electric street lightning is introduced not only on some streets
285ace5b-a097-5c50-938d-59f06ad60cd4.description: 12 October: Timişoara is the first European city where electric street lighting is introduced not only on some streets, but also across the entire city. An electric plant is built and 731 incandescent lamps with coal filament installed, covering an area of 10 km2.

28ab6014-e506-5cf0-aae9-ac0855144018.name: Millerand Law
28ab6014-e506-5cf0-aae9-ac0855144018.description: The law on the working conditions of women and children (Millerand Law) decreases the working day to 11 hours.

28d2e305-a82e-547d-95c3-d1993d036a8c.name: Era of literature Sturm und Drang
28d2e305-a82e-547d-95c3-d1993d036a8c.description: The era of *Sturm und Drang* (Storm and Stress) in literature (i.e. the works of Goethe, Schiller, Hölderlin and Herder) is characterised by lyricism, fantasy, freedom, juvenility and idealism, which is felt most keenly in the dramatic writing of the period.

28eba20e-1b91-590e-a7a0-75aaf9ad01da.name: Verdi composes *Othello*
28eba20e-1b91-590e-a7a0-75aaf9ad01da.description: After long silence, Verdi composes a new opera on a text by Arrigo Boito: *Othello*, based on Shakespeare’s tragedy. In *Othello*, Verdi adopts a more fluent narrative structure that goes beyond the traditional division into separate units (arias, duets, concertatos, choirs).

2901e9f5-1ce6-50a3-9268-75c9badb1b2e.name: An Austrian Maria Theresian Thaler
2901e9f5-1ce6-50a3-9268-75c9badb1b2e.description: The counterstamp of Austrian Maria Theresia Thaler (“MTT”) is seen on silver bullion coins from the Arabian mint in Najd.

291178b8-b556-5703-8315-53ffa5d2ef11.name: Foundation of National Company of Tobacco
291178b8-b556-5703-8315-53ffa5d2ef11.description: Foundation of the National Tobacco Company in Xabregas, Lisbon. Following the 18th-century tendency, the profits of tobacco manufacturing and trade became the major source of revenue for oligarchic businessmen (known as the Caixas) seeking its control. The monopoly was rented out by the state, usually on a triennial base.

29245803-940b-51dc-99a4-13dff2913b48.name: Foundation of the Greek Chamber of Commerce of Alexandria
29245803-940b-51dc-99a4-13dff2913b48.description: The Greek Chamber of Commerce is founded in Alexandria, Egypt, with Emmanouil Benakis as its president.

293afb3e-a556-5c8d-861d-433eab3c3ecd.name: Muhammad Said Pasha and the rebellion against the Second Mexican Empire
293afb3e-a556-5c8d-861d-433eab3c3ecd.description: Muhammad Sa‘id Pasha dispatches part of a Sudanese battalion to help stop a rebellion against the Second Mexican Empire.

2972cc06-457a-51a9-baf7-8508708c034a.name: Josef Ressel equips in Trieste for the first time  the steam ship
2972cc06-457a-51a9-baf7-8508708c034a.description: In Trieste, Josef Ressel equips the steamship *Civetta* with a ship’s propeller for the first time.

298b33d8-c046-5fc6-a571-f1b4ce604f9c.name: Great Arab Revolt
298b33d8-c046-5fc6-a571-f1b4ce604f9c.description: Supported by the UK, on 10 June 1916 Husayn ibn ‘Ali, the Sharif of Mecca, declares the Great Arab Revolt against the Turks with the aim of establishing an independent Arab state under his leadership in Bilad al-Sham (Greater Syria). Aqaba in Jordan is captured in 1917, becoming the headquarters of the northern army headed by Husayn’s son Prince Faysal, who becomes King of Syria in 1920. British promises to Sharif Husayn have contradicted other secret agreements of the UK with its allies, e.g. Sykes–Picot. These mandates put an end to the Arab Kingdom of Syria under King Faysal on 24 July 1920.

298d15ef-96eb-5a24-8a38-05ddd1b6dac1.name: Emergence of a new European-inspired city
298d15ef-96eb-5a24-8a38-05ddd1b6dac1.description: Emergence of a new European-inspired city outside the Arab medina with a multitude of buildings built in the European style.

29a0a883-e78d-55c3-b87a-8866ad3d7b70.name: Italy’s first African war
29a0a883-e78d-55c3-b87a-8866ad3d7b70.description: Italy’s first African war: in 1882 Italy starts colonial expansion in the Horn of Africa; in 1890, Eritrea becomes an Italian colony. Afterwards, Italy attempts to penetrate into Ethiopia and suffers a crushing defeat at Adwa (the biggest African victory over a colonial army): Italy loses 4,000 Italian and 2,000 colonial soldiers. The Crispi government resigns.

29e7100f-db44-5468-a339-aaa5c774b2d5.name: First International Exhibition of Modern Decorative Arts in Turin
29e7100f-db44-5468-a339-aaa5c774b2d5.description: First International Exhibition of Modern Decorative Arts in Turin, featuring the best production of architecture, furniture and applied arts.

2a7b6bbe-2029-5fed-ad45-5c1a57ecc81e.name: The Kingdom of Sardinia participates in the Crimean war
2a7b6bbe-2029-5fed-ad45-5c1a57ecc81e.description: The Kingdom of Sardinia participates in the Crimean war as part of the Anglo-French alliance against Russia.

2a82e38e-cf68-59cf-8aea-4d6b80a7e245.name: Speicherstadt Hamburg
2a82e38e-cf68-59cf-8aea-4d6b80a7e245.description: The warehouse district known as Speicherstadt Hamburg develops.

2a899b68-a709-564d-8389-0ac7d79720dc.name: Auto de Gil Vicente
2a899b68-a709-564d-8389-0ac7d79720dc.description: *Auto de Gil Vicente* written by Almeida Garrett (1799–1854). The plot revives the 16th-century court of King Manuel I where a play by Gil Vicente (founder of Portuguese modern theatre) is performed during the celebrations for the marriage of his daughter Princess Beatriz.

2ab621a1-285d-5faa-b434-1b8228552433.name: Regeneration, led mainly by Minister Fontes Pereira Melo
2ab621a1-285d-5faa-b434-1b8228552433.description: Regeneration, led mainly by Minister Fontes Pereira Melo (who gives the period name – Fontism) is a peaceful political cycle of global innovation started in 1851. The kingdom is tired of political unrest. Conditions are created for the middle classes and foreign investors to support economic expansion, the development of infrastructure and industrialisation.

2b18945a-5d86-5f2b-89e8-02658523ba03.name: Dictionary of Three Languages
2b18945a-5d86-5f2b-89e8-02658523ba03.description: The *Dictionary of Three Languages* by Gjorgji Pulevski (d. 1893) is published in Belgrade. It shows the political context and coexistence of Macedonians, Albanians and Turks in the territory of Macedonia. It gives words in Macedonian, Albanian and Turkish in three columns. Pulevski was also the author of the *Dictionary of Four Languages*.

2b2733bd-d19b-5a9c-8e1a-686ca08b5909.name: Hotel Kadri
2b2733bd-d19b-5a9c-8e1a-686ca08b5909.description: Hotel Kadri is built in Zahlé. In 1914 it is taken over by the Turkish army and used as a military headquarters.

2b2ed3c4-0c02-5af2-9ada-b0bbd50412bf.name: Romania fights in the First World War
2b2ed3c4-0c02-5af2-9ada-b0bbd50412bf.description: After two years of neutrality, Romania fights in the World War I on the side of the Triple Entente. At the end of the war, following the dissolution of the Austro-Hungarian monarchy and of the Russian Empire, the national gatherings of Bessarabia, Transylvania, Banat and Bukovina vote for their union with the Romanian kingdom. Greater Romania is thus created.

2b577c29-5b3f-567d-ab58-550aac88e5ff.name: Lord Curzon visits the Trucial shaikhs
2b577c29-5b3f-567d-ab58-550aac88e5ff.description: British Viceroy and Governor-General of India, Lord Curzon, visits the Trucial sheikhs at Sharjah to reaffirm Britain’s commitment to “guardianship and protection” and the British Government’s position as “your overlords and protectors”. Curzon asserts that continued British control of India depends on maintaining British supremacy in the Gulf.

2b9a07fc-5259-59a3-897b-1f73f087c01e.name: Stimulus by French July Revolution
2b9a07fc-5259-59a3-897b-1f73f087c01e.description: Stimulated by the French July Revolution, the *Vormärz* (pre-March) Revolution refers to the formation of political programmes and factional movements.

2bae9fb7-b0af-51f2-a3c7-7aba828e2284.name: Carol Popp de Szathmari
2bae9fb7-b0af-51f2-a3c7-7aba828e2284.description: Carol Popp de Szathmari, the most important Romanian photographer of the 19th century (born in Cluj, Transylvania), moves to Bucharest, where he opens a photo studio.

2bff19cd-a8db-5a7f-a8f6-0ab4d2463451.name: Otto Wagner built the stations for the Viennese Metro
2bff19cd-a8db-5a7f-a8f6-0ab4d2463451.description: Otto Wagner designs and overseas construction of the Viennese metro, the Wiener Stadtbahn.

2c7d2a85-b967-565e-9c90-6b7cdd0553bf.name: The Great Exhibition of the Works of Industry of All Nations
2c7d2a85-b967-565e-9c90-6b7cdd0553bf.description: At “The Great Exhibition of the Works of Industry of All Nations“ in London, Portugal shows 1,293 products from almost all the regions.

2c93a9e7-ca89-5f23-aed7-2d0dfe713425.name: Izmir Clock Tower
2c93a9e7-ca89-5f23-aed7-2d0dfe713425.description: Izmir Clock Tower is built to commemorate the 25th anniversary of Abdülhamid II’s accession to the throne. It is designed by Levantine French architect Raymond Charles Père.

2d16b3d6-1296-5b21-baca-487bff7754e1.name: Voyage of the frigate *Arapiles* to the Near East
2d16b3d6-1296-5b21-baca-487bff7754e1.description: Voyage of the frigate *Arapiles* to the Near East. The ship was commissioned by the Spanish government to travel to the Near East with Spanish archaeologists and curators to document ancient monuments and buy antiquities. It sailed from Naples to Greece, Istanbul, Rhodes, Cyprus, Lebanon and Egypt and brought back drawings, notes and artworks to be kept in the Museo Arqueológico Nacional of Madrid.

2d225d93-e88c-5abf-8ce2-adc5e930c715.name: Triple Alliance
2d225d93-e88c-5abf-8ce2-adc5e930c715.description: The Triple Alliance formed (Italy, Germany, Austria-Hungary).
