Before construction of the Suez Canal, travellers sailed to Alexandria and continued overland to Suez, picking up a steamer there.

58310e59-46aa-5b4e-bc32-362f0b4fed0a.name: Jamal Pasha
58310e59-46aa-5b4e-bc32-362f0b4fed0a.description: Turkish commander Jamal Pasha initiates a blockade of the entire eastern Mediterranean coast. Lebanon witnesses thousands of deaths from widespread famine and plague.

583874ad-fb8b-5cec-9f29-2142ab10f00b.name: King Fuad I visits Italy
583874ad-fb8b-5cec-9f29-2142ab10f00b.description: King Fuad I of Egypt’s visit to Italy.

5845f393-ba6d-5c40-9ef1-3e6e4b3364fb.name: British impose a peace treaty
5845f393-ba6d-5c40-9ef1-3e6e4b3364fb.description: The British impose a Peace Treaty on the Qawasim and other sheikhs of the Arab littoral of the Gulf. The signing is preceded by a preliminary agreement forcing the sheikhs to turn over all remaining vessels, fortifications and weapons in exchange for the restoration of their fishing and pearling vessels. The Treaty enjoins all signatories to fly a specific red-and-white flag.

586a0e8d-7262-563f-a0c2-100726f50f6c.name: Leisure travels
586a0e8d-7262-563f-a0c2-100726f50f6c.description: Travelling to North Africa, Egypt or the Turkish Empire becomes part of the leisure travels of wealthy families of Spain.

588f15d9-d644-513d-b9bf-aeca23c44bbd.name: Muhammad Ali kills the Mamluks
588f15d9-d644-513d-b9bf-aeca23c44bbd.description: On 1 March, Muhammad ‘Ali invites some 470 Mamluk beys to the Citadel for a feast to celebrate his son’s imminent departure for Mecca. When the feasting is over the Mamluks mount their lavishly decorated horses and are led in procession down the narrow, high-sided defile, below what is now the Police Museum. As they approach Bab al-Azab, the great gates swing closed and gunfire rains down on them from above. After the fusillades, Muhammad ‘Ali’s soldiers wade in with swords and axes to finish the job. Legend relates that only one Mamluk escaped alive, leaping over the wall on his horse.

58e37a19-d974-5e96-a3d1-224f04b4c968.name: Friedrich Gottlob invents paper commodity
58e37a19-d974-5e96-a3d1-224f04b4c968.description: Friedrich Gottlob commodifies paper production (the mass production of cheap paper).

591dbe24-99ed-56eb-b195-73798988607d.name: The Post Museum
591dbe24-99ed-56eb-b195-73798988607d.description: The Post Museum is established in February 1934; it opens to the public in January 1940.

592ec00c-9384-51ec-9937-eace81147978.name: Treaty Britain-Morocco
592ec00c-9384-51ec-9937-eace81147978.description: In 1856 a treaty is signed, initiated by Britain in order to strengthen its influence over Morocco and to maintain its naval supremacy in the Mediterranean, which hugely undermines Moroccan sovereignty. This treaty wrested control over the extent of European penetration away from the governing institution of Morocco the Makhzen. The advantages gained by European traders, combined with their superior technique and the quantity of capital behind them, enabled then to monopolise most of the sea trade and to reduce Moroccan players to mere intermediaries.

59535ffd-671f-5e78-8f21-81f325d7570f.name: Serbia became a Kingdom
59535ffd-671f-5e78-8f21-81f325d7570f.description: The first king of Serbia in the modern age is Milan Obrenović, Prince (1822–82) and King (1882–89). From the start of his independent reign, Knez Milan works to build up the military, and sides with Russia in his foreign policy. He declares war on Turkey in 1876, but it ends in Serbia’s defeat due to poorly prepared diplomatic policy. The signing of the Treaty of San Stefano (made between the two countries after the Russo-Turkish War) is followed by an about-face in Knez Milan’s policy as he turns more and more to Austria-Hungary. A decision by the Congress of Berlin in 1878 grants Serbia independence, while the Secret Convention (between Serbia and Austria-Hungary) binds Austria-Hungary into declaring Serbia a kingdom in 1882.

59a3feae-4a4e-5986-8a1a-db43f2ad485c.name: Al-shami pilgrimage route
59a3feae-4a4e-5986-8a1a-db43f2ad485c.description: Between 1516 and the mid-19th century the main interest of the Ottoman authorities in the territories of modern Jordan was to maintain the *al-shami* pilgrimage route of the holy sanctuaries of Islam in Mecca and Medina. To ensure the safety of the pilgrim caravans good relations were maintained with the local Bedouin tribes. An annual payment was paid by the state (*khuwwa* or *surra*) to their chiefs to facilitate the passage of the pilgrims or simply to leave them alone.

59b636b4-efc3-5f77-8881-c9d2bb97d9f1.name: Santa Justa Lift, an iconic example of iron architecture
59b636b4-efc3-5f77-8881-c9d2bb97d9f1.description: Opening of Santa Justa Lift, an iconic example of iron architecture. Planned since 1874, it was designed to bridge the 25 metre gap in height between Ouro and Carmo streets, thus making pedestrian traffic between Lisbon’s hills easier. The inauguration of the gangway by King Carlos I is held on 10 July.

59bf0b8f-49ec-5110-b7c7-f3c49433af29.name: Foundation of the Romanian Red Cross
59bf0b8f-49ec-5110-b7c7-f3c49433af29.description: Foundation of the Romanian Red Cross.

5aebb03a-5bdd-53a0-9be4-4024941216cf.name: The first Serbian railway and railway bridge
5aebb03a-5bdd-53a0-9be4-4024941216cf.description: The first Serbian railway and railway bridge is built in Belgrade.

5afe3b8b-730a-5293-840c-ab35f6166983.name: The Robert Mouawad Private Museum
5afe3b8b-730a-5293-840c-ab35f6166983.description: A private residence in Beirut’s Zokak el-Blat quarter is turned into the Robert Muawad private museum, presenting precious collection of fine arts and antique pieces.

5b01dc26-ca6d-5090-9182-1f97b10e501d.name: King Wilhelm
5b01dc26-ca6d-5090-9182-1f97b10e501d.description: King Wilhelm I – later Kaiser (Emperor) of the Second Empire – assumes his regency.

5b44b899-a9c0-520e-9d95-8f3e16f12471.name: The Suez Canal is completed
5b44b899-a9c0-520e-9d95-8f3e16f12471.description: With completion of the Suez Canal a number of dignitaries and high-profile personalities arrive in Egypt for the inauguration, including Empress Eugénie of France.

5b5e49bc-662a-51f8-b8c9-61dc1f79ee5c.name: Postal service organised
5b5e49bc-662a-51f8-b8c9-61dc1f79ee5c.description: The First Governor of the new Greek nation, Ioannis Kapodistrias, orders the foundation of the postal service.

5b7283eb-b3e1-5174-a15e-f94b5e8d047c.name: Development of Hamburg
5b7283eb-b3e1-5174-a15e-f94b5e8d047c.description: Up until 1815 Hamburg had been a free city, which began to be developed under the German Confederation. A huge fire in 1842 then called for a huge rebuilding programme that continues up until 1897, with development of the customs examination area in 1888, and the Speicherstadt, the world’s largest warehouse district. In 1892, cholera caused some 8,000 deaths, but by 1900 the population is 1 million. A social housing scheme is implemented in the 1920s.

5b7a41d0-269c-5d02-9ad0-a45c3045a8bb.name: Development of hydroterapy
5b7a41d0-269c-5d02-9ad0-a45c3045a8bb.description: From 1855, the spa towns of eastern France are developed: at Vittel, and at Contrexéville near Plombieres-les-Bains in the Pyrenees, where Napoleon III stays.

5ba2cba1-99dd-5b9d-96e4-b1fe26edc5fc.name: Abbas Mahmud al-Akkad
5ba2cba1-99dd-5b9d-96e4-b1fe26edc5fc.description: Abbas Mahmud al-Akkad writes his only novel *Sarah* in which he relates a personal experience with the only woman he loved. According to al-Akkad’s view women were to be respected and admired, and this appreciation for women is expressed in three books he wrote where he demands the full participation of women in building Egyptian society.

5c14846d-9feb-529f-9328-03a7877d33ec.name: Founding of the National Museum
5c14846d-9feb-529f-9328-03a7877d33ec.description: Serbia’s oldest museum, Museum Serbski, now the National Museum in Belgrade, is founded by the Minister of Education Jovan Sterija Popović.

5c1dac61-3f50-5579-827d-98a5494f193f.name: Commissariato generale per l’emigrazione
5c1dac61-3f50-5579-827d-98a5494f193f.description: Comprehensive law on migration creates the Commissariato generale per l’emigrazione and introduces other measures aimed at ensuring migrants’ welfare, such as medical inspections on boats.

5c4b3b29-08ed-55aa-98ec-012dd13d32a9.name: The British India Company
5c4b3b29-08ed-55aa-98ec-012dd13d32a9.description: The British India Company establishes a regular steamer service in the Arabian Gulf, first as a mail service, and later enhanced by cargo and passenger services.

5c561e04-6086-5b89-b5b8-cae35dc41aa8.name: Woodrow Wilson declares his 14 points
5c561e04-6086-5b89-b5b8-cae35dc41aa8.description: Woodrow Wilson declares his “14 points” program in front of Congress.

5c6e87ed-d174-55b8-90b3-2140abc4ff66.name: First bathing establishment created in Rimini
5c6e87ed-d174-55b8-90b3-2140abc4ff66.description: First bathing establishment created in Rimini.

5cc65d3f-debc-57aa-9b34-78d4fc48acc7.name: The Prussian king Friedrich Wilhelm IV
5cc65d3f-debc-57aa-9b34-78d4fc48acc7.description: The Prussian King Friedrich Wilhelm IV refuses the German Imperial Crown.

5d0914ab-1af9-5e2f-b345-722ab22443c1.name: Garden cities become en vogue
5d0914ab-1af9-5e2f-b345-722ab22443c1.description: Garden cities – planned urbanisation to overcome the housing crises in growing cities –come into vogue. Examples include Margarethenhöhe in Essen, Dresden-Hellerau and Dresden-Briesnitz.

5d09ec49-fac2-51d7-8a29-ca36398aa833.name: Portugal Contemporâneo
5d09ec49-fac2-51d7-8a29-ca36398aa833.description: Publication of *Portugal Contemporâneo*, by Joaquim Pedro de Oliveira Martins (1845–94). Detailed analysis of the events between 1826 and 1868, it is considered the most clear-sighted study of Portugal in the 19th century. The author makes a general criticism of Portuguese liberalism, presented as a historical account.

5d140c71-8308-507d-934a-c4da1ffa73b2.name: Average annual Italian migration (1910-1919)
5d140c71-8308-507d-934a-c4da1ffa73b2.description: Average annual Italian migration (temporary and permanent, to nearest 1,000): France 44,000; USA 157,000; Argentina 32,000; Brazil 13,000.

5d2b3ccb-5a97-5ef9-90a7-205821a87d1e.name: A bridge over the Douro River
5d2b3ccb-5a97-5ef9-90a7-205821a87d1e.description: Ponte Dona Maria Pia, a bridge over the Douro River, completes the Lisbon–Porto railway line. Designed by Gustave Eiffel and Théophile Seyrig, the bridge keeps the beauty of the Douro unchanged. It was built where the banks are closer. It was named after the Queen.

5d6255e5-35bf-53ba-bde0-60190babaef6.name: Clothing regulation
5d6255e5-35bf-53ba-bde0-60190babaef6.description: 3 March: Clothing regulation: the Ottoman state mandates the fez as the common headgear for all Ottoman men.

5da80983-955c-58ea-bc67-cb1246379503.name: Industrialisation process
5da80983-955c-58ea-bc67-cb1246379503.description: Under the framework of liberal Setembrismo, which seeks to fight against corruption and the privileges of the elite, an industrialisation process is promoted and protectionist customs taxes are adopted. One of the main reasons is to reduce the import of English products. The colonisation of African possessions is also developed.

5dd3075d-46bb-5690-a3eb-2d410fcd6884.name: Commune
5dd3075d-46bb-5690-a3eb-2d410fcd6884.description: When the people of Paris refuse to accept defeat and take up arms the Versailles-based government resist and harshly repress the "Commune".

5de1a738-1071-51d9-bc2e-586ec9996e94.name: A Burial At Ornans
5de1a738-1071-51d9-bc2e-586ec9996e94.description: *A Burial At Ornans* by the Realist painter Gustave Courbet.

5ded0fce-6460-5ca1-9001-060f25541638.name: Decimal metric system
5ded0fce-6460-5ca1-9001-060f25541638.description: 13 December: Under the framework of the Regeneration modernisation, the adoption of the decimal metric system based on the legal *mètre* of France is decreed by Queen Maria II. This decree establishes a ten-year deadline for its full enforcement, but the whole process will take longer than that.

5dfc1c7a-8787-5eb5-9cb6-64ff09948d70.name: Alexandru Odobescu sends an Archeological questionnaire to teachers all over the country
5dfc1c7a-8787-5eb5-9cb6-64ff09948d70.description: Alexandru Odobescu sends an archaeological questionnaire to teachers all over the country, who have to return information about archaeological discoveries or vestiges of antique monuments existing in the areas where they live or work.

5e12f1c5-8671-530e-be6f-81f215bfeed4.name: A former Austrian officer
5e12f1c5-8671-530e-be6f-81f215bfeed4.description: Russia recognises Ferdinand of Saxe-Coburg, a former Austrian officer, as the new Prince of Bulgaria.

5e47b845-ad9d-58f1-8863-c9006a806f07.name: The reign of Hammuda Pasha Bey
5e47b845-ad9d-58f1-8863-c9006a806f07.description: The reign of Hammuda Pasha Bey, known as the “Founder” of modern Tunisia. He made possible the renovation of the city walls of Tunis and the restoration of its fortifications, and undertook similar projects in cities such as Bizerte and Le Kef.

5e8334f1-80c2-544a-b749-c6372fcd31de.name: Balkan Wars migration
5e8334f1-80c2-544a-b749-c6372fcd31de.description: Balkan Wars. Large wave of Muslims and Jews flee the Balkans for Ottoman lands to the south. This involuntary migration is estimated to involve 64,000 persons.

5e8e835e-4f3c-50bc-9425-0da7e73b4c35.name: Bankruptcy is declared in Portugal originating a tremendous popular outrage
5e8e835e-4f3c-50bc-9425-0da7e73b4c35.description: 13 June: bankruptcy is declared in Portugal causing tremendous popular outrage. The deficit in the public finances, the dependence on foreign funding and incipient industrialisation are contributing factors to this crisis.

5ea85de4-6ad1-5da8-80e7-e340d86d1aab.name: The Republic is proclaimed in Lisbon on 5 October.
5ea85de4-6ad1-5da8-80e7-e340d86d1aab.description: The Republic is proclaimed in Lisbon on 5 October. King Manuel II is forced to exile in England together with his mother Queen Amelia who ends up in her homeland France. A Provisional Government is set up, headed by Teófilo Braga, a well-known respected jurist and writer. The new cabinet ruled until the first republican Constitution was enacted.

5f23bc1e-e36f-51fd-9a2d-970103c800d1.name: Osman Hamdi Bey in Nemrud
5f23bc1e-e36f-51fd-9a2d-970103c800d1.description: Osman Hamdi Bey, Ottoman administrator and archaeologist excavates in Nemrud. Publication of his book *Le Tumulus de Nemroud-Dagh*.

5f3c3107-0e5b-5b6d-9dc1-ab31694240f4.name: Kuzman Shapkarev
5f3c3107-0e5b-5b6d-9dc1-ab31694240f4.description: The birth in Ohrid of Kuzman Shapkarev (1834–1909), eminent Macedonian folklorist, ethnographer, educator and author of textbooks. Owing to his collecting activities a great deal of Macedonian intangible heritage was spared from oblivion. He was a teacher in Ohrid, Bitola, Prilep and Kukush. Later he worked and lived in Sofia. Although his collections of oral folk literature were published as Bulgarian, most of his works originated from Macedonia.

5f4ca7bd-5c3d-594c-a744-1806e82465a6.name: Second republic
5f4ca7bd-5c3d-594c-a744-1806e82465a6.description: During the Second Republic a number of social reforms take place, including universal male suffrage and the abolition of slavery. In December 1848 Louis-Napoleon Bonaparte (grand-nephew of Napoleon I) takes over as president of the Republic and reverts to a more conservative political position. He sets up an authoritarian regime by coup d'état (December 1851), and declares himself emperor in 1852.

5f5f08be-a1c7-50ee-a64d-2d1ab295bfe9.name: Birth of Mubarak bin Saif al-Nakhi
5f5f08be-a1c7-50ee-a64d-2d1ab295bfe9.description: Birth of the celebrated poet Mubarak bin Saif al-Nakhi in Sharjah.

5f66b3bc-d9d9-530e-b4da-1069dad553c4.name: Renewing and urban modernization of Rome
5f66b3bc-d9d9-530e-b4da-1069dad553c4.description: Renewal and urban modernisation of Rome starts with the opening of a long road linking Porta Pia (where the Italian army broke into the city in 1870) to the Quirinale Palace, residence of the King (formerly a papal palace). The headquarters of some ministries are located along this road.

5f6f1f6c-f07c-5a4f-98e3-65059a681579.name: Foundation of the Museo Arqueológico Nacional in Madrid
5f6f1f6c-f07c-5a4f-98e3-65059a681579.description: Foundation of the Museo Arqueológico Nacional in Madrid following the European movement to create national museums holding the remains of a country's past in tandem with the development of archaeology as a discipline. The museum covers prehistory to modern times, and from its opening in 1871 Spanish Moorish objects are displayed in its Medieval galleries.

5fa1c487-0a04-5200-96b2-3afbdd256676.name: Rossini puts on stage in Paris his last Opera
5fa1c487-0a04-5200-96b2-3afbdd256676.description: Gioachino Rossini puts on stage in Paris his last opera, *Guillaume Tell*, featuring the fight of the Swiss people for freedom from Habsburg domination. He wrote 39 operas, characterised by a style aiming at pure musical beauty (bel canto). Great attention is paid to the sound of the voice and to technical virtuosity, with little emphasis on the different dramatic situations and to the personality of the different characters.

5fa9a00e-02df-55e6-be0e-5fd31bc53847.name: After their return to Lisbon a triumphal reception was offered to Capelo e Ivens by several Portuguese associations.
5fa9a00e-02df-55e6-be0e-5fd31bc53847.description: 20 September: After their return to Lisbon a triumphal reception was offered to Capelo and Ivens by several Portuguese associations. During the solemn session organised by the Sociedade de Geografia de Lisboa (SGL) at the Teatro Real de S. Carlos, following their lectures, the explorers receive the SGL gold medal from King Luís I.

5fffa50a-bb0d-5142-8221-808f5027d8a6.name: Title of khedive for Egyptian governors
5fffa50a-bb0d-5142-8221-808f5027d8a6.description: 8 June: The Egyptian governor receives from the Sublime Porte the title of “khedive,” which provides him legislative independence.

600f4e75-2d1a-5787-8510-e2e101ec2215.name: Telegraphic communication
600f4e75-2d1a-5787-8510-e2e101ec2215.description: 9 September: Telegraphic communication is introduced within the empire.

602a8cee-ec90-5b31-a4c6-715bf6bce9d8.name: First steamboat in the Ottoman Empire
602a8cee-ec90-5b31-a4c6-715bf6bce9d8.description: First steamboat in the Ottoman Empire is launched.

604b3d19-b7e3-5a7e-9b6d-b69b106657d8.name: The Constitution of 1822 is approved by the Cortes
604b3d19-b7e3-5a7e-9b6d-b69b106657d8.description: 1 October: Unavoidable recognition by King João VI of the first liberal Constitution approved by Parliament on 23 September. Inspired by the Spanish Constitution of 1812 and the French ones of 1791, 1793 and 1795, royal prerogatives and the privileges of nobles and clergy are to be limited, though this has only weak impact.

6064a904-43b5-5c03-a1ae-8919ca2276e5.name: Yusuf Bek Butros Karam
6064a904-43b5-5c03-a1ae-8919ca2276e5.description: Yusuf Bek Butros Karam, a Lebanese Maronite born in 1823 fights in the 1860 civil war and leads a rebellion in 1866-67 against the Ottoman Empire’s rule in Mount Lebanon. His proclamations have been interpreted as an early expression of Lebanese nationalism.

60ad5fa6-5b8e-5044-b459-de6d85e818ea.name: Electric telegraph
60ad5fa6-5b8e-5044-b459-de6d85e818ea.description: American John Lawrence Smith, an agricultural chemist and mineralogist in Ottoman employ, demonstrates the electric telegraph invented by Samuel Morse in an elaborate presentation to Sultan Abdülmecid and his officials. The sultan bestows on Morse the prestigious Nishan-ı İftihar (Order of Glory of the Empire), Morse’s first official honour.

60c822bc-fa1e-5001-9d5f-d5b9bb620555.name: Music of this era falls under the label late Romanticism
60c822bc-fa1e-5001-9d5f-d5b9bb620555.description: Surveillance, spying and so on, creates fear and leads to political persecution of musicians (e.g. both Richard Wagner and Gottfried Semper are forced into exile). Music of this era falls under the label “late Romanticism” (i.e. when emotional expression and freedom of style are enhanced), and new genres are born; i.e. symphonic poetry (Franz List) and musical drama (Richard Wagner’s *Tristan and Isolde*, 1865).

6106c00b-0450-5f5b-80a2-1b28bd3200c8.name: Edmund Count Szechenyi oganized the first Turkish Fire Brigade in Istanbul
6106c00b-0450-5f5b-80a2-1b28bd3200c8.description: Edmund Count Széchényi establishes Turkey’s first fire brigade in Istanbul.

6139c385-f32c-5637-b47a-699143b777a1.name: Timişoara is the first city in Romania and the fifth in the world to use horse-drawn trams for public transportation
6139c385-f32c-5637-b47a-699143b777a1.description: Timişoara is the first city in Romania to use horse-drawn trams for public transportation. In Bucharest they are introduced in 1871.

618387ff-39ea-513b-be6e-8f87b9c0c023.name: Second Balkan War
618387ff-39ea-513b-be6e-8f87b9c0c023.description: The Second Balkan War begins due to a quarrel between Serbia and Bulgaria over the division of joint conquests. Bulgaria attacks Serbia and Greece in 1923; the Bulgarians are defeated on both fronts. Subsequently, Turkey and Romania declare war on Bulgaria and the Bulgarians soon request an armistice. The war ends with a Peace Treaty signed in Bucharest in August 1913. During the Balkan Wars, Serbia expands its territory by 39,500 square kilometres.

61a9def0-9d70-5dc8-a568-5b7f270ae2b1.name: Publication of the romance
61a9def0-9d70-5dc8-a568-5b7f270ae2b1.description: Publication of the novel *Amor de Perdição* (*Fatal Love*) by Camilo Castelo-Branco (1825–90). Written very quickly, this romance has everything to be a major work of passion: tragic intensity, speed of action, balance of characters and simplicity of style.

620f6142-edf5-5bcb-9922-665707d69f44.name: Bathing establishment for the middle class
620f6142-edf5-5bcb-9922-665707d69f44.description: The municipality of Cervia (on the Adriatic Sea) builds a bathing establishment explicitly intended for the middle class: previously a prerogative of the elite, beach tourism starts to become a more widely practised activity.

626803b2-7c9b-5e54-a692-543fc22773f9.name: German citizens leave the territory that later becomes the German Bund
626803b2-7c9b-5e54-a692-543fc22773f9.description: An estimated 60,000 German citizens leave the territory that later becomes the German Bund (Federation).

626a7c32-80cf-533f-8281-a14836c6ce93.name: Experiments of radio broadcasts
626a7c32-80cf-533f-8281-a14836c6ce93.description: Gugliemo Marconi makes the first successful experiments of radio broadcasts.

62b71e32-a6a0-55dc-a22c-7279ac86738a.name: Tsar Nicholas II visits France
62b71e32-a6a0-55dc-a22c-7279ac86738a.description: Tsar Nicolas II visits France and inaugurates the Pont Alexandre III bridge in Paris.

62f56046-b6ef-519d-b28d-7700add16e6b.name: Huda Shaarawi
62f56046-b6ef-519d-b28d-7700add16e6b.description: Huda Sha‘rawi becomes the first president of the Egyptian Feminist Union having returned from the International Woman Suffrage Alliance Congress in Rome.

63220074-7517-5c81-9d69-f9e4db5e6a1e.name: British-enforced treaty
63220074-7517-5c81-9d69-f9e4db5e6a1e.description: A British-enforced Treaty is signed to ensure the mutual surrender of fraudulently absconding debtors in the pearling industry. It is signed by the Trucial Sheikhs in the presence of Haji Abdul Rahman, the Residency Agent at Sharjah, and Haji Abdul al-Qasimi, the Residency Munshi who had been deputed from Bushire to convey the directives of the British Resident.

6347e87c-3147-5769-98b0-e955d8c89064.name: French School of Rome
6347e87c-3147-5769-98b0-e955d8c89064.description: Creation of the French School of Rome (excavations at Pompeii and Herculaneum).

638423e1-56c1-5400-bf27-82bdb2c4b5b1.name: Sidi Mohamed Bey of Tunis presented a pair of pistols to Emperor Franz Joseph
638423e1-56c1-5400-bf27-82bdb2c4b5b1.description: Sidi Muhammad Bey of Tunis presents a pair of pistols to Emperor Franz Joseph I of Austria.

63df46f6-f282-5624-b8a6-97d36c1e2a6b.name: Sigmund Freud formulates his own theory of psychoanalysis in Vienna
63df46f6-f282-5624-b8a6-97d36c1e2a6b.description: Sigmund Freud formulates his theory of psychoanalysis in Vienna.

63e6557e-2ecd-5d8c-8936-66e5e1e12bbf.name: The battle of al-Wajba
63e6557e-2ecd-5d8c-8936-66e5e1e12bbf.description: The Battle of al-Wajba is a victory for Sheikh Jassim and Qatar. This represents a decisive moment in the nation's history, asserting Qatar's independence from direct Ottoman interference.

63f18f78-027a-512b-b545-a702d2fdf3b5.name: Turkish fashion with the Crimean War
63f18f78-027a-512b-b545-a702d2fdf3b5.description: The Crimean War brings thousands of British soldiers to Constantinople. After the war, certain innovations can be traced back to it – such as beards! There is a craze for things all things Turkish; the Turkish commander even becomes something of a folk hero in Britain.

64516dd4-35bb-5a24-8f2e-e27cd3e2017e.name: At the International exposition in Paris
64516dd4-35bb-5a24-8f2e-e27cd3e2017e.description: At the International Exposition in Paris, Romania has four pavilions, the central one designed by French architect Jean-Camille Formigé.

64ef7436-3d51-534b-b8b6-57f5647ba530.name: Castel Beranger
64ef7436-3d51-534b-b8b6-57f5647ba530.description: Castel Béranger by Hector Guimard is in the Art Nouveau style.

651e2166-027e-5166-8bd2-8503b179108a.name: History of Cevdet
651e2166-027e-5166-8bd2-8503b179108a.description: Ahmed Cevdet Paşa, historian, jurist and conservative Tanzimat reformer, completes the first volumes of *Târih-I Cevdet* (History of Cevdet), which deals with Ottoman history, 1774–1826.

651e94f5-0f70-5505-ba14-e1290675437d.name: The Austrian Government annexes Bosnia and Herzegovina
651e94f5-0f70-5505-ba14-e1290675437d.description: The Austrian Government proclaims the annexation of Bosnia-Herzegovina and the evacuation of Austrian troops from the Sanjak on 6 October. The Austrian annexation then escalates into a major international crisis, which sees Serbia’s future hope to establish a Yugoslav empire shattered.

654a2977-9950-5731-a830-9fab6a5d5cc3.name: War against Greeks in western Anatolia
654a2977-9950-5731-a830-9fab6a5d5cc3.description: 30 August: Final battle in western Anatolia results in the collapse of the Greek army.

65612c13-f905-500c-80ef-9e0bd6c515a0.name: Carl Eugen, duke of Wittenberg, built three important palaces
65612c13-f905-500c-80ef-9e0bd6c515a0.description: Karl Eugen, Duke of Wittenberg, built three important palaces: one in the centre of Stuttgart, Neues Schloss (1746–1807); Schloss Solitude (1763–9); and Schloss Hohenheim (1772–93).

656b5d4c-4925-52b9-945c-b0f4e8c2031d.name: Sultan Abdülaziz makes state visits to European powers
656b5d4c-4925-52b9-945c-b0f4e8c2031d.description: Sultan Abdülaziz makes state visits to European powers.

65ac637b-f943-5f12-a110-65a88d49cc97.name: Archeological museum of American University of Beirut
65ac637b-f943-5f12-a110-65a88d49cc97.description: Luigi Palma di Cesnola, the American Consul in Cyprus, gives a collection of Cyprian pottery to the Syrian Protestant College (now the American University) in Beirut. This event is the first step towards the foundation of the Archaeological Museum of the American University.

65b10eb0-ef36-520f-b9a5-88a19b6de022.name: Industrialisation in Germany
65b10eb0-ef36-520f-b9a5-88a19b6de022.description: Due to the rise of industrialisation in Germany, in 1862, the Hobrecht-Plan aims to modernise Berlin over the following 50 years.

65c7ef83-b772-5260-85bb-66baf3098f0f.name: Robert Burns
65c7ef83-b772-5260-85bb-66baf3098f0f.description: Scotland’s most famous poet Robert Burns (b. Alloway, Scotland 1759; d. Dumfries, Scotland 1796) is set to immigrate to the West Indies when a collection of his poems, chiefly in the Scottish dialect, is published in the county town of Kilmarnock in 1786. The publication launches Burns’ career.

65f6503a-3b1d-5e44-ba34-de7fbebb7a54.name: The Agricultural Bank
65f6503a-3b1d-5e44-ba34-de7fbebb7a54.description: The Agricultural Bank (Ziraat Bankası) is founded as the first state-funded bank of the empire.

65f6525f-86f2-5aef-a509-4543036f4a61.name: More than half a million pilgrims visit Rome on the occasion of the Catholic Holy Year
65f6525f-86f2-5aef-a509-4543036f4a61.description: More than half a million pilgrims visit Rome on the occasion of the Catholic “Holy Year”. In the Roman Catholic tradition, a Holy Year or Jubilee is a year of forgiveness of sins and reconciliation. Other Holy Years were celebrated in 1875 and in 1900. Rome always attracted Catholic pilgrims, especially during Holy Years.

65f70868-23e6-59fc-8950-dc04a720109a.name: Buildings in the arabisance style
65f70868-23e6-59fc-8950-dc04a720109a.description: Construction of public and private buildings in the arabisance style, which proposes a synthesis of European architectural styles with Arab and Spanish-North African architecture.

66283311-38ae-55c1-9fb3-7a442949d310.name: Austria ceded Lombardy but not Venetia to Napoleon III
66283311-38ae-55c1-9fb3-7a442949d310.description: At the Peace of Zürich (10 November) Austria cedes Lombardy, but not Venetia, to Napoleon III; in turn, Napoleon hands the province over to the Kingdom of Sardinia.

663cee60-d874-532e-97e5-96d56e8527d7.name: Alhambrismo in music
663cee60-d874-532e-97e5-96d56e8527d7.description: “Alhambrismo” in music. From 1890 many composers produce pieces showing the influence of the Alhambra, e.g.Chapi's *Los Gnomos de la Alhambra* (1889), Debussy’s *Lindaraja* (composed in 1901) and *La puerta del vino* (1912–13). The most important piece is the first movement of *Noches en los Jardines de España* (1909–15) by Manuel de Falla, titled "En los Jardines del Generalife".

66dc2298-19d0-543f-847d-1358432b4320.name: The Austrian expressionist writer Georg Trakl committed suicide
66dc2298-19d0-543f-847d-1358432b4320.description: The Austrian expressionist writer Georg Trakl commits suicide following his experiences in battle during World War I.

66e4b586-6534-5829-b9de-b51e67a67839.name: The Salon des Cent
66e4b586-6534-5829-b9de-b51e67a67839.description: The Salon des Cent (Salon of the One Hundred) neither focused on any one school of art nor paid attention to any of the official bodies.

66f3a28a-355e-544b-ba01-cbfe4bb04d9d.name: The War Academy
66f3a28a-355e-544b-ba01-cbfe4bb04d9d.description: 1 July: The War Academy is founded.

672fd0d2-785a-512c-8f61-97375cdda834.name: Peace of Saint-Germain-en-Laye
672fd0d2-785a-512c-8f61-97375cdda834.description: Austria signs the Peace of Saint-Germain-en-Laye with the Entente Powers.

67aa1088-bcfd-5152-9ea4-e583d3e1e99a.name: Foundation of the Wiener Philhamoniker
67aa1088-bcfd-5152-9ea4-e583d3e1e99a.description: The Wiener Philharmoniker is founded. It becomes one of the most famous orchestras in the world.

68780656-24ea-563b-a207-e2dec7dba7a0.name: Opening of the new State Opera House in Vienna
68780656-24ea-563b-a207-e2dec7dba7a0.description: Opening of the new State Opera House in Vienna.

68b29239-0140-504f-b66c-545d6656f2d8.name: International Worker’s Day
68b29239-0140-504f-b66c-545d6656f2d8.description: For the first time, trade unions organise celebrations for May Day as the International Worker’s Day.

68dae8ec-76c0-53c3-86fc-855e45cacc0c.name: First general strike at a national level
68dae8ec-76c0-53c3-86fc-855e45cacc0c.description: First general strike at a national level held as a protest at police violence against workers (in repeated instances, the police had opened fire against workers on strike, killing several of them).

69112068-498b-51bc-8b7e-a79cf6931f9c.name: Giacomo Puccini consolidates his reputation
69112068-498b-51bc-8b7e-a79cf6931f9c.description: Giacomo Puccini consolidates his reputation. He develops a very personal language that is deeply rooted in the Italian melodic tradition, despite his attention to international trends and his choice of exotic subjects (*Madama Butterfly*, *La fanciulla del West*, *Turandot*).

6931f8eb-e6fc-5986-ba4d-8cda339bbdcc.name: The Grand Tour falls out of vogue
6931f8eb-e6fc-5986-ba4d-8cda339bbdcc.description: The “Grand Tour” falls out of vogue; it used to be a period of educational travel, popular among the European aristocrats in the 17th and 18th centuries. Its primary destination was Italy. In the second half of the 19th century, vanguard artists no longer looked at Roman antiquities and Renaissance for inspiration.

69344782-79a8-5543-9548-c02268cf92ff.name: Sociedade Promotora de Belas Artes
69344782-79a8-5543-9548-c02268cf92ff.description: The Sociedade Promotora de Belas Artes (1861) and the Grémio Artístico (1890) created by the Grupo do Leão (1880) merge into the National Society of Fine Arts (SNBA) headed by Malhoa Columbano and António Ramalho. In Porto, the Centro Artístico Portuense (CAP) (founded in 1870) did not survive the death of the painter Silva Porto in 1903.

6993a367-d97b-56a0-b4c6-9ba1470c9215.name: The Treaty of Adrianopole
6993a367-d97b-56a0-b4c6-9ba1470c9215.description: 14 September: the Treaty of Edirne annuls the Ottoman monopoly on Wallachia and Moldavia’s commerce.

69c6e3e5-09d3-588a-83da-b50e66266409.name: The Silesian deputy Hans Kudlich introduced legislation to abolish
69c6e3e5-09d3-588a-83da-b50e66266409.description: Silesian Deputy Hans Kudlich introduces legislation to abolish the enforced servitude of peasants in the Reichstag.

69d5db6e-1e4b-5847-8ea4-d62c8039f7e2.name: Munira al-Mahdiyya
69d5db6e-1e4b-5847-8ea4-d62c8039f7e2.description: Strong cultural pressure at this time puts constraints on female performers. When the singer Munira al-Mahdiyya begins her career, she is the first female Muslim performer to appear onstage.

69d66fbc-5522-5bb7-aabb-b4b2430dd3a0.name: First X-Ray obtained in Portugal by Henrique Teixeira Bastos
69d66fbc-5522-5bb7-aabb-b4b2430dd3a0.description: First X-ray made in Portugal by Henrique Teixeira Bastos, Professor of Physics at Coimbra University. In 1895 Roentgen had discovered X-rays and the news was published in Portugal in the newspaper *Novidades* in January 1896. This first X-ray of the right hand of a boy with bone tuberculosis was made one week after.

69f0739c-fe46-5f2b-8810-b7e9e08126c7.name: Construction of the First Dam
69f0739c-fe46-5f2b-8810-b7e9e08126c7.description: The British begin construction of the first Dam across the Nile in 1898 and work continues to 1902. Opened on 10 December 1902, the Aswan Low Dam is a gravity (masonry) buttress dam on the Nile in Aswan.

6aa5c17d-8e35-57d2-a0c7-8d1b52d3e631.name: Era of literature Naturalism
6aa5c17d-8e35-57d2-a0c7-8d1b52d3e631.description: The era of “Naturalism” in literature (i.e. the works of Hauptmann, Holz and Schlaf) is characterised by a reality without embellishment or subjective insight (the radicalisation of realism).

6abfc0a9-8e84-51e0-90a9-66ba1eba10dc.name: Emperor Wilhelm II visits Tangiers
6abfc0a9-8e84-51e0-90a9-66ba1eba10dc.description: Emperor Wilhelm II visits Tangiers on 3 March 1905, keen to prevent diplomatic isolation of his country and to safeguard Germany’s economic interests.

6acfed1c-6fec-5e62-ab26-d6d9542b4283.name: Slav-Macedonian Scholarly Literary Society
6acfed1c-6fec-5e62-ab26-d6d9542b4283.description: The Slav-Macedonian Scientific Literary Society, also known as the St Petersburg Colony, is established. It plays an important role in the national awakening of Macedonians and raising the issue of the independence of Macedonia within the international community.

6b04af09-19b5-5457-868e-6f71c2bce7af.name: Formation of Turkish National Assembly
6b04af09-19b5-5457-868e-6f71c2bce7af.description: 23 April: Formation of Turkish National Assembly in Ankara.

6b0ce9a4-e140-5aff-90d6-eea679067dcd.name: Birth of İbrahim Çallı
6b0ce9a4-e140-5aff-90d6-eea679067dcd.description: Birth of İbrahim Çallı (d. 1960). He was a prominent painter who was sent to Paris between 1910 and 1914 where he studied in the workshop of Fernand Cormon.

6b501378-2667-5a24-bfeb-003e5853b431.name: Fortuny and Lameyer in North Africa
6b501378-2667-5a24-bfeb-003e5853b431.description: The painters Mariano Fortuny y Marsal and Francisco Lameyer travel to North Africa. Fortuny buys different artworks and textiles for his collection.

6c137ef4-af01-5e88-9a24-e8c7949b9038.name: Wiener Kongress
6c137ef4-af01-5e88-9a24-e8c7949b9038.description: The Wiener Kongress (Congress of Vienna) decides on territorial realignment and the constitutional restoration of Europe.

6c1930cf-088a-5c20-9e5a-8bbd43461b7e.name: Queen Maria II
6c1930cf-088a-5c20-9e5a-8bbd43461b7e.description: Queen Maria II (1819–53) regains the crown after her father’s death and the liberals’ victory. The Queen has to cope with the transition from absolutism to constitutionalism and disputes between opposing factions, conservatives on one side (Cartismo supporters of the 1826 Charter) and radicals on the other (Vintismo defenders of the Constitution of 1822).

6c22e537-f177-5568-b772-db88e49c1b3a.name: Building of the new water supply pipeline from the alps to Vienna
6c22e537-f177-5568-b772-db88e49c1b3a.description: Construction of a new water-supply pipeline from the Alps to Vienna.

6c2f1326-232b-5d18-8f55-d8db8581997e.name: Two Romanians are members of the international jury of the Vienna International Exposition
6c2f1326-232b-5d18-8f55-d8db8581997e.description: Two Romanians are members of the international jury of the Vienna International Exposition: agronomist and economist P.S. Aurelian and doctor Carol Davila.

6c90399e-fd36-52e6-b726-fc34a75f04ca.name: First Napoleonic invasion
6c90399e-fd36-52e6-b726-fc34a75f04ca.description: First Napoleonic invasion. Prince Regent João (1767–1826, crowned in 1816) transfers the court and the seat of political power to Brazil, avoiding being deposed and replaced by a Napoleonic nominee as in other European kingdoms. In Portugal, Beresford, the British governor, intervenes in Portuguese general politics disregarding national needs.

6c9bdf39-a081-5a3d-9d60-0adb9ca3363c.name: Banque Misr was founded
6c9bdf39-a081-5a3d-9d60-0adb9ca3363c.description: Tal‘at Harb Pasha founds Banque Misr.

6cca5be6-d210-57c4-8fdc-8943c89de1f8.name: Local governments in Ajlun, Balqa and Kerak
6cca5be6-d210-57c4-8fdc-8943c89de1f8.description: The people of Transjordan, encouraged by the UK, establish local governments in Ajlun, Balqa and Karak. British advisers are assigned to help these governments.

6d0430be-e12b-542b-ba75-56e586778e2e.name: The British government becomes effectively ruler of the Trucial Coast
6d0430be-e12b-542b-ba75-56e586778e2e.description: The British government effectively becomes the ruler of the Trucial Coast when the sheikhs are forced to pledge that neither they nor their descendants will enter agreements with or grant territorial rights to any government or their representatives other than Britain.

6d539e15-d25c-57d0-9714-8ef44ea4c2e8.name: Italy trying to annex Rome
6d539e15-d25c-57d0-9714-8ef44ea4c2e8.description: Uprising in Rome demanding unification with Italy. At the same time, Garibaldi leads an expedition of volunteers that enters the Papal States and tries to seize Rome. Roman rebels are defeated and executed. Garibaldi is defeated by Papal troops backed by a French expeditionary corps (France protects the Papal States).

6d96e891-ffc5-5169-bf20-38d41cad1dda.name: First Exhibition
6d96e891-ffc5-5169-bf20-38d41cad1dda.description: The first World Fair/Expo (Exposition universelle) of industrial products takes place at the Champs-Elysées, Paris, from 15 May to 15 November. More than five million visitors attend and 25 states and their colonies are represented.

6daae50a-b99b-511d-afe3-0ac78441af43.name: Second Restoration
6daae50a-b99b-511d-afe3-0ac78441af43.description: Second Restoration: the reign of Louis XVIII and his brother Charles X. France experiences an economic boom (i.e. the development of the railways), but discontent grows over the king’s authoritarian policies.

6dd4acbb-77bf-53db-a08d-bed60f5aa5c6.name: Sozialistengesetz
6dd4acbb-77bf-53db-a08d-bed60f5aa5c6.description: The anti-Socialist laws known as *Sozialistengesetz* prohibit socialist organisations, meetings and publications.

6e069b4d-5488-5fe8-985a-f06958a52e4e.name: The General Italian Exhibition in Turin attracts 3 million visitors
6e069b4d-5488-5fe8-985a-f06958a52e4e.description: The General Italian Exhibition in Turin attracts 3 million visitors.

6e082db2-c3da-5a02-a3e4-3139fd85fd7c.name: Street gas lamps
6e082db2-c3da-5a02-a3e4-3139fd85fd7c.description: Imperial decree orders that all civil servants have to light one or two street gas lamps in front of their houses both in summer and winter.

6e0a124d-2266-5184-b900-33030b18a400.name: Alois Alzheimer
6e0a124d-2266-5184-b900-33030b18a400.description: Alois Alzheimer describes a type of dementia, Alzheimer’s, for the first time.

6e157e7a-0b1f-5e6d-9acf-9d6f57a4102e.name: Houses for workers
6e157e7a-0b1f-5e6d-9acf-9d6f57a4102e.description: Construction of workers’ housing includes the utopian city of Familistère de Guise in Aisne (also called the “Social Palace”), set up by Jean-Baptiste André Godin between 1859 and 1870.

6e42aa58-4d87-55a9-b87b-1f075952e460.name: Afonso Costa is appointed Prime Minister
6e42aa58-4d87-55a9-b87b-1f075952e460.description: Afonso Costa is appointed Prime Minister. Republican achievements fall short of people’s expectations, fuelling the resistance of monarchists, capitalists and landlords. Inflation, public debt, trade deficit, strikes, the rise of anarcho-syndicalism, middle-class disillusion, and fear of communism will invite the establishment of the 1915 military dictatorship.

6ea94107-d7c0-5695-86d5-ecc027be2ac3.name: British interest in classical Arabic culture originated in India
6ea94107-d7c0-5695-86d5-ecc027be2ac3.description: British interest in classical Arabic culture including literature sometimes originates in India where the first printed Arabic version of *One Thousand and One Nights* is published.

6ed03cd7-05fd-5b5d-94e8-465dad172921.name: The book On the Macedonian Matters
6ed03cd7-05fd-5b5d-94e8-465dad172921.description: Publication in Sofia of *On Macedonian Matters* by Krste Petkov Misirkov (1874–1926). This book was a starting point in explaining factors about Macedonian people as a distinct nation and laid the foundations of the Macedonian modern language and grammar.

6ed93e06-df35-5cb5-a985-bd1f3ba52932.name: Johann Strauss created
6ed93e06-df35-5cb5-a985-bd1f3ba52932.description: Johann Strauss creates his Wiener Walzer Kapelle, an orchestra specialising in the Viennese Waltz.

6f0b5ad5-ddee-5e73-b5c4-82dd72f61c94.name: Inauguration of the new Catholic cathedral in Tunis
6f0b5ad5-ddee-5e73-b5c4-82dd72f61c94.description: Inauguration of the new Catholic Cathedral in Tunis, designed in the monumental Greco-Roman style, in line with the image France intends to convey in the early days of its protectorate over the regency.

6f1e41ce-836d-50a0-bbcd-c87c41dcca39.name: Law on the unification of currencies
6f1e41ce-836d-50a0-bbcd-c87c41dcca39.description: Law on the unification of currencies passed: the lira becomes the Italian currency.

6f6d5e62-4564-5db7-94c1-076eeb716266.name: Creation of the Carmo Archaeological Museum by the Portuguese Association of Civil Architects
6f6d5e62-4564-5db7-94c1-076eeb716266.description: Creation of the Carmo Archaeological Museum by the Portuguese Association of Civil Architects, which in 1867 adopts the title of Royal Association of Civil Architects and Portuguese Archaeologists. The museum is located in the ruins of medieval Convento do Carmo, destroyed by the 1755 earthquake.

6f73c27b-7bf1-5c6c-9b68-d36e22b18563.name: Weaving wool activity in Sharjah
6f73c27b-7bf1-5c6c-9b68-d36e22b18563.description: British records note that an industry of weaving fine sheep’s-wool *‘aba’* (cloaks) had been developed in Sharjah but, as insufficient quantities were being made to meet local demand, they were also imported from Bahrain and al-Ahsa. Most of the cloth used in the Trucial States at the time was imported from India and elsewhere.

6f7fbdc8-99dc-5893-adfb-e94f1bc885f3.name: Literature during age of Metternich and Junges Deutschland
6f7fbdc8-99dc-5893-adfb-e94f1bc885f3.description: This era, one marked by the politician and statesman Klemens von Metternich, a supporter of restoration politics and conditions prior to the French Revolution, is satirised by the *Junges Deutschland*, a movement in literature (i.e. the works of Büchner, Heine and Grabbe) that is characterised by a rejection of these beliefs in support of a free press and freedom of expression.

6f945400-003a-55f4-b732-d4af19ae593e.name: The Algeciras Conference
6f945400-003a-55f4-b732-d4af19ae593e.description: The Algeciras Conference of 1906 endorses the intervention of Western powers in Morocco, granting special rights to both Spain and France.

6fa0bccb-1a8d-5990-b2af-00f5436e8d59.name: The remains of the poet Luís de Camões and Vasco da Gama were moved to the Jerónimos Monastery
6fa0bccb-1a8d-5990-b2af-00f5436e8d59.description: The remains of the poet Luís de Camões and the explorer Vasco da Gama are moved to the Jerónimos Monastery. Vasco da Gama and Luís de Camões (north and south side respectively), the two main representatives of the 16th-century *The Lusiad*s epic poem, are honored and rest beside members of the Avis dynasty buried in Jerónimos.

6fa4aca4-5820-5c59-ac31-17a2366292bb.name: The Thinker
6fa4aca4-5820-5c59-ac31-17a2366292bb.description: *The Thinker* by the sculptor Auguste Rodin.

6fc91344-be7f-5899-80a2-376561e9bcb8.name: Mass migration
6fc91344-be7f-5899-80a2-376561e9bcb8.description: As a consequence of agricultural crisis, mass migration starts.

6fd67085-3f92-5771-b8e7-163f03f68b33.name: Law on health at work
6fd67085-3f92-5771-b8e7-163f03f68b33.description: The Law on Health and Hygiene at work is passed.

6fd78f6a-2e6a-5434-bf2c-4c3ec48bf9a9.name: Construction of Abdeen Palace
6fd78f6a-2e6a-5434-bf2c-4c3ec48bf9a9.description: Construction of the Abdeen Palace in Cairo begins in 1868 and inauguration takes place some six years later.

6ffb4720-af5c-5918-8c92-27a460c3a900.name: Exposition Universelle et Internationale
6ffb4720-af5c-5918-8c92-27a460c3a900.description: At the Paris “Exposition Universelle et Internationale”, the Portuguese pavilion is called “Portugal and Portuguese Overseas Colonies”. Inside, on the ground floor, are two main exhibitions: one on the works of João Vaz (1859–1931) painter of harbours and fishing scenes, the other on natural forest products such as cork.

701b3c4c-459b-54bc-af7e-fd494ad0988b.name: Romania participates in the Second Balkan war
701b3c4c-459b-54bc-af7e-fd494ad0988b.description: In 1913 Romania participates in the Second Balkan War and under the Treaty of Bucharest receives the south of Dobruja from Bulgaria.

7032ab2d-f09f-5f79-a61a-4b59e3c78966.name: The peace treaty of Adrianopole
7032ab2d-f09f-5f79-a61a-4b59e3c78966.description: The peace Treaty of Edirne institutes the Russian protectorate over Moldavia and Wallachia, which lasts until 1856. The Romanian countries remain under Russian occupation until 1834. Under the supervision of the Russian authorities in 1830–31 the Organic Regulations, considered to be the first Romanian constitutions, are drawn up and adopted.

704a5ccf-9005-50bf-b021-94fe3a19c836.name: The poem *Hymn to Liberty* National Athem of Greece
704a5ccf-9005-50bf-b021-94fe3a19c836.description: The poem *Hymn to Liberty* by Dionysios Solomos becomes the Greek National Anthem with music composed by Nikolaos Mantzaros.

704bad92-6b5f-5962-a131-d14fc3d883b7.name: The Italian composer, Verdi, was commissioned by the Egyptian Khedive to compose the opera Aida
704bad92-6b5f-5962-a131-d14fc3d883b7.description: The Italian composer Verdi is commissioned by the Egyptian Khedive to compose the opera *Aida* for celebrations to mark the opening of the Suez Canal. Later Verdi is also commissioned to compose the Egyptian National Anthem.

7053c28d-72a6-5da6-994a-84569ea89571.name: Construction of Gezira Bridge
7053c28d-72a6-5da6-994a-84569ea89571.description: Jezira Bridge is constructed in 1871 and opens to traffic in 1877. The intention is to link the districts of Dokki and Bulaq al-Dakrur with Zamalek. Construction requires redirection of the Nile bed.

7071890f-2726-5807-ac9f-372a7b4a1491.name: Germany declares war to Portugal
7071890f-2726-5807-ac9f-372a7b4a1491.description: Germany declares war on Portugal. Portugal enters World War I, complying with international commitments in Europe and defending the Portuguese strategic possessions in Africa, mainly Angola and Mozambique. The Portuguese army fought on the western European Front and in the south of Angola (border with Namibia) and the north of Mozambique (Nevala).

70727e57-5c25-5de6-a3d8-daa34cd7d5b9.name: The establishment of the Nobel Prize
70727e57-5c25-5de6-a3d8-daa34cd7d5b9.description: The establishment of the beneficence “Nobel Prize” by Alfred Nobel.

7090f93b-0f04-5337-860b-b03fed8afff0.name: Era of literature Expressionism
7090f93b-0f04-5337-860b-b03fed8afff0.description: The era of Expressionism in literature (i.e. the works of Benn, Kafka, Lasker-Schüler, Mann and Döblin) is influenced by the human experience of World War I and other influences such as Darwinism, Friedrich Nietzsche’s “despair of civilisation” and Freud’s Psychoanalytic theory.

70be0e76-4551-58e2-a3cc-a30ce4cf06fe.name: The British destroy Al Qawasim hegemony
70be0e76-4551-58e2-a3cc-a30ce4cf06fe.description: The British put a stop to Qawasim hegemony in the Lower Gulf region by destroying their ports, strongholds, and fleets on both shores of the Arab Gulf.

710b2604-7aab-59f3-bc07-51c7ad167822.name: Rafael Contreras begins to make models from the Alhambra
710b2604-7aab-59f3-bc07-51c7ad167822.description: Rafael Contreras begins to make models from the Alhambra that are shown in international exhibitions and acquired by many museums and schools of design. The models are used as examples of wall decoration in the Alhambresque style.

712fdf38-81cf-59a8-9af4-136c4e171043.name: Cholera epidemic
712fdf38-81cf-59a8-9af4-136c4e171043.description: Cholera epidemic causes 7,000 deaths in Naples and 2,500 in Palermo (out of a total 21,000 deaths). The government starts programmes of urban renewal in Naples and other towns (the most effective tool to prevent new epidemics).

71711107-8d8f-521b-a665-ad7ff21e9deb.name: The Great Industrial Exposition
71711107-8d8f-521b-a665-ad7ff21e9deb.description: The Great Industrial Exposition is held at the Lehrter Bahnhof in Berlin, where one of main attractions is the first electric locomotive from Siemens & Halske.

71974b2e-4adf-51d8-8597-e04be4444a5b.name: The English Admiral Edward Pellow
71974b2e-4adf-51d8-8597-e04be4444a5b.description: The English Admiral Edward Pellow, 1st Viscount Exmouth imposes on the regencies of Algiers, Tunis and Tripoli new recommendations to slow the race at sea. He inaugurates the so-called Gunboat diplomacy, which involves the threat of military force.

71cfb4b3-30b0-5b27-b72f-13fbbc67f236.name: Abolition of slave trade
71cfb4b3-30b0-5b27-b72f-13fbbc67f236.description: Slave trade (*trata de negros*) abolished by the Spanish Parliament at Cádiz. Following the influence of the French Revolution the anti-slavery movement grew in Europe. In 1837 slavery was abolished in Spain but not in the colonies. The government later freed the slaves of Puerto Rico (1873) and Cuba (1878).

72048ead-8c65-5cac-9ef1-b76901da64ae.name: The Restitution of Obrenovic Dynasty
72048ead-8c65-5cac-9ef1-b76901da64ae.description: The *Hatišerif* (Turkish edict) is issued in 1838, allowing the *Sovjet* (Council) to limit the powers of Prince Miloš Obrenović. Unwilling to accept this however, Miloš abdicates and leaves Serbia in 1839. Prince Mihailo Obrenović reigns for a short time before the Karađorđević Dynasty regains the Serbian throne in 1842. The 1858 *Svetoandrejska skupština* (Assembly convened on St Andrew’s Day) decides on a change of dynasty, overthrowing Prince Aleksandar Karađorđević and reinstating Miloš Obrenović. A 37-strong deputation from the Assembly, with a massive, heavily armed entourage, leaves Belgrade for Bucharest to bring the newly elected prince back to the country, marking the beginning of Miloš’ second, but short-lived reign, which ends when he dies in 1860.

722693e4-ebaa-5bf2-9bb0-074a103a4200.name: Formation of the Neues Museum
722693e4-ebaa-5bf2-9bb0-074a103a4200.description: Formation of the Neues Museum (1843–55), built by Friedrich August Stüler, a follower of K. F. Schinkel. Stüler and Carl Busse then design the Alte Nationalgalerie (1867–76).

722f8524-3b9a-5d34-a262-76fc3e942501.name: Fiftieth anniversary of the Italian Unification
722f8524-3b9a-5d34-a262-76fc3e942501.description: To celebrate the fiftieth anniversary of Italian unification, international exhibitions are organized in Rome, Florence and Turin.

7286e801-c45a-5b95-8e84-564a84d56928.name: Rural migration to Paris
7286e801-c45a-5b95-8e84-564a84d56928.description: Massive rural exodus to Paris, in particular farmers from the Auvergne region.

72f65531-b8b0-59a3-a8d7-1aac9d33503d.name: Novemberrevolution
72f65531-b8b0-59a3-a8d7-1aac9d33503d.description: The so-called November Revolution results in the withdrawal of Emperor Wilhelm II; the Council of People’s Deputies (SPD and USPD members) take over government.

73062766-2590-53f2-a399-a71806b8ce49.name: Inauguration of the National Gallery of Modern Art in Rome
73062766-2590-53f2-a399-a71806b8ce49.description: Inauguration of the National Gallery of Modern Art in Rome, in the Exhibition Palace by Pio Piacentini. It is intended to focus on “national” art.

731d2825-34dc-5c1b-ad80-cce07481cbfe.name: Austria and France concluded the peace of Campo Formio
731d2825-34dc-5c1b-ad80-cce07481cbfe.description: Austria and France conclude the Treaty of Campo Formio on 17 October. Austria then cedes to Belgium and Lombardy. To compensate, it gains the eastern part of the Venetian Republic up to the Adige, including Venice, Istria and Dalmatia.

733d01a3-105b-5064-8341-c319999da1ff.name: Museum of Celtic and Gallo-Roman Antiquities
733d01a3-105b-5064-8341-c319999da1ff.description: Creation of the Museum of Celtic and Gallo-Roman Antiquities by Napoleon III in Saint-Germain-en-Laye.

73577528-b383-5d4e-9249-7b67217c0f69.name: Sultan Mehmed V
73577528-b383-5d4e-9249-7b67217c0f69.description: 27 April: Unseating of Sultan Abdülhamid II and accession of Sultan Mehmed V.

73881fe2-cb68-5d5d-9bea-cbdd445f103c.name: Ausstellung von Meisterwerken Muhammedanischer Kunst in Munich
73881fe2-cb68-5d5d-9bea-cbdd445f103c.description: A groundbreaking exhibition on Islamic art opens in Munich, “Ausstellung von Meisterwerken Muhammedanischer Kunst”.

73894d38-608c-52d0-a6b7-048282a78bb2.name: Battle of Isly
73894d38-608c-52d0-a6b7-048282a78bb2.description: The Battle of Isly is fought on 14 August 1844 between the Moroccan army employing an archaic strategy against professional soldiers trained in the Napoleonic campaigns and armed with batteries of light guns. The battle ended with the defeat of the Moroccans. The consequences of this defeat were grave for Morocco. It was the first time the country had lost a battle in more than two centuries, and it showed Mulay ‘Abd al-Rahman just how weak his army was.

73d5ad42-1356-5263-8b4f-ded315f855f4.name: Alexandria Sporting Club
73d5ad42-1356-5263-8b4f-ded315f855f4.description: The Alexandria Sporting Club is built; it is one of the oldest clubs in Egypt.

747b8d2e-cf80-5853-b99c-d7b9a2170dfe.name: A governmental survey reveals the existence of 443 friendly societies
747b8d2e-cf80-5853-b99c-d7b9a2170dfe.description: A governmental survey reveals the existence of 443 friendly societies (Società di mutuo soccorso), all located in Central and Northern Italy (Milan has 38 societies with a total of 9,923 members, Turin 13 with 14,864 members). Their number and membership grows considerably over time until the development of modern welfare.

7483a87c-61fa-5112-9005-df923ff060f7.name: Steamer service in the Gulf
7483a87c-61fa-5112-9005-df923ff060f7.description: The German Hamburg–America Line offers a steamer service between Europe and the Gulf.

74a13175-31ff-5506-bdad-c194b76dee86.name: Asia Minor Catastrophe
74a13175-31ff-5506-bdad-c194b76dee86.description: Following the “Asia Minor catastrophe”, almost 1.5 million Greek nationals arrive as refugees at Greece’s coastal regions, for example at Pontus, having been uprooted from their homes in Asia Minor (Anatolia).

74c3750b-3776-57ae-86cc-6d2f9070fac5.name: La Sylphide, by F. Taglioni
74c3750b-3776-57ae-86cc-6d2f9070fac5.description: *La Sylphide* is a Romantic ballet by Fillippo Taglioni in which his daughter, Marie, danced *en pointe* in the title role.

74fe7cf6-79ec-5ebc-bad7-fa7f3974ab87.name: Free primary school
74fe7cf6-79ec-5ebc-bad7-fa7f3974ab87.description: The (Jules) Ferry Law establishes free, compulsory and secular primary education for all French children.

751acb8a-a175-575c-bac1-303c93111d8e.name: The British occupation of Egypt
751acb8a-a175-575c-bac1-303c93111d8e.description: With the British occupation of Egypt comes growth in European-imported ideas and fashions. Egypt becomes a significant tourist destination for wealthier Europeans. English and French –especially French – become commonly used languages.

7549a3c9-0d34-5d66-9a43-57847324067b.name: Bank of Italy
7549a3c9-0d34-5d66-9a43-57847324067b.description: A comprehensive law on banking establishes the Bank of Italy, which starts operating on 1 January 1894.

7560c725-f1f9-5ae3-b2fa-1cd004f0e19e.name: Founding of first Serbian journal *Novine serbske*
7560c725-f1f9-5ae3-b2fa-1cd004f0e19e.description: In Vienna in 1813 Dimitrije Davidović, politician, diplomat, author of the Candlemas Constitution and one of the founders of journalism in Serbia, launches *Novine Serbske*, Serbia’s first daily newspaper. The newspapers are printed in Serbia for the first time in 1834.

75cb987d-c61d-595c-9dba-c3b445713c91.name: Crisis of the First Republic
75cb987d-c61d-595c-9dba-c3b445713c91.description: Crisis of the First Republic (1914–26). Lack of political stability due to the absence of parliamentary majorities able to undertake much-needed reforms, together with the political consequences of Portugal’s participation in World War I from 1916, contributes to the deterioration of the economic situation, hastening the fall of the Republican regime.

75ea8147-54e7-5866-ba9e-de354887a88e.name: War declared on Morocco
75ea8147-54e7-5866-ba9e-de354887a88e.description: War declared on Morocco. Battles of Castillejos (Fnidq) and Wad-Ras. A peace agreement is signed with the Moroccan Sultan leaving Tetouan under Spanish rule.

760e6fbc-520c-5eff-8473-f2db18370dfc.name: José Viana da Motta
760e6fbc-520c-5eff-8473-f2db18370dfc.description: The birth of José Viana da Motta (d. 1948). Pianist, composer, conductor and pedagogue, he studied piano and composition in Berlin and performed in concerts around the world. He was professor of Piano at the Conservatory of Geneva and Director of the Conservatório Nacional de Lisboa, maintaining his concert career alongside teaching.

76167038-67f2-5180-bd4a-fdb94c5d893c.name: Labour Code
76167038-67f2-5180-bd4a-fdb94c5d893c.description: On 28 December, the Act establishing the Labour Code is passed.

7637c289-671a-55af-914e-9e5bde830847.name: Spain focuses on North Africa in the framework of the colonial interests of other European powers
7637c289-671a-55af-914e-9e5bde830847.description: After the loss of its last colonies, Cuba, Puerto Rico and the Philippines, Spain focuses on North Africa in the framework of the colonial interests of other European powers such as France, the UK and Germany. After different international talks and agreements – Spanish–French Agreement (1904), Algeciras Conference (1906), Cartagena Declarations (1907) – Spain and France sign in November 1912 the Treaty establishing the French and Spanish Protectorates in Morocco.

7642cc53-806b-5a3e-b148-21619ca230ff.name: CGL is founded
7642cc53-806b-5a3e-b148-21619ca230ff.description: The Confederazione Generale del Lavoro (CGL – national confederation of trade unions) is founded. Argentina Altobelli becomes Secretary General of the Farm Workers Union (the first woman to become national union leader).

76609b15-5020-5967-af97-3b932345378f.name: Top hats begin to be worn in the United Principalities
76609b15-5020-5967-af97-3b932345378f.description: Top hats begin to be worn in the United Principalities, where they were called *joben*, from the name of Jobin, the French merchant who first sold them in Bucharest.

76612ecb-7de2-5f19-898c-9a0345125993.name: San Remo Conference
76612ecb-7de2-5f19-898c-9a0345125993.description: France takes control over Lebanese territory after the San Remo Conference.

769ded06-955c-5a7c-a2d2-abe45ba6d499.name: Gaston Maspero
769ded06-955c-5a7c-a2d2-abe45ba6d499.description: Excavations of French Egyptologist Gaston Maspero (1846–1916) in Egypt.

76cf902a-1193-599d-aede-2794482c58be.name: Edirne retaken
76cf902a-1193-599d-aede-2794482c58be.description: 23 July: Edirne retaken by the Ottoman Army under the command of Enver Paşa.

76e01fa6-f7d0-5253-8859-c7014c752224.name: Resistance to French occupation
76e01fa6-f7d0-5253-8859-c7014c752224.description: Tunisians put up stiff resistance to French occupation without any external support. The Sublime Porte, itself threatened by the Western powers, limits the show of protest against the French occupation.

7701e442-0e45-5fd5-8b4e-0a3510f9bc24.name: Giorgio De Chirico’s first metaphysical paintings
7701e442-0e45-5fd5-8b4e-0a3510f9bc24.description: Giorgio de Chirico’s first metaphysical paintings (*L’enigma dell’ora*, 1912; *Le muse inquietanti*, 1916; *Ettore e Andromaca*, 1917; *Il Grande Metafisico*, 1917).

777339f6-df77-5622-83c1-4bd508d41761.name: Sultan bin Saqr I
777339f6-df77-5622-83c1-4bd508d41761.description: Sharjah becomes the main seat of the ruling Sheikh, Sultan bin Saqr al-Qasimi I, and the centre of the government of the Sharjah Emirate.

7775ae73-0164-5411-84ca-fb0a6ada7c1f.name: Introduction of universal male suffrage and of an electoral system of proportional representation
7775ae73-0164-5411-84ca-fb0a6ada7c1f.description: Introduction of universal male suffrage and of an electoral system of proportional representation. The Popular Party (antecedent to the Christian Democrats) is founded. Mussolini creates the first Fascio di combattimento (embryo of the Fascist Party).

77ab6cc2-743f-567e-9af4-1b1e88e9e447.name: Inauguration of the first Portuguese railway between Lisbon and Carregado
77ab6cc2-743f-567e-9af4-1b1e88e9e447.description: Inauguration of the first Portuguese railway between Lisbon and Carregado, 36,454 km north of Lisbon, by King Pedro V and innumerable guests, transported in 14 wooden carriages pulled by two locomotives. The first train trip lasts 40 minutes. A steam engine is adapted to move the locomotives.

7820633e-271d-5957-b49f-d749c58fb11f.name: Archaeological expedition to Egypt
7820633e-271d-5957-b49f-d749c58fb11f.description: The Grand Duke of Tuscany Leopold II and Charles X of France finance the archaeological expedition to Egypt headed by Ippolito Rossellini and Jean-Francois Champollion.

78345b74-beb3-5dfa-a7d7-7fb9ed03bcb0.name: Khan Antun Bey Square evolves
78345b74-beb3-5dfa-a7d7-7fb9ed03bcb0.description: Khan Antun Bey Square evolves after the construction of the great Ottoman jetty and quays from 1890 that changes the design of the urban area.

7866aee2-15a3-5407-a06d-d0b5a4f48d9a.name: Sheikh Abdullah bin Jassim Ruler of Qatar
7866aee2-15a3-5407-a06d-d0b5a4f48d9a.description: Treaty with the UK. This recognises Sheikh Abdullah bin Jassim as the ruler of Qatar, and places the sheikhdom under British maritime protection.

78c161ce-851d-536d-8804-d1d905afdff6.name: Construction of the new Synagogue in Rome
78c161ce-851d-536d-8804-d1d905afdff6.description: Construction of the new Synagogue in Rome (architects: Vincenzo Costa and Osvaldo Armanni), an imposing building of eclectic style, with decorative elements inspired by Assyro-Babylonian architecture.

797a2cba-06d1-5dc9-8479-ff5914b1a90b.name: Pedro as Regent returns to Portugal to defend his daughter’s rights
797a2cba-06d1-5dc9-8479-ff5914b1a90b.description: Civil war. Pedro returns to Portugal as Regent to defend his daughter’s rights. He launches military operations from Azores and Porto against the absolutist faction of Prince Miguel favored by the Quadruple Alliance. After the Miguelists’ defeat, peace terms depend on the Évora-Monte Convention and Prince Miguel’s exile.

7986496d-f340-503e-897c-9134459abad3.name: Most parts of Arabia become a part of the new state
7986496d-f340-503e-897c-9134459abad3.description: Most parts of Arabia become part of the new Saudi State. In 1803, The two holy cities of Mecca (Makkah) and Medina (Madinah), along with the rest of the Hijaz region, join the Saudi State.

7a01b30f-564f-5a01-ae6e-9b4cb5e36612.name: Michael Latos was born in Croatia
7a01b30f-564f-5a01-ae6e-9b4cb5e36612.description: Michael Latos is born in Croatia (Austrian Empire) in 1828. He later deserts the Austrian army and flees to the Ottoman Empire, where he makes a military career as Omar Pasha and becomes Minister of War in 1868.

7a1b4652-23c3-5efa-9116-45e57f95138f.name: Suffrage established for men aged 25 years and above
7a1b4652-23c3-5efa-9116-45e57f95138f.description: Suffrage established for men aged 25 years and above. Although the 1812 Constitution had theoretically established “universal” suffrage for men, during most of the 19th century it had been limited to men above a certain economic level. It was not until 1931, under the Second Republic, that the suffrage became truly universal, including women.

7a2368f8-11c4-5baf-9be4-0709de638f7f.name: Edict by Cardinal Bartolomeo Pacca dictating a comprehensive set of measures for the protection of cultural heritage in the Papal States
7a2368f8-11c4-5baf-9be4-0709de638f7f.description: Edict by Cardinal Bartolomeo Pacca (1756–1844) dictating a comprehensive set of measures for the protection of cultural heritage in the Papal States: it is the first comprehensive law on the protection of cultural heritage issued in Italy and it will become a model for the other Italian states.

7a48cda3-67f4-58ad-86cf-f318a463500d.name: School of Languages
7a48cda3-67f4-58ad-86cf-f318a463500d.description: Rifa’a al-Rafi’ al-Tahtawi founds the School of Languages to educate and train professional interpreters and translators.

7a553fc3-2194-523c-ab34-bb025546f8fe.name: The IX International Congress of Anthropology and Prehistoric Archaeology
7a553fc3-2194-523c-ab34-bb025546f8fe.description: The 11th International Congress of Anthropology and Prehistoric Archaeology is held in Lisbon. This important conference gives international recognition to the dynamism that Portuguese archaeology has demonstrated since 1850.

7a646070-4f51-53ee-a347-81ab80dd7b70.name: Dawud Pasha
7a646070-4f51-53ee-a347-81ab80dd7b70.description: Dawud Pasha (the *mutasarrif* \[governor\] of Lebanon, appointed by the Ottomans) restores to Lebanon a part of its lost territory, establishes for the Druze a school in Abayh that still bears his name and struggles against the feudal lords in the south and the clerical party in the north.

7a77081e-dc50-5afc-ae5d-ed507acd1850.name: the young King Alexander of Serbia murdered
7a77081e-dc50-5afc-ae5d-ed507acd1850.description: The young King Alexander of Serbia is brutally murdered in an officers’ conspiracy in June. The replacement of the pro-Austrian Obrenović Dynasty by the pro-Russian House of Karađorđević under Peter I, changes the balance of power in the Balkans.

7aaaaad6-b81d-58de-882f-e0c832d17ef6.name: Ahmad Bey in France
7aaaaad6-b81d-58de-882f-e0c832d17ef6.description: Ahmad Pasha Bey is received by King Louis Philippe at the Tuileries Palace. He stays at the Élysée Palace. He visits the parliament, the Hôtel des invalids, Napoleon’s tomb and the Palace of Versailles.

7abe2b5b-33b9-5dca-b5b0-5d8effa36b37.name: Establishment of an insurance company for sea transportation
7abe2b5b-33b9-5dca-b5b0-5d8effa36b37.description: An insurance company for sea transportation is founded on the island of Chios.

7b01ee1e-38d7-545d-a1d0-c48ccc6f23b9.name: The revolution in July
7b01ee1e-38d7-545d-a1d0-c48ccc6f23b9.description: The French July Revolution strengthens the power of the *Besitzbürgertum* (the landed gentry). Revolutions in central and north Germany enforce constitutional state reforms.

7b4b9e1c-fa6a-58c2-89c0-26e0dcea8c29.name: British Ultimatum
7b4b9e1c-fa6a-58c2-89c0-26e0dcea8c29.description: The British Ultimatum (11 January 1890) pressures Portugal to withdraw from southern Africa resulting in popular outrage and unrest. The bankruptcy of 1892, anti-monarchic sentiment against King Carlos I, the cost of living and unfulfilled popular needs are major drivers of the Republican movement.

7b64abfb-e68f-5439-95af-c7ac30a24ad3.name: Embassy sent by Siam
7b64abfb-e68f-5439-95af-c7ac30a24ad3.description: Embassy sent by King Mongkut of Siam (now Thailand) to Napoleon III.

7b8e43a5-4d66-5adc-a8b1-d1a35d55480f.name: Swiss engineers Carl Culmann
7b8e43a5-4d66-5adc-a8b1-d1a35d55480f.description: Swiss engineers Carl Culmann and Arnold Burkly-Ziegler are contracted to develop a water supply network for Bucharest.

7bdc11bd-0506-5fb4-8591-e9c1587220c0.name: Sykes-Picot Treaty
7bdc11bd-0506-5fb4-8591-e9c1587220c0.description: Sykes–Picot Agreement signed by the British, French and Russian governments on 16 May 1916 concerning the division of Ottoman lands in Greater Syria between the two colonial powers, the UK and France. According to this secret treaty southern Syria (Palestine and Jordan) and Iraq are to fall under British mandate and Syria and Lebanon under the French.

7bf6d490-d456-59ff-90b6-cbd66afa2bf1.name: Treaty of the Protectorate
7bf6d490-d456-59ff-90b6-cbd66afa2bf1.description: At the metropolitan palace, Muhammad Sadiq Bey signs the treaty imposed by the French Protectorate known as the Treaty of Bardo (or Treaty of Kasser al-Sa‘id). This is followed by the Convention of Marsa in 1883. The Regency of Tunis passes from Ottoman suzerainty to French domination.

7c09389d-e946-5db3-8b7b-8cbcee844e5b.name: First Serbian railway and railway bridge
7c09389d-e946-5db3-8b7b-8cbcee844e5b.description: The first Serbian railway and railway bridge is built in Belgrade.

7c71bdaf-c826-5929-8315-5bb5276df62e.name: Umberto Boccioni realized the sculpture Unique Forms of Continuity in Space
7c71bdaf-c826-5929-8315-5bb5276df62e.description: Umberto Boccioni made the sculpture *Unique Forms of Continuity in Space*, considered a masterpiece of Italian Futurism.

7c937d26-6b48-5e39-9f91-b729c903b5cb.name: Voz do Operário
7c937d26-6b48-5e39-9f91-b729c903b5cb.description: 11 October: The labour association Voz do Operário is founded in Lisbon by Custódio Gomes and Custódio Braz Pacheco, two factory workers in the tobacco industry, to defend the rights of the workers more disrespected and threatened than ever by the tobacco industry crisis of 1879.

7ca9f489-64fb-5adf-a55f-fa9754ac5af6.name: Reign of Muhammad Ibn ‘Abd al-Rahman
7ca9f489-64fb-5adf-a55f-fa9754ac5af6.description: Reign of Muhammad Ibn ‘Abd al-Rahman: with a view to overhauling the machinery of administration, Muhammad IV creates an administrative school, the Madrasa Makhzenia, and proceeds to modernise financial and tax services. He also thought about modernising the army, both in terms of soldier training and equipment. This was eventually achieved by his son Mulay al-Hasan I.

7cb9840e-a7bd-5441-95a2-7059f5032563.name: Inauguration of the National Museum of Palazzo Venezia
7cb9840e-a7bd-5441-95a2-7059f5032563.description: Inauguration of the National Museum of Palazzo Venezia, in the 15th-century palace that used to house the Embassy of the Republic of Venice in Rome. The museum progressively focuses on applied arts: ceramics, furniture, silverware, jewellery, arms and armours, carpets and a variety of other items dating from the Middle Ages to modern times.

7d74e5db-b083-5f4e-b18e-90c5b19b47be.name: Pearling
7d74e5db-b083-5f4e-b18e-90c5b19b47be.description: Around 1914, 80 per cent of the Trucial Coast’s labour force is involved in the wider pearling sector, including 950 major pearl merchants, 1,300 pearling ship-owners and some 21,000 general employees. The remainder are employed in agriculture, fisheries and other forms of commerce. Gulf pearling exports amount to 2 million pounds sterling.

7d87c64e-9a01-53b5-95f3-65164b3091a0.name: Promulgation of the Mining Law
7d87c64e-9a01-53b5-95f3-65164b3091a0.description: Promulgation of the Mining Law, which stipulates separation between the ownership of land and of the subsoil resources, which, except for oil, belong to the state. Concessions of oil exploitation by the state (in cases where the owner of the land did not want to do it) are regulated.

7e99d51f-295e-501d-a319-3dcc9c002541.name: Zog I, King of the Albanians, and most of his family left England
7e99d51f-295e-501d-a319-3dcc9c002541.description: Zog I, King of the Albanians, and most of his family, leave England and settle in Egypt at the behest of King Faruq.

7eb302aa-f081-538b-a781-b0bc915391de.name: Franco prussian war
7eb302aa-f081-538b-a781-b0bc915391de.description: The Franco-Prussian War: France's defeat to Prussia results in the abdication of Napoleon III. Proclamation of the Third Republic.

7edf1463-a8f5-5c20-b759-bbef2f93e30f.name: Beirut clock tower is built
7edf1463-a8f5-5c20-b759-bbef2f93e30f.description: On 9 January 1897 and in celebration of the 10th anniversary of the Ottoman Sultan ‘Abd al-Hamid II’s coronation, a clock tower is built near the Grand Serail, Beirut, to make up for the absence of a public clock indicating mandatory Muslim prayer times especially as many foreign institutions had built Western-style clock towers.

7f3b6de5-f8f4-5303-905d-f199e97a97cd.name: Yaqub Sanu
7f3b6de5-f8f4-5303-905d-f199e97a97cd.description: Yaqub Sanu‘ founds the satirical magazine *Abu Naddara* early in this year. It has immediate and wide appeal to both the literate and the illiterate, who find someone to read it to them.

7f886bbc-0b8d-5f56-bba7-f43af099564a.name: Qasr al-Mushatta: the monument is one of the most important works of early Islamic architecture
7f886bbc-0b8d-5f56-bba7-f43af099564a.description: A large part of the richly ornamented south facade of Qasr al-Mushatta – one of the most important works of early Islamic architecture – was presented as a gift from the Ottoman Sultan ‘Abd al-Hamid II to Emperor Wilhelm II and transported from Jordan to Berlin via rail and sea.

800e9ee8-98c0-5843-859c-1c9e33376ab7.name: A seaside hostel instituted in Viareggio
800e9ee8-98c0-5843-859c-1c9e33376ab7.description: A seaside hostel is opened in Viareggio (Tuscany) for the treatment of children affected by tuberculosis (the first of its kind in Italy). In Tuscany, experiments of “marine therapy” for children started in the 1820s. By 1882, 21 seaside hostels for medical purposes are active in Italy.

8127cc2b-985b-5e93-ad59-6428d9a9aff2.name: Establishment and opening of Egyptian Geological Museum
8127cc2b-985b-5e93-ad59-6428d9a9aff2.description: The Egyptian Geological Museum (EGM) is established and opened to the public as part of the Egyptian Geological Survey (EGS), founded earlier in 1896. The Museum supports the theses that Egyptians are pioneers in extraction and utilization of metals and stones, the essential basics of civilization, and that they were the first to discover gold and copper and mine them from the Eastern Desert and Sinai.

812dcc79-7392-5f3f-ac7e-59250cdd8302.name: Estacio Pharmacy in Porto founded in 1883 starts
812dcc79-7392-5f3f-ac7e-59250cdd8302.description: Estacio Pharmacy in Porto founded in 1883 starts to produce the first pills for medication. The preparation of manipulated medicines in the apothecaries of the Catholic monasteries and convents (Boticas de Convento) is replaced by the production of medicines by laboratory pharmacies.

8135c904-16ed-5812-bc23-049b451af18c.name: Temporary peace accord
8135c904-16ed-5812-bc23-049b451af18c.description: A temporary Peace Accord is achieved between the British East India Company, represented by Captain David Seton the Resident at Muscat, and Sheikh Sultan bin Saqr. This comes following several incidents labelled by the British as “piracy”, which the Qawasim argue is crucial defence of their existentially important economic interests in the Gulf region.

813a86ce-62d3-5472-8a4b-912204c62d3b.name: Najib al-Rihani
813a86ce-62d3-5472-8a4b-912204c62d3b.description: Najib al-Rihani introduces a new type of theatre known as Musical Theatre or *Operette*. Cooperating with the famous Egyptian singer and composer Sayyid Darwish and the actor and writer Badi‘ Khayri, together, they produce several successful *Operettes*.

81e30ec0-670a-5b6d-8f1f-8cb3c5e0dc16.name: Gustav Klimt and the Viennese Sezession
81e30ec0-670a-5b6d-8f1f-8cb3c5e0dc16.description: Gustav Klimt (1867–1918) founds, along with other Viennese artists, the Viennese Secession, a society of Austrian Art Nouveaux artists.

8205bc2e-e6ae-5df4-a0da-272fc8c024ab.name: The icon Seven Holy Teachers
8205bc2e-e6ae-5df4-a0da-272fc8c024ab.description: The icon “Seven Holy Teachers” (Sedmochislenitzi) is painted by the most significant representative of Christian religious art in Macedonia, Dicho Krstevic Zograph, at the peak of his creativity. It represents the Slav missionaries Sts Cyril and Methodius and their disciples Clement, Nahum, Gorazd, Sabbas and Angelarij in a solo composition. His icons are distinguished by bright colour and baroque features.

821d3757-6bbc-58cc-a35f-7ed89fd4f6ab.name: Two peasants find a Gothic hoard
821d3757-6bbc-58cc-a35f-7ed89fd4f6ab.description: Two peasants find a Gothic hoard (4th–5th centuries AD) – the Pietroasa Treasure – near a village from Buzău county (Wallachia). Unfortunately, only 12 of the 22 golden pieces – jewellery and vases – were preserved.

824c3c76-55e8-57f3-9cec-54f35cf505fe.name: A reaction to academic teaching of SNBA emerge in 1911
824c3c76-55e8-57f3-9cec-54f35cf505fe.description: A reaction to academic teaching of the National Society of Fine Arts (SNBA) emerges in 1911 with the first free exhibition of young modernist painters. This is highlighted in the first Exhibition of the Humoristas of 1912, which includes painters Cristiano Cruz, Almada Negreiros, Eduardo Viana, Stuart de Carvalhais, José Pacheko and Emmerico Nunes and sculptor Diogo de Macedo.

826c5209-aba9-591c-aefd-1bf8fca1b9e0.name: Estatuto Real
826c5209-aba9-591c-aefd-1bf8fca1b9e0.description: Estatuto Real signed by the Queen Regent, María Cristina de Borbón, as a royal charter similar to the one under the French King Louis XVIII. There is no constitution, but it has two chambers (similar to the British House of Lords and House of Commons) and a government, with a president and ministers.

826f1118-43bd-5cce-84ef-3c309b71260b.name: Law of public instruction
826f1118-43bd-5cce-84ef-3c309b71260b.description: December: the law of public instruction establishes free, compulsory primary education.

828da978-e3f1-5465-b4cb-566e2f362687.name: British imposition of treaty to prohibit maritime warfare
