828da978-e3f1-5465-b4cb-566e2f362687.description: The British impose a Treaty to prohibit maritime warfare among the Arab littoral sheikhdoms during the pearling season from May to November with Britain as enforcer of the peace. The British now term the lands of the signatory sheikhdoms as “The Trucial Coast” or “Trucial Oman”. The Treaty is renewed regularly until 1853, when a Perpetual Treaty is put into place.

832851f7-3314-5aff-8065-8070bc0cc563.name: Foundation of Nestlé
832851f7-3314-5aff-8065-8070bc0cc563.description: Henri Nestlé founds the company Nestlé, which becomes the world’s largest corporation for comestible goods.

8350658c-7ee3-5a82-be6c-98634441bfd6.name: Gray, Paul and Co, a British Company, establishes a shipping office in Lingah
8350658c-7ee3-5a82-be6c-98634441bfd6.description: Gray, Paul and Co, a British Company, establishes a shipping office in Lingah, a city within Qawasim territory, located on the Persian littoral of the Arabian Gulf. The port first served for mail delivery and as a transshipment centre for traffic to and from Bahrain and the Trucial Coast. Later until 1902 all pearls from the Trucial Coast were exported to British India via this port.

83eb781a-d656-5412-bb1e-408743b04193.name: Maronite clergy move their school from Ghazir to Beirut
83eb781a-d656-5412-bb1e-408743b04193.description: Maronite clergy move their school from Ghazir to Beirut. Granted the title of university by the authorities, which allows it to grant academic degrees, mainly doctoral degrees in philosophy and theology, the school takes the name of Saint Joseph’s University. Faculties and institutes are founded in subsequent years.

84208956-45b2-5162-b9eb-bf72b9f4a054.name: Formation of the Pergamon Museum
84208956-45b2-5162-b9eb-bf72b9f4a054.description: Foundation of the Pergamon Museum (including the Museum of Islamic Art), conceptualised by Wilhelm von Bode, and built by Alfred Messel and Ludwig Hoffmann.

8443946e-10e4-5f99-9ad0-313a625cfd4f.name: The Great Famine, or Irish Potato Famine
8443946e-10e4-5f99-9ad0-313a625cfd4f.description: The Great Famine, or “Irish Potato Famine” as it is known, is a period of huge significance in Irish national history, not least because the country lost about a quarter of its population: a million people died from starvation and disease and another million emigrated. A number of factors – including absentee landlords, land acquisitions, the corn laws, anti-Catholic sentiment and crop failures due to “potato blight” – brought about the famine at a time when around two-fifths of the population were reliant solely on potatoes.

84718b70-8269-53d0-8a36-b830240b8a0f.name: Creation of the Portuguese Ethnological Museum that in 1906 opened its doors to the public at the Jerónimos Monastery
84718b70-8269-53d0-8a36-b830240b8a0f.description: Creation of the Portuguese Ethnological Museum, which in 1906 opened its doors to the public at the Jerónimos Monastery in the Belém area of Lisbon. The museum is currently designated the National Museum of Archaeology.

84854da1-fd11-586e-b7be-5e14ba93d147.name: A period of intense diplomatic activity
84854da1-fd11-586e-b7be-5e14ba93d147.description: A period of intense diplomatic activity between the Regency of Tunis and Western governments, which sees 20 diplomatic or consular agencies in Europe and the East represent the regency.

84d3dd3f-6827-5068-b1ee-08874ea54a76.name: Inspired by Cadiz Constitution members of Parliament authored the first liberal Constitution
84d3dd3f-6827-5068-b1ee-08874ea54a76.description: 1 October: Inspired by Cadiz Constitution members of Parliament authored the first liberal Constitution. King João VI (1767-1826) promulgated the document on 1 October 1822, in Lisbon. Royal prerogatives and  the nobles and clergy privileges were limited, though with a weak impact.

8506bf80-03db-5e62-b9a6-acbc9e7a0191.name: Some features of 19th-century architecture in Lebanon
8506bf80-03db-5e62-b9a6-acbc9e7a0191.description: Some features of 19th-century architecture in Lebanon have their origins in the era of Fakhr al-Din II. He had built khans and caravanserais to encourage trade and he introduced the red-tile technique, which became a typical element in Lebanese architecture. The *mashrabiyya* (wooden screens), used in buildings of Fakhr al-Din’s era, are still used in 19th-century Lebanese architecture.

85311f01-914b-5f91-a743-5637bc90c39a.name: Travelling to orient
85311f01-914b-5f91-a743-5637bc90c39a.description: From 1830, among artists and intellectuals of the 19th century the journey to the ‘Orient’ to discover ancient civilisations becomes a kind of ritual.

8554eddd-61e3-526c-ba86-031048c23c41.name: Lazar Lichenoski
8554eddd-61e3-526c-ba86-031048c23c41.description: One of the founders of Macedonian modern art, Lazar Lichenoski (d. 1964) is born in Galichnik. After graduating from Belgrade Art School he attended prestigeous art schools in Paris. He is best known for his landscapes, which reveal the harmonious beauty of nature through endless views from the peak of Bistra Mountain. Lichenoski introduced expressionism in Macedonian art.

8567f1df-9d97-5c0f-a86c-dc3aed0eb655.name: Era of literature Realism
8567f1df-9d97-5c0f-a86c-dc3aed0eb655.description: The era of Realism in literature (i.e. the works of Raabe, Fontane and Busch) is characterised by exact descriptions of reality, subjective narration and irony.

859dd6b5-d1e5-5658-a3a6-e78978cc9a54.name: Outcast
859dd6b5-d1e5-5658-a3a6-e78978cc9a54.description: *O Desterrado* (*The Outcast*), a sculpture by António Soares dos Reis (1847–89) is an idealised self-portrait. It conveys the collective feelings of his contemporary intellectuals and the feelings of loneliness and longing common to those who had left their homeland. The sculptor’s romantic sensibility enabled him to shape feelings and psychological tensions in the marble.

85bb72ad-6896-53fc-a4fa-1ef72f9b232d.name: Promulgation of the first Ottoman constitution
85bb72ad-6896-53fc-a4fa-1ef72f9b232d.description: 23 December: Promulgation of the first Ottoman constitution.

85c74932-11fc-5818-a400-b53441f61a78.name: Beginning of reforms in the empire
85c74932-11fc-5818-a400-b53441f61a78.description: 3 November: Mustafa Reşid Paşa declares the Imperial Rescript of Gülhane (the beginning of the Tanzimat reforms), granting basic rights to Ottoman subjects and declaring a policy of state reform. These reforms included the "fair and public trial[s] of all accused regardless of religion”, the creation of a system of "separate competences, religious and civil”, and the validity of non-Muslim testimony.

85cf5d5d-54b1-5413-ba10-cbbc7349d7c6.name: the heir apparent Archduke Francis Ferdinand was shot in Sarajevo by a Bosnian youth of Serb origin
85cf5d5d-54b1-5413-ba10-cbbc7349d7c6.description: On 28 June the heir-apparent Archduke Francis Ferdinand is shot in Sarajevo by a Bosnian youth of Serb origin.

85e637d1-860a-5c6f-9e23-25ad80c8e60c.name: Italy is hit by the international agricultural crisis
85e637d1-860a-5c6f-9e23-25ad80c8e60c.description: Italy is hit by the international agricultural crisis and annual per capita income decreases.

86372ddf-6fd6-507d-b5e3-ac1a8f524208.name: The Austrian composer Anton Bruckner dies

865a4c24-b92b-51bd-96f4-0bc9e859fd0f.name: First photography of Arab monuments such as the Alhambra
865a4c24-b92b-51bd-96f4-0bc9e859fd0f.description: First photography of Arab monuments such as the Alhambra and the Great Mosque of Córdoba. The development of photography sheds new light on these monuments and these first photographs are important documents on Arab remains in Spain.

86752dc4-aac4-5c69-a6d3-5db03c3d5774.name: Sir Evelyn Baring Consul-General of Britain
86752dc4-aac4-5c69-a6d3-5db03c3d5774.description: Arriving in Egypt as diplomatic agent and Consul-General of Britain, Sir Evelyn Baring’s (Lord Cromer’s) first task is to demand that Khedive Muhammad Tawfiq should abandon Sudan. Tawfiq consents reluctantly, but having done so he then does everything he can to ensure success of the policy that Baring has been sent to carry out.

86adb22f-a29c-57fe-b080-00b5b94f2c01.name: Fire in Aksaray district
86adb22f-a29c-57fe-b080-00b5b94f2c01.description: Fire in Aksaray district, İstanbul, destroys more than 650 buildings and is a major turning point in the history of İstanbul’s urban form. Italian architect Luigi Storari is appointed to carry out the re-building of the area, which is to conform to the new pattern: hence it is to be regular with straight and wide streets.

86be13e4-9de3-5205-b175-7bb77c5639cb.name: Fréjus Rail Tunnel
86be13e4-9de3-5205-b175-7bb77c5639cb.description: Fréjus Rail Tunnel under Alps, between Italy and France, inaugurated (12.8 km long).

86beb8a0-8cd2-5dff-b031-e8a773398e4d.name: Luigi Pirandello publishes the novel *Il fu Mattia Pascal*
86beb8a0-8cd2-5dff-b031-e8a773398e4d.description: Luigi Pirandello (1867–1936), Italian dramatist, novelist, poet and short story writer, publishes the novel *Il fu Mattia Pascal*. In 1934, he will be awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature.

86df9378-ff23-568d-981b-e4ab06c00163.name: The British Ambassador in Constantinople and reforms
86df9378-ff23-568d-981b-e4ab06c00163.description: The British Ambassador in Constantinople, Stratford Canning, has been credited with influencing the reforms in Turkey during the 19th century, in particular the decree of 1839, initiating a programme of liberal reform in the Ottoman Empire. Some of the changes are superficial, but nonetheless highly visible, such as the adoption of Western dress and titles. Other changes are seen in the culmination of social transformations within the Empire.

8730568c-7f23-51cb-9249-3768d718584b.name: The mutasarrifiyya
8730568c-7f23-51cb-9249-3768d718584b.description: In the aftermath of the Lebanese civil war in 1860, the Ottoman authorities impose a new system of government for the mountain districts of Lebanon. Formerly, the region had been divided into two districts, one with a Maronite Christian administrator and the other with a Druze. The Ottomans combine them into a single district, known as the *mutasarrifiyya*.

874e439a-4513-5a3b-9a0f-e7020053079d.name: The Lyceu Maria Pia the first female school is created in Lisbon
874e439a-4513-5a3b-9a0f-e7020053079d.description: Opening of the Lyceu Maria Pia, Lisbon, the first secondary school for girls. Though planned since 1887, female access to secondary level education faced lengthy resistance from Parliament. In 1888 the government was authorised to set up girls’ secondary schools run by district, municipal and charitable entities in Lisbon, Porto and Coimbra.

87651cd0-1b60-5e82-8132-362fb7bb320c.name: Austria cooperated in the settlement
87651cd0-1b60-5e82-8132-362fb7bb320c.description: Austria cooperates in a settlement to the Turkish–Egyptian crisis of 1840, sending intervention forces to conquer the Ottoman fortresses of Saida (Sidon) and St Jean d’Acre, and concluding with the Dardanelles Treaty signed at the London Straits Convention of 1841.

877dafd0-9f60-5864-acb2-b560bc71880d.name: Foundation of the NSDAP
877dafd0-9f60-5864-acb2-b560bc71880d.description: Foundation of the National Socialist German Workers Party (NSDAP); the party’s first selection for the German *Reichstag* is on 6 July.

879c3b37-aee0-5d71-8c03-b245e7f287d8.name: Ottoman participates in Vienna World Exhibition
879c3b37-aee0-5d71-8c03-b245e7f287d8.description: Ottoman participates in Vienna World Exhibition with a faithful full-scale replica of the Sultan Ahmed Fountain near Hagia Sophia in İstanbul. Ottoman artisans crafted the details of the façade panels, and the most of the materials were brought from Turkey.

87ad1534-a5ce-5b9b-95cd-2736a922d99f.name: Hammuda Pasha Bey
87ad1534-a5ce-5b9b-95cd-2736a922d99f.description: During the reign of Hammuda Pasha Bey, known as the “Founder” of modern Tunisia, the Regency of Tunis enjoys a thriving economy and an overall sense of security.

87c4fb26-97d0-5e91-8b87-9cfab63befbc.name: Black slaves
87c4fb26-97d0-5e91-8b87-9cfab63befbc.description: Important increase in the arrival of black slaves. The slave market is supplied by seasonal caravans and the Fezzan from Ghadames and the sub-Saharan region in general.

87e99421-c762-5c2c-a0c5-5fe38f1cc18a.name: *Manon Lescaut* by Giacomo Puccini
87e99421-c762-5c2c-a0c5-5fe38f1cc18a.description: *Manon Lescaut* by Giacomo Puccini (1858–1924) has a great success in Turin and Puccini becomes the most promising opera composer of the new generation.

87f39b39-b595-532d-8cd5-f7ca02ce520c.name: Defensive Treaty of Hunkar Iskelesi
87f39b39-b595-532d-8cd5-f7ca02ce520c.description: 8 July: Defensive Treaty of Hünkar İskelesi with Russia establishes Russian naval superiority in the Black Sea.

87f577c8-f580-5078-9d40-296bf89695ee.name: Starting point of the Ottoman novel
87f577c8-f580-5078-9d40-296bf89695ee.description: Publication of the novel *Taaşşuk-u Talat ve Fitnat* (The Romance of Talat and Fitnat) by Şemseddin Sami (1850–1904). This book is considered to be the starting point of the Ottoman novel.

88138228-33df-5ff1-b684-2ad28e2a85fa.name: Period of art Realism
88138228-33df-5ff1-b684-2ad28e2a85fa.description: Realism (a backlash to both Classicism and Romanticism) is exemplified by French artist Gustave Courbet’s *Die Steinklopfer* (1849), although long before then Albrecht Dürer had painted his highly realistic *Junger Feldhase* (1502).

8839d424-6a12-51e3-b554-9e666b625e37.name: A stretch of the northern railway route Floridsdorf to Deutschwagram
8839d424-6a12-51e3-b554-9e666b625e37.description: A stretch of the Northern Railway between Floridsdorf and Deutsch-Wagram comes into operation using steam-powered locomotives.

883ffa62-cefa-5fc5-b030-73e8d8eddc11.name: German Empire changes from free-trade
883ffa62-cefa-5fc5-b030-73e8d8eddc11.description: The German Empire moves from a free-trade system to protective duty.

88426545-ff29-56ff-9b0e-0d2f4531332d.name: Art Nouveau
88426545-ff29-56ff-9b0e-0d2f4531332d.description: Art Nouveau, a movement of the so-called Belle Époque, favours curves and decoration inspired by plant forms, and media such as stained glass. Art Deco, which followed in the so called Golden Twenties, affected architecture and the arts and crafts in particular on account of its preponderance for symmetry.

885afda5-dbd5-51f9-a040-fd0c36d2a6d7.name: Public movements in Saxony
885afda5-dbd5-51f9-a040-fd0c36d2a6d7.description: Popular movements in Saxony, Baden and the Pfalz attempt to put into effect the Constitution of the Empire, but they are defeated by Prussian troops.

8891679f-0bca-5f7b-9db7-13f48ca6dba5.name: London Treaty
8891679f-0bca-5f7b-9db7-13f48ca6dba5.description: The London Treaty: England, Russia and France suggest to the Ottoman Sultan that he should recognise Greek independence. This is the first step towards foundation of the Greek State.

8978f1aa-2492-5ccb-8de1-0a4ba14127b0.name: The statue of an athlete was found in Ephesos
8978f1aa-2492-5ccb-8de1-0a4ba14127b0.description: A statue of an athlete is found in Ephesus, Turkey; ‘Abd al-Hamid II, the Ottoman Sultan at the time, gives it as a gift to the Austrian Emperor Franz Joseph I.

89921c7a-6c88-55fb-8491-e1a4a127f6c8.name: Signing of the Treaty of Versailles
89921c7a-6c88-55fb-8491-e1a4a127f6c8.description: On signature of the Treaty of Versailles, Germany must face up to its responsibility to make reparation payments, abandon territory and let go of its colonies. The League of Nations is founded.

89b3b259-caa1-5021-80b7-ebc9ba9afb10.name: The Paris Treaty
89b3b259-caa1-5021-80b7-ebc9ba9afb10.description: 30 March: The Paris Treaty marks the end of the Crimean War (1853–56); the Ottoman Empire is admitted into the Concert of Europe.

89db1804-533f-5192-a876-220a9f594541.name: Mohammad bin Saud established the first Saudi state
89db1804-533f-5192-a876-220a9f594541.description: In 1765 Imam Muhammad bin Saud establishes the First Saudi State in Arabia, starting with the Najd region, and making its capital the city of Dir‘iyya.

89f7da91-c373-5f3d-be38-70971584f56f.name: Treaty of Sevres
89f7da91-c373-5f3d-be38-70971584f56f.description: 10 August: Treaty of Sévres, which divides Anatolia between the Allies, Greeks, Armenians and Kurds.

8a31935d-1a39-5b3b-9ae1-707009dabc94.name: Dimitar Miladinov
8a31935d-1a39-5b3b-9ae1-707009dabc94.description: One of the most prominent Macedonian poets, folklorists and educators, Dimitar Miladinov(1810–62) is born in Struga. He spends most of his life teaching in the Ohrid region. His greatest achievement is the collection of folk songs between 1854 and 1860.

8aad85d1-fbea-56a1-b52e-22fc73bce8b0.name: Charles Rennie Mackintosh
8aad85d1-fbea-56a1-b52e-22fc73bce8b0.description: Charles Rennie Mackintosh (b. Glasgow, Scotland 1868; d. London, England 1928), artist, designer and architect, is perhaps best known for the Charles Rennie Mackintosh building at Glasgow School of Art, which was built in two stages (1897–9 and 1907–9) due to lack of funding. Designed in the Art and Crafts style, and owing much to Scotland’s baronial tradition, Mackintosh eschewed the architectural styles of Greece and Rome in his design. Achieving the acclaim he felt he deserved in Europe, Mackintosh’s originality was never fully appreciated in the United Kingdom, except by a few loyal supporters and patrons, during his lifetime.

8adc9778-a6d1-53d4-b4dc-bdfa8f45a902.name: Imperial Rescript of Reforms
8adc9778-a6d1-53d4-b4dc-bdfa8f45a902.description: 28 February: Under diplomatic pressure, the Sublime Porte is forced to declare the Imperial Rescript of Reforms (Islahat Fermanı), giving the empire admission to the Concert of Europe. The Rescript states the equality of Muslims and non-Muslims before law, the right of non-Muslims to be admitted to government and military service, and abolition of the poll tax and freedom in education for non-Muslims.

8b366f79-f1db-5df1-9d61-2f466087069d.name: Foundation of the secret organisation Filiki Etaireia
8b366f79-f1db-5df1-9d61-2f466087069d.description: Foundation of the secret organisation Filiki Etaireia (Friendly Society) prepares the ground for the Greek Revolution.

8b83d62a-aa76-5388-8979-dab9a80a9302.name: School for design
8b83d62a-aa76-5388-8979-dab9a80a9302.description: The "special national school for design, mathematics, architecture and ornamental sculpture applied to the industrial arts", which succeeds the Royal school of design founded in the 18th century, becomes the École nationale supérieure des arts décoratifs in 1877.

8b95b4f5-80df-533d-a2b5-eb7e8d87e518.name: The literary society Junimea
8b95b4f5-80df-533d-a2b5-eb7e8d87e518.description: The literary society Junimea, which had an important role in promoting Romanian literature, is founded in Iaşi. In 1867 it begins publishing a periodical in which the works of Romanian writers appear and also translations from worldwide literature.

8b9f97cf-d1a0-5856-8a71-bf3c8705123f.name: Hambacher Fest
8b9f97cf-d1a0-5856-8a71-bf3c8705123f.description: The “Hambacher Fest” demonstrates the liberal, democratic and national opposition in Germany.

8ba2e24d-8a08-5ff1-9d43-aaccb9084a29.name: Hambacher Fest
8ba2e24d-8a08-5ff1-9d43-aaccb9084a29.description: From 27 to 30 May an apparently non-political country fair, the “Hambacher Fest”, was held by a German national democratic assembly, demanding freedom, national entity and popular sovereignty.

8bcd27f3-c0ad-5d38-8347-1971bca6fcd5.name: Bankruptcy of Greece
8bcd27f3-c0ad-5d38-8347-1971bca6fcd5.description: Prime Minister Charilaos Trikoupis declares that Greece is bankrupt.

8bd90a52-d2f7-50f4-9340-487a99247ace.name: Electric telegraph
8bd90a52-d2f7-50f4-9340-487a99247ace.description: The First electric telegraph in France between Paris and Rouen.

8c073e9f-3803-583b-8313-d568691e42c0.name: Death of Emperor Francis Joseph
8c073e9f-3803-583b-8313-d568691e42c0.description: Death of Emperor Francis Joseph and accession of Emperor Charles I to the Austro-Hungarian throne.

8c181db7-c652-5211-acd7-3a6429715790.name: The hospital al-Jasra
8c181db7-c652-5211-acd7-3a6429715790.description: Sheikh Abdullah bin Jassim starts to make plans to build the first hospital, in al-Jasra Qatar, which will be opened in 1947. During 1943, Sheikh Abdullah establishes some of the first modern schools in Qatar.

8c443b97-b49c-5ec0-a6c0-864d5abb24ce.name: Heinrich Göbel invents light bulb
8c443b97-b49c-5ec0-a6c0-864d5abb24ce.description: Heinrich Göbel invents the light bulb.

8c44b16d-f009-59a7-93ec-3042e8ebfaad.name: Creation of the Museum of the Geological Commission currently called Museum of Geology of Portugal
8c44b16d-f009-59a7-93ec-3042e8ebfaad.description: Creation of the Museum of the Geological Commission currently called the Museum of Geology of Portugal. It is established under the auspices of the Geological Commission from specimens collected by the Portuguese pioneers of geology Carlos Ribeiro, Nery Delgado, Pereira da Costa, Paul Choffat and others.

8caa1078-d879-5053-baef-f5f64c961dfe.name: Casati law in the Kingdom of Sardinia
8caa1078-d879-5053-baef-f5f64c961dfe.description: The Casati Law is passed in the Kingdom of Sardinia (and in 1860 extended to the rest of Italy) that  defines the organisation of the educational system, from primary school to university. The system is aimed more at educating the ruling elite than the illiterate masses. Humanities are given a much higher status than scientific and technical education.

8cb7d9a9-d9a7-5b9f-8663-9203c0bdd7d3.name: Harsh repression of pro-national unification
8cb7d9a9-d9a7-5b9f-8663-9203c0bdd7d3.description: Harsh repression of pro-national unification and pro-constitution movement forces many activists – including Giuseppe Mazzini and Giuseppe Garibaldi – to flee abroad.

8cf48875-f300-53b3-b28a-a173336ff17f.name: The Mavrokordatos Mansion
8cf48875-f300-53b3-b28a-a173336ff17f.description: Mavrokordatos Mansion is built in the Kipseli neighbourhood in Athens for the well-known political family of that name.

8d011312-9ad7-5994-b522-b0a06a8a4e8b.name: Museum of Islamic Art
8d011312-9ad7-5994-b522-b0a06a8a4e8b.description: The Museum of Islamic Art, the German Oriental Society and the Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York, undertake two excavations during which several *iwan*s and stucco ornaments, as well as numerous other finds from houses, in layers of occupation from the late Sasanian period through to the early Islamic periods, are found. The stucco finds form the foundations for later stylistic developments in Samarra. Many of the stuccos are now found at the Museum of Islamic Art, Berlin, and the Metropolitan Museum of Art.

8d702c8f-8343-5372-948c-03fced2c4e8a.name: A railroad was opened between Budweis
8d702c8f-8343-5372-948c-03fced2c4e8a.description: A railway line opens between Budweis (Bohemia) and Linz (Upper Austria). The rolling stock was not yet steam-operated.

8daf36ae-da19-51be-8431-78d4430c8364.name: Army mutiny led by Rafael del Riego
8daf36ae-da19-51be-8431-78d4430c8364.description: In 1820, the army mutiny led by Rafael del Riego leads to King Fernando VII accepting the Constitution, in spite of his former opposition to constitutional monarchy, bringing in the Trienio Liberal period of popular rule. The Congress of Verona in 1822 gives France a mandate to restore Fernando as absolute monarch. In 1823 the French army invades Spain to restore absolutism, ending the Trienio Liberal.

8db8c26a-6cb3-54fe-9f26-97c4ebc9529c.name: The first newspaper
8db8c26a-6cb3-54fe-9f26-97c4ebc9529c.description: *Al-Waqa'i\`a al-Masriya* is established by order of Khedive Muhammad ‘Ali. It is the first indigenous Middle Eastern newspaper, initially written in both Ottoman Turkish and Arabic.

8dc1e066-b0ca-50ae-a67d-ad6cb9504c69.name: Prince Pedro, Duke of Braganza and royal heir
8dc1e066-b0ca-50ae-a67d-ad6cb9504c69.description: King João VI asks his heir Prince Pedro, Duke of Braganza (1798–1834) to remain in Brazil. Part of the court decides to stay there. Facing revolt against the anti-Brazilian policy of Portugal, Pedro proclaims the independence of Brazil on 7 September (Grito do Ipiranga). In October he is acclaimed as the first Brazilian Emperor, Pedro I.

8e2d6073-4b91-53e7-a17a-1289fe3055a2.name: Ahmed Vefik Paşa dies
8e2d6073-4b91-53e7-a17a-1289fe3055a2.description: Ahmed Vefik Paşa dies. Besides his administrative positions, he is regarded as a precursor of Turkish cultural nationalism and remembered also for contributing to the development of Western theatre in the empire by translating French plays.

8eedc255-dbb4-5aa8-8c71-fddd20c56cd3.name: The portrait of Gjurchin Kokale
8eedc255-dbb4-5aa8-8c71-fddd20c56cd3.description: The portrait of Gjurchin Kokale, founder of the Church of St George in Lazaropole, is painted inside the church by Dicho Krstevic Zograph. It is one of the earliest known portraits in Macedonia. In 1854 this prolific artist painted the icon of Archpriest Samoil from the Treskavec Monastery near Prilep.

8efc0b1f-845b-5815-b118-bde2a37617c3.name: The first performance of Janufa
8efc0b1f-845b-5815-b118-bde2a37617c3.description: First performance of Leoš Janáček’s (1854–1928) opera *Janufa*.

8f4bc9d4-1925-5635-bb1e-d9e967d6babb.name: Revolution in Austria
8f4bc9d4-1925-5635-bb1e-d9e967d6babb.description: Revolution in Austria-Hungary and northern Italy.

8f842ce9-8bb0-5ca5-8be7-b476e1916429.name: Smyrna Bank
8f842ce9-8bb0-5ca5-8be7-b476e1916429.description: The first successful attempt to open a modern bank in the Empire. Smyrna Bank is established by foreign merchants (English, French, Austrian, Dutch, Russian, American, Italian, Danish, Spanish and Greek) under the Swedish Consulate in Izmir in order to diminish their dependence on other merchants and bankers. It is closed in the same year for operating without permission.

8f88862c-a2e3-564f-91e7-70cde409e029.name: During the reign of prince Grigore IV Ghica
8f88862c-a2e3-564f-91e7-70cde409e029.description: During the reign of Prince Grigore IV Ghica, the major streets in Bucharest, which used to be covered with wooden planks, are covered with cobblestones.

8fdfbbba-8d8d-5e73-9692-a45a89bb360c.name: Dance at Le moulin de la Galette
8fdfbbba-8d8d-5e73-9692-a45a89bb360c.description: *Dance at Le moulin de la Galette* by the Impressionist painter Pierre-Auguste Renoir.

901a99aa-b153-5ca8-a585-3b5f5b544a7f.name: The Great Exhibition of this year was influenced by some Islamic design
901a99aa-b153-5ca8-a585-3b5f5b544a7f.description: At the Great Exhibition of this year are some examples of Islamic design influenced by Owen Jones, who had “discovered” Al-Andalus (Andalusian) Islamic architecture. Jones was brother-in-law to the architect J. W. Wild who designed St Mark’s Church in Alexandria.

9081dc0f-a345-5a59-9ce0-06df5d69bf1f.name: Emigration of Macedonian intellectuals
9081dc0f-a345-5a59-9ce0-06df5d69bf1f.description: Extensive emigration of intellectuals from Macedonia to neighbouring countries and Russia. With unfavourable conditions at home for science and research, many Macedonian students stay in the country where they studied to contribute to the development of science, culture and arts. They often organised societies such as the Sofia Circle of Macedonian Students run by Petar Pop-Arsov (1872–1941), which began issuing *Loza* newspaper in 1882.

909181d2-abe5-5c4c-b5bb-a3967f4f53d1.name: Emperor Franz Joseph opens the World Trade Fair in Vienna
909181d2-abe5-5c4c-b5bb-a3967f4f53d1.description: Emperor Franz Joseph I of Austria opens the *Weltausstellung*, Vienna’s World Trade Fair.

90935b63-15aa-5ad8-88bf-bb9ae478d8c2.name: Era of literature Biedermeier
90935b63-15aa-5ad8-88bf-bb9ae478d8c2.description: The Biedermeier era in literature (i.e. works by Mörike and von Droste-Hülshoff) is characterised by melancholia, a desire to escape to an idyll and to recapture religion and the homeland.

90a28368-de7d-5942-8964-60957d94b636.name: The Treaty of Paris
90a28368-de7d-5942-8964-60957d94b636.description: The Treaty of Paris is signed. Following defeat by Anglo-Ottoman forces, France surrenders to Britain the Egyptian antiquities it has collected. The way is open for British exploration of Egyptian archaeology.

90b7fec9-0e88-57f8-acda-ad0361e9f665.name: Nikiphoros Lytras becomes professor at the School of Arts in Athens
90b7fec9-0e88-57f8-acda-ad0361e9f665.description: Nikiphoros Lytras takes up a professorship at the School of the Arts in Athens.

90d0bd88-4824-5527-b701-e5fb1ff20bf3.name: Emperor Franz Joseph visits Jerusalem
90d0bd88-4824-5527-b701-e5fb1ff20bf3.description: Emperor Franz Joseph I of Austria visits Jerusalem.

90d36efa-a8ae-5f67-88a4-1033f6c637ee.name: The Coppino Law
90d36efa-a8ae-5f67-88a4-1033f6c637ee.description: The “Coppino Law” makes elementary schools mandatory and free of charge.

90df7ca0-b9c6-50a7-87e9-9b9959873bab.name: Al Qawasim possess a fleet of over 700 long-distance trading vessels
90df7ca0-b9c6-50a7-87e9-9b9959873bab.description: The Qawasim possess a fleet of over 700 long-distance trading vessels, venturing all over the Gulf as well as in India and East Africa.

90f9af3a-71de-5df8-a4a8-4589d1f3c2e4.name: Copou, one of the first public gardens in Romania
90f9af3a-71de-5df8-a4a8-4589d1f3c2e4.description: Copou, one of the first public gardens in Romania, is laid out in Iaşi, Moldavia, at the initiative of Prince Mihail Sturdza.

90fca70a-5e4d-5846-8227-acb82f85a386.name: Benedetto Croce promotes the approval of the first law on the safeguard of the natural landscape
90fca70a-5e4d-5846-8227-acb82f85a386.description: Philosopher, senator and minister of education (1920–21) Benedetto Croce promotes the approval of the first law on safeguarding the natural landscape.

913a6c4d-4fd4-5274-b73b-a7590ebe6104.name: Post impressionism
913a6c4d-4fd4-5274-b73b-a7590ebe6104.description: Trends in painting in this period include: "Post-Impressionism" (i.e. Cézanne, Gauguin, Toulouse-Lautrec, van Gogh); Pointillism (i.e. Seurat, Signac); Symbolism (i.e. Moreau, Puvis de Chavannes, Redon); Les Nabis (i.e. Bonnard, Denis, Sérusier, Vuillard) and Primitivism (i.e. Matisse, Rousseau).

9149bffa-e352-5994-8d2b-8ba58911ceee.name: The Automobile Club d’Italia is founded
9149bffa-e352-5994-8d2b-8ba58911ceee.description: The Automobile Club d’Italia is founded.

917681cc-b919-531c-843a-f3e13dad88f3.name: Western travellers from Europe dreamed of a
917681cc-b919-531c-843a-f3e13dad88f3.description: Travellers from Europe approached the notion of the Near East with dreams of a “holy world” and “treasuries of wisdom”. The European desire for the “Orient” arose partly as a result of the Enlightenment, which since the 1800s had already changed the public psyche, filtering down from the rationalism of intellectuals to the scientification of the public. In addition, the many wars of the period, especially the Napoleonic Wars, produced in the people nostalgia; a desire for distance, the unknown, and the halcyon days of the past. Romantic-era authors and philosophers, much disturbed by these very topics (e.g. Friedrich Schlegel), thus attempted to escape into something magical – the “Orient” seemed to them, and their readers, an ideal imaginary world.

91852d9c-5949-5366-960f-3019bb526314.name: Aida
91852d9c-5949-5366-960f-3019bb526314.description: Giuseppe Verdi’s Egyptian-themed *Aida* premiers in Cairo on 24 December.

91cc2594-3d4f-5630-8c3f-46296b05f330.name: Liberty style in Italy
91cc2594-3d4f-5630-8c3f-46296b05f330.description: Construction of some remarkable Liberty-style buildings, such as the Villino Florio in Palermo and the new building of Palazzo Montecitorio (seat of the Italian Chamber of Deputies in Rome), both by Ernesto Basile, some pavilions for the 1902 national exhibition in Turin, and the small Coppedè neighbourhood in Rome. Overall, however, Liberty style leaves a smaller mark on Italian cities than eclecticism.

9279e267-edad-5c62-9654-c698a2f52fc9.name: Western classical music penetrated the courtly circles of the Ottoman Empire
9279e267-edad-5c62-9654-c698a2f52fc9.description: Western classical music penetrates the courtly circles of the Ottoman Empire. The imperial Ottoman family includes composers, such as Sultan ‘Abd al-‘Aziz who composes dance music. On a visit to London in 1867, the band of the Grenadier Guards plays one of the Sultan’s own compositions at a reception for him.

93028364-952e-5a9e-be51-7997d9f35ad7.name: Alessandro Manzoni publishes *I promessi sposi*
93028364-952e-5a9e-be51-7997d9f35ad7.description: Alessandro Manzoni (1785–1873) publishes *I promessi sposi* (*The Betrothed*), one of the most widely read Italian novels. His use of the Italian language stands out as a model.

9352cc88-047e-5c84-9e20-e450cd3c91ee.name: The construction of a road to link Wallachia and Transylvania
9352cc88-047e-5c84-9e20-e450cd3c91ee.description: The construction of a road to link Wallachia and Transylvania, crossing through the Predeal Pass in the Southern Carpathians, is begun during the reign of Prince Gheorghe Bibescu.

935f7722-9528-53b4-a4c2-857e86f69c22.name: Filippo Tommaso Marinetti publishes the Futurist Manifesto
935f7722-9528-53b4-a4c2-857e86f69c22.description: Filippo Tommaso Marinetti (b. Alexandria, Egypt, 1876, d. Bellagio, Italy, 1944) publishes the Futurist Manifesto. The Futurist artistic movement emphasised speed, energy, vitality, and the power of machine and technology. Marinetti also glorified violence and war, which he considered “the world’s only hygiene”.

93884e61-5a05-5942-9500-70bacc27f392.name: Taimiyya school in Sharjah
93884e61-5a05-5942-9500-70bacc27f392.description: Sharjah’s Taimiyyah School, which also incorporated a library, would send promising students farther afield to continue their studies. Students from outside Sharjah were offered free board and accommodation at the school.

939794ba-587f-56fb-bb17-0fe359268498.name: Tunisian army in the Crimean war
939794ba-587f-56fb-bb17-0fe359268498.description: A contingent of the Tunisian army is called upon to participate alongside the Ottoman Empire, France and England in the Crimean War.

93ac1fd9-7813-5c1c-86c5-caf9b6599aa1.name: Social and cultural life
93ac1fd9-7813-5c1c-86c5-caf9b6599aa1.description: The colonial era: social and cultural life are organised around Europeans striving for modernity and accustomed to the cultural life of European cities; hence construction of theatres, hotels, casinos, etc.

93d189cb-ae36-5e54-9295-ea87ce356a14.name: Construction of the Tour Eiffel
93d189cb-ae36-5e54-9295-ea87ce356a14.description: The World Fair in Paris showcases the development of the latest industrial processes, and the Eiffel Tower is constructed for it.

93ff3a7d-f379-5601-bd00-2407c7eaef46.name: A school is built by the Jesuits in Ghazir (Kisruwan district)
93ff3a7d-f379-5601-bd00-2407c7eaef46.description: A school is built by the Jesuits in Ghazir (Kisruwan district).

9424dc39-4a81-5080-86e3-f62fdabdaa0a.name: Romanian pilot and inventor Traian Vuia tests in France (near Paris) his heavier-than air
9424dc39-4a81-5080-86e3-f62fdabdaa0a.description: 18 March: Romanian pilot and inventor Traian Vuia tests in France (near Paris) his heavier-than-air, fully self-propelled, fixed-wing aircraft. The plane leaves the ground and flies at a height of 1 m for a distance of about 12 m, but the engine cuts out and it comes down.

945e7d97-47be-56f7-ad31-1b918b2899d1.name: Shaikh Sultan bin Saqr succeeds his father
945e7d97-47be-56f7-ad31-1b918b2899d1.description: Sheikh Sultan bin Saqr succeeds his father as leader of the Qawasim. He expands the Qawasim Empire to the east to encompass the areas now known as Khor Fakkan and Kalba. He delegates the administration of key strongholds to his brothers and later to his sons. His half-brother Salih bin Saqr rules Sharjah from 1803 to 1838, followed by his son Saqr bin Sultan (until 1846), and then his son Abdallah bin Sultan (until 1855).

94d4a14b-6a95-5feb-a787-bf6195fd1542.name: Around 5 million Germans migrate to the USA
94d4a14b-6a95-5feb-a787-bf6195fd1542.description: Around 5 million Germans migrate to the USA to meet the need for manpower there, thanks to industrialisation, especially from the Ruhr region.

94e1cbbf-fb7b-5824-b5fe-bfe48d6dda2d.name: Installation of the first public telephone line in Romania
94e1cbbf-fb7b-5824-b5fe-bfe48d6dda2d.description: Installation of the first public telephone line in Romania (in Bucharest between the Minister of Internal Affairs and the Central Post Office).

9509fe50-b893-5fd5-9c68-609f2982023d.name: The reign of the great builder ends
9509fe50-b893-5fd5-9c68-609f2982023d.description: The reign of Hammuda Pasha Bey, known as the “Founder” of modern Tunisia, comes to an end.

95578c79-201d-5b5f-9c73-20719bcd8b0d.name: Founding of the
95578c79-201d-5b5f-9c73-20719bcd8b0d.description: Foundation of the Deutsche-Orient Gesellschaft (DOG) in Berlin is to promote research in the field of “Oriental” archaeology and bring it to a wider audience. One of the first archaeological excavations undertaken by the DOG was in Babylon, with the discovery of the Ishtar Gate (now at the Museum of the Ancient Near East in Berlin). DOG was responsible for finds at Tell el-Amarna, the capital of the Pharaonic Empire where the famous bust of Queen Nefertiti was found (now at the Neues Museum). Kaiser Wilhelm II assumed patronage of DOG in 1901.

9588f892-dec6-5757-ad89-100edb1e6cf0.name: Ludwig the second built Palace Linderhof
9588f892-dec6-5757-ad89-100edb1e6cf0.description: King Ludwig II of Bavaria sets in motion the building of his second palace, Linderhof (1869–85), the smallest of the large palaces he had built, and the only one he lived to see completed. The king’s penchant for the so called Moorish style can be seen in several elements, such as the Moorish Kiosk (1867) and the Moroccan House (1878). The King’s House on the Schachen (1869–72), built with a Turkish Hall by Georg von Dollmann, further attests to Ludwig’s admiration for the “Oriental” style.

958a990b-025b-5e1a-b4bc-1c3a09211912.name: The first newspaper in Ottoman Turkish
958a990b-025b-5e1a-b4bc-1c3a09211912.description: 11 November: The first newspaper in Ottoman Turkish, *Takvim-I Vekayi*, published by the state.

95cd27a8-4d86-5001-b31c-a811f6158d89.name: Within the liberalism educational reform
95cd27a8-4d86-5001-b31c-a811f6158d89.description: Under the liberal educational reforms, Lyceu Nacional de Aveiro (Aveiro High School) is the first school in Portugal to occupy a building designed specifically for this function. Previously schools occupied existing buildings, often old convents. The school had been created as Colégio de Aveiro in 1848.

963235b5-028c-59e9-ab3f-efc83c6e61f2.name: Symbolist theatre
963235b5-028c-59e9-ab3f-efc83c6e61f2.description: Paul Claudel's de *L'Annonce faite à Marie* opens at the Théâtre de l'Œuvre, a Symbolist theatre set up as a reaction to André Antoine’s “Naturalist” Théâtre Libre.

963e88b5-a317-516e-8a30-94670f4673de.name: Conference of San Remo
963e88b5-a317-516e-8a30-94670f4673de.description: The Conference of San Remo was an international meeting convened to decide which parts of its territories the Ottoman Empire would lose, to become the mandated territory under the League of Nations. For example, France received mandated territory for Syria and Lebanon (and King Faysal of Iraq goes into exile after losing Greater Syria to the French).

965995ff-1f8d-57e5-b624-638985258f77.name: Blueprints for a new Istanbul
965995ff-1f8d-57e5-b624-638985258f77.description: The first blueprints for a new Istanbul are prepared by Helmuth von Moltke, a general in the Ottoman army working for its modernisation, under direct orders from Mustafa Reşid Paşa.

9666b787-0c19-576b-a8a9-4f9b9a2b42d9.name: Corset
9666b787-0c19-576b-a8a9-4f9b9a2b42d9.description: The corset introduces the fashion for a more slender figure.

9674ae6a-4bc3-5d40-9df1-20e1f0537689.name: Opening of the Semmering railway road
9674ae6a-4bc3-5d40-9df1-20e1f0537689.description: The Semmering Railway is the first mainline railway to pass through mountainous territory.

96ce7b5c-4391-5530-9cf8-bf12afb3c268.name: The National Gathering
96ce7b5c-4391-5530-9cf8-bf12afb3c268.description: December: the National Gathering of the United Principalities adopts the law through which the land owned by monasteries (more than a quarter of Romania’s surface) becomes property of the state.

96d0bddb-4063-5626-9f75-3e9c909306b9.name: Romeo and Juliet, by Gounod
96d0bddb-4063-5626-9f75-3e9c909306b9.description: Premiere of the opera *Roméo et Juliet* by Charles-François Gounod.

96d2d0ed-5fc0-5aab-9f28-02cafde9436a.name: First photography of the Islamic monuments
96d2d0ed-5fc0-5aab-9f28-02cafde9436a.description: First photography of the Islamic monuments and remains in Spain such as the Great Mosque of Córdoba and the Alhambra palace.

96e5e4b5-aa64-5511-b1ec-329efd627e19.name: The Ottomans abandon Doha
96e5e4b5-aa64-5511-b1ec-329efd627e19.description: The Ottomans suddenly abandon Doha, leaving behind guns, shells and ammunition.

96ea10b4-9d97-5b67-afbb-63d6cbcf2c41.name: The Ente nazionale per le industrie turistiche
96ea10b4-9d97-5b67-afbb-63d6cbcf2c41.description: The Ente nazionale per le industrie turistiche (ENIT – a state-funded body aimed at promoting tourism in Italy) is founded. In the last decades of the 19th century, local associations and bodies aimed at promoting tourism started to be created, under public or private initiative.

9710722e-3904-53dd-95fe-25256ccdb433.name: Liberal ideas emergence since 1817
9710722e-3904-53dd-95fe-25256ccdb433.description: The emergence of liberal ideas. In Porto a Provisional Ruling Council is created (1820) and pursues the rebellion against British rule that started in Lisbon. Liberal revolution breaks out in Porto (August 1820), spreads to Lisbon, beginning the radical cycle known as Vintismo. King João VI is forced to return to Portugal from Brazil in 1821.

972c094b-4c3e-5aa7-b45d-549e13cd596c.name: Romanceiro  Português
972c094b-4c3e-5aa7-b45d-549e13cd596c.description: Publication of *Romanceiro Português* by Almeida Garrett (1799–1854), a two-volume compilation of popular folktales. Almeida Garrett aimed at the creation of a national literature inspired by local and regional traditions.

9761cf62-4352-54a2-b289-17bd7193e646.name: Aware that Portuguese empirical knowledge on Central Africa was being exceeded
9761cf62-4352-54a2-b289-17bd7193e646.description: Aware that Portuguese empirical knowledge of Central Africa was being overtaken by other countries, the “Sociedade de Geografia de Lisboa” is founded to "promote and assist the study and progress of geography and related sciences in Portugal". To raise awareness of the colonial Portuguese possessions in Africa and Asia was also a goal.

976ad953-5c9a-58ca-b227-667e1dac7837.name: At the age of 80, Verdi composes his last opera, *Falstaff*
976ad953-5c9a-58ca-b227-667e1dac7837.description: At the age of 80, Verdi composes his last opera, *Falstaff*, an *opera buffa* that opens new avenues towards the theatre of the 20th century. The music underscores all the subtle nuances of the psychology of the different characters.

976ca7cb-265a-5998-8ae5-7250fc2ed750.name: Carlist party rises three times in three dynastic wars against the State
976ca7cb-265a-5998-8ae5-7250fc2ed750.description: As a consequence of political instability and of a woman taking over the rule of Spain, the deeply conservative and ultra-Catholic Carlist party rises three times in three dynastic wars against the State (1836–39, 1846–49 and 1872–76).

977b1c25-67c0-5e7f-88f4-033570cb4b2e.name: Carol de Hohenzollern-Sigmaringen ruler of the United Principalities
977b1c25-67c0-5e7f-88f4-033570cb4b2e.description: 14–20 April: plebiscite leading to German Prince Carol de Hohenzollern-Sigmaringen being elected ruler of the United Principalities and recognised by the Ottoman Empire in October. On 13 July a new constitution is adopted, based on the Belgian one from 1835.

979d710a-1ec4-5981-837d-41ab03d27893.name: Italy annexes Venice
979d710a-1ec4-5981-837d-41ab03d27893.description: Italy participates in the Austro-Prussian War on the side of Prussia and annexes Venice.

97c12ea3-4f56-58fe-b558-e863ea2f0570.name: Alliance of the three Emperors
97c12ea3-4f56-58fe-b558-e863ea2f0570.description: The alliance of the three Emperors of Germany, Russia and Austria recognise the Habsburg Empire’s predominance in the western Balkans. In June, Austria reaches an agreement with King Milan I of Serbia, whereby Austria promises to support an eventual Serbian expansion in the south, while Serbia agrees to exclude any agreement with other powers without Austria’s prior approval.

985b4746-8b34-5fd6-b140-d0251758ef38.name: Recaîzâde Mahmud Ekrem
985b4746-8b34-5fd6-b140-d0251758ef38.description: Recaîzâde Mahmud Ekrem publishes the novel *Araba Sevdası* (A Carriage Affair). He was prominent in literary circles and promoted the Westernisation of Ottoman Turkish literature.

98861a27-1280-5c98-a5f4-9075f022c8ab.name: Madame Bovary, by Flaubert
98861a27-1280-5c98-a5f4-9075f022c8ab.description: Publication of Gustave Flaubert’s novel *Madame Bovary*.

989c2abc-ba9c-5c42-bf1a-131fb76c3497.name: Ministry of Public Education
989c2abc-ba9c-5c42-bf1a-131fb76c3497.description: March: The Ministry of Public Education is founded.

98a4e342-dfd0-56b9-be45-fd1a5b55f172.name: Egyptian currency based on a bimetallic base
98a4e342-dfd0-56b9-be45-fd1a5b55f172.description: A Khedival Decree promulgates the issue of an Egyptian currency consisting of a bi-metallic base of gold and silver. The Egyptian pound, known as the *geneih* is introduced, which replaces the Egyptian piastre (*ersh*) as the main unit of currency.

98d4da1f-7cf1-5086-b8e3-fd46401464ac.name: Gotthard Rail Tunnel
98d4da1f-7cf1-5086-b8e3-fd46401464ac.description: The Gotthard Rail Tunnel between Italy and Switzerland opens (14.9 km). The construction work had started in 1872.

98f51348-22bc-511a-b977-4656c4d8de06.name: British interests in raw material
98f51348-22bc-511a-b977-4656c4d8de06.description: British interests in raw material – iron and coal – lead to the foundation of the iron and steel industry in Bilbao and Santander and industrial exploitation of the coal mines in Asturias.

9920fb8a-96c7-5363-9af9-de70d2143d3e.name: Formation of Serbian Duchy Vojvodina
9920fb8a-96c7-5363-9af9-de70d2143d3e.description: The Serbian uprising against the Austrian monarchy sees the formation of *Srpsko Vojvodstvo* (the Serbian Duchy). Stevan Knićanin-Vojvoda (military commander) commands Serbian volunteers during the Hungarian Revolution (1848–49).

99588519-9d97-5d34-9d4c-598db2643084.name: Beginning of the restoration of the Alhambra
99588519-9d97-5d34-9d4c-598db2643084.description: Beginning of the restoration of the Alhambra by the Contreras family. The restoration is more an “adornment” of the monument following ideas from Orientalism. The Contreras' casting workshop reproduces plaster decorations from the palace sold as souvenirs and displayed at international exhibitions, spreading the Alhambrismo or Alhambresque style.

997a6934-67c0-573e-ac3a-ee81bfbed8aa.name: Italian poet Giosuè Carducci (1835–1907) is awarded the Nobel Prize in literature
997a6934-67c0-573e-ac3a-ee81bfbed8aa.description: Italian poet Giosuè Carducci (1835–1907) is awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature.

998d798d-2347-571d-9cd6-15bd4a57d3b4.name: Livro de Cesário Verde
998d798d-2347-571d-9cd6-15bd4a57d3b4.description: Posthumous publication of the *Livro de Cesário Verde*, a compilation of the poetry of Cesário Verde (1855–86) by his friend, Silva Pinto, author of the Preface. An original poet who described a world previously unknown to poetry, Cesário Verde completely modernised the traditional style of the Portuguese lyricism.

99a83377-13c3-5bb1-a766-d812bb727188.name: Karlsbader Beschlüsse
99a83377-13c3-5bb1-a766-d812bb727188.description: The Karlsbader Beschlüsse (Carlsbad Decrees) was intended to suppress liberal and national movements through censorship of the press and political persecution.

99f85f3d-8888-5c6b-bd38-1adbddff587c.name: Pearling becomes the most important industry
99f85f3d-8888-5c6b-bd38-1adbddff587c.description: Pearling becomes the major industry of the Qawasim and other sheikhdoms of the Arab littoral of the Gulf; exports provide the most important revenues.

9a0151cb-2b30-58f0-89f8-80b6316ce4df.name: Experiments of electric street lightning in Turin and Milan
9a0151cb-2b30-58f0-89f8-80b6316ce4df.description: First experiments of electric street lighting in Turin and Milan.

9a016aa4-c91c-522a-871b-7f0d5470c39c.name: Champollion
9a016aa4-c91c-522a-871b-7f0d5470c39c.description: The scholar, philologist and Orientalist Jean-François Champollion (1790–1832) deciphers the Rosetta Stone hieroglyphs.

9a024698-3b5e-567e-be50-95605be6d9b3.name: The Two Red Years
9a024698-3b5e-567e-be50-95605be6d9b3.description: The “Two Red Years”: 2 million unemployed. Introduction of compulsory old-age, unemployment and disability insurances. High inflation and decrease of salaries. Intense workers’ mobilisation: strikes and occupations of land, factories and shipyards. Trade unions achieve minimum wage, 8-hour working day and recognition of factory commissions.

9a471f90-312e-52fa-a127-1c56234bc732.name: Sultan Abdülaziz visits Vienna
9a471f90-312e-52fa-a127-1c56234bc732.description: Sultan ‘Abd al-‘Aziz visits Vienna on 18 July.

9a6eeb77-3ff6-50d4-8a8a-9ef27b11a1d9.name: Spain's first Constitution of 1812
9a6eeb77-3ff6-50d4-8a8a-9ef27b11a1d9.description: Spain's first Constitution of 1812, influenced by the French Revolution, is revolutionary because it declares the Spanish American colonies to be provinces and all their inhabitants citizens. The constitution reduces some of the powers and privileges of the monarchy, aristocracy and church and will influence future post-independence South American constitutions. Up to 1876 Spain will change its constitution four times (1837, 1845, 1869, 1876).

9a9d0f31-977e-5700-8fe1-3601ddf7fb5c.name: Electricity production in millions of Kilowatt-hours

9aca0cbd-2b49-54c5-9584-b4244fb05dd1.name: Transjordan melting pot for different cultures
9aca0cbd-2b49-54c5-9584-b4244fb05dd1.description: Due to the very diverse composition of the Transjordanians with their different backgrounds – Arabs and non-Arabs, Muslims and Christians, settlers and nomads – Transjordan becomes the melting pot for different cultures. This is reflected in very diverse cultural artefacts (fashion and costumes, musical instruments and music, and dances) but more importantly in traditions and social behaviour.

9add12c7-e1b8-5970-beb8-75b8c1e94d9f.name: Opening of Applied Art Schools
9add12c7-e1b8-5970-beb8-75b8c1e94d9f.description: Opening of applied art schools, often attached to museums: Industrial Museum of Turin (1863), Artistic Industrial Museum of Rome (1873), Naples (1882) and Palermo (1885).

9b04f760-70ba-559c-9c4c-f93f7ee2e7af.name: Congress of Berlin
9b04f760-70ba-559c-9c4c-f93f7ee2e7af.description: Uprisings in the Balkan Ottoman territories lead to disproportionate reprisals. Popular protests in Britain oppose support for the Ottoman Empire. In contrast to the Crimean War, Britain provides no military aid to the Ottomans in their war with Russia. Diplomatic support is rewarded however, with Britain’s occupation of Cyprus confirmed at the Congress of Berlin.

9b0ea268-fca4-5b1c-bdcd-3904ad6f3846.name: Educational reform and restructure of the Zaytuna
9b0ea268-fca4-5b1c-bdcd-3904ad6f3846.description: Educational reform and restructuring of the Zaytuna Mosque through the introduction of new disciplines and incentives for teachers in Tunisia.

9b112d2f-13fc-52bf-a1a6-04d7d7ba7f77.name: William Henry Fox Talbot announces his calotype photography
9b112d2f-13fc-52bf-a1a6-04d7d7ba7f77.description: William Henry Fox Talbot announces his calotype photography, which, using a developing agent, drastically reduces exposure time. A negative image is created, from which it is possible to produce countless positive images. Talbot is keen to apply the technique to archaeological objects, and photography is then used increasingly for recording objects and sites.

9b2b1358-8caf-5edd-9920-05860f764130.name: Alexandru Ioan Cuza
9b2b1358-8caf-5edd-9920-05860f764130.description: 14 May: coup d’état of Alexandru Ioan Cuza, who dissolves parliament and proposes a new constitutional project, which is voted the same month and ratified by the Ottoman Empire and the guaranteeing Powers in June 1864. The *Statute Expanding the Paris Convention* assigned greater power to the prince and the government.

9b450048-55a3-5ab1-aec3-b1fa23980c1a.name: The first International Exhibition organized in Portugal
9b450048-55a3-5ab1-aec3-b1fa23980c1a.description: “A Exposição Internacional”, in Porto, is the first international exhibition organised in Portugal. Designed by the English architect Thomas Dillen Jones, it follows the London model and was conceived to accommodate the Portuguese International Exhibition.

9b5f4850-bd48-5ab0-a4d0-d194121af1a9.name: Rail network
9b5f4850-bd48-5ab0-a4d0-d194121af1a9.description: The rail network transforms German industry, and merchant shipping multiplies.

9b7f77db-0600-5029-aacf-678f450cd5c5.name: Indian migration to Aden
9b7f77db-0600-5029-aacf-678f450cd5c5.description: Aden becomes a British Crown Colony in 1839 administered (until 1937) not from London but from India. Indians migrating to practise trade and the professions help to duplicate what is happening in India, albeit in a smaller way, in the Gulf and Iraq.

9b840343-1920-501d-a993-002fcbc604d9.name: The Romanian Maritime Service, the first civil naval institution of Romania, is founded.
9b840343-1920-501d-a993-002fcbc604d9.description: The Romanian Maritime Service, the first civil naval institution of Romania, is founded. It is intended to buy and build ships and it ensures passenger and freight transportation on the route Brăila–Constanţa–Istanbul, later extended to Alexandria and to ports on the eastern shore of the Mediterranean: Pireu, Smyrna, Haifa and Beirut.

9b85c4b5-6390-52b9-b1c3-0f45fb1a9d68.name: Inauguration of the Opera House
9b85c4b5-6390-52b9-b1c3-0f45fb1a9d68.description: The Opera House is inaugurated in November 1869 with Verdi’s Opera *Rigoletto*. In attendance, seated in the Royal loge, are Khedive Isma‘il Pasha, Empress Eugénie and her husband Napoleon III, and François Joseph I of Austria.

9bd86d21-27d5-512d-959e-32c8217857d5.name: The Raft of the Medusa
9bd86d21-27d5-512d-959e-32c8217857d5.description: *The Raft of the Medusa*, by the Romantic painter Théodore Géricault.

9c2da1ed-84ff-5b27-9357-1a0a609415ab.name: The worst of the five cholera epidemics that hit Italy during the XIX century
9c2da1ed-84ff-5b27-9357-1a0a609415ab.description: The worst of the five cholera epidemics that hit Italy during the 19th century kills more than 160,000. The most affected towns are always Naples and Palermo.

9c6b48b5-25f0-53a4-8474-179e3ab5f7d5.name: Wilhelm Friedrich Hemprich and Christian Gottfried Ehrenberg
9c6b48b5-25f0-53a4-8474-179e3ab5f7d5.description: The German naturalists and explorers Wilhelm Friedrich Hemprich and Christian Gottfried Ehrenberg embark on a research tour in cooperation with Martin Lichtenstein (who published *Reisen im südlichen Afrika* (Tourism in Southern Africa) in 1810 and was appointed director of the Berlin Zoological Museum in 1813) from Cairo to Derna in Libya, along the Nile, and through the Sinai Desert and Lebanon, collecting natural and historical specimens.

9c8f81a8-ece3-5b44-97ed-f41a573fec3c.name: Isabel II comes of age in 1843
9c8f81a8-ece3-5b44-97ed-f41a573fec3c.description: Isabel II comes of age in 1843. During her reign the political parties are divided into liberals and conservatives. The Church regains its privileges under the 2nd Concordat signed in 1851. The Queen's rule ends in 1868 with the revolution known as La Gloriosa (the Glorious Revolution).

9c90f8d8-0e57-5f19-b36b-659de54b1f31.name: Britain and the development of railways in the Near East
9c90f8d8-0e57-5f19-b36b-659de54b1f31.description: Britain also holds a stake in the development of railways in the Near East. Egypt, as part of a global transport network and under British sponsorship, has a railway network before Norway does.

9d288960-20f8-5958-a78e-fd4a392d409d.name: Average annual Italian migration (1900-1909)
9d288960-20f8-5958-a78e-fd4a392d409d.description: Average annual Italian migration (temporary and permanent, to nearest 1,000): France 57,000; USA 233,000; Argentina 73,000; Brazil 30,000.

9d3b086b-e315-5dc0-b2ec-763dd9acc571.name: First law on migration
9d3b086b-e315-5dc0-b2ec-763dd9acc571.description: The first law on migration introduces measures aimed at preventing a married woman from migrating without her husband’s consent; at preventing men to migrate to avoid military service; and at granting migrants some protection against abuses.

9d8a7c8f-ad81-5516-b2bb-658af1cfc977.name: September revolution known as La Gloriosa
9d8a7c8f-ad81-5516-b2bb-658af1cfc977.description: Carlist wars, economic crisis (1866–68) and disgruntlement with Queen Isabel II and the government explode in the September revolution known as La Gloriosa. The revolution is followed by six years of democratic government under Amadeo I, from the Italian Saboya family, (1870–73) and then under the first Spanish Republic (1873–74), causing the 3rd Carlist war.

9da9e5a3-e6c3-5651-bf90-3349c0ed1a2b.name: Death of Theodor Herzl
9da9e5a3-e6c3-5651-bf90-3349c0ed1a2b.description: Theodor Herzl, founder of the Zionist movement, dies.

9dd8fa5a-379e-5e9b-a469-b70959e1d2a7.name: The old Egyptian port undergoes several important changes
9dd8fa5a-379e-5e9b-a469-b70959e1d2a7.description: The old Egyptian port undergoes several important changes: buildings are extended, a commercial tribunal is constructed, and the land area is expanded by infilling with rocks brought by railway from Nahr al-Kalb.

9ddf0116-f6b4-545d-84b7-d179ee81a69b.name: Triumph of the Opera (or Melodrama)
9ddf0116-f6b4-545d-84b7-d179ee81a69b.description: Triumph of the opera (or melodrama), a form of theatre born in the 17th century, in which the characters express themselves by singing. In the 19th century, this form of art becomes very popular in Europe. In Italy, the opera becomes the most important musical genre and overshadows all other musical forms.

9ded2c22-f1f2-546e-9285-f31a0c09cd09.name: El-Hakaneia Palace
9ded2c22-f1f2-546e-9285-f31a0c09cd09.description: El-Hakaneia Palace on Manshieh Square in Alexandria is designed by Alfonso Maniscalco in the Beaux-Arts tradition. Constructed as the seat of the “Mixed Tribunals” the building is still used as a courthouse today.

9df0c620-bf2e-5b22-813f-e0484b919e29.name: Exploratory missions in the Regency
9df0c620-bf2e-5b22-813f-e0484b919e29.description: Multiple exploratory missions and studies scoured the Regency of Tunis. These missions provided the first opportunity to discover the remains of antiquity and to open up new fields of research.

9e3acefe-50ed-5b9a-888f-8abed4a00169.name: School of Fine Arts for female students
9e3acefe-50ed-5b9a-888f-8abed4a00169.description: The School of Fine Arts for female students (İnâs Sanâyi-i Nefise Mektebi) is opened.

9e601e15-5f14-5c3e-b2a2-c62f78ffd74a.name: School of Medicine
9e601e15-5f14-5c3e-b2a2-c62f78ffd74a.description: A School of Medicine is established at Abu Za‘bal and annexed to the Military Hospital there due to the efforts of Clot Bek, a French physician. A fatwa is then issued by Sheikh Hasan al-Attar, which allowed anatomizing cadavers as long as it was done in order to prevent disease.

9e8153b2-8593-53b4-a2f8-0529f3d5fa39.name: Stale Popov
9e8153b2-8593-53b4-a2f8-0529f3d5fa39.description: Birth of writer Stale Popov in Melnca, Mariovo Region. He began writing early immortalising tales from Macedonian folk tradition about Itar Pejo (Smart Pejo). He achieved eminence after publication of his first novel *Patchwork Life*. His talent lay in introducing themes from social life. His other well-known novels are *Kalesh Angja* and *Tole Pasha*.

9e9ae2c5-e969-5e5b-8cc3-565d1b82762b.name: Teixeira de Pascoaes
9e9ae2c5-e969-5e5b-8cc3-565d1b82762b.description: Birth of Teixeira de Pascoaes (d. 1952). This poet was the main representative of the aesthetic and doctrinal movement called “saudosismo”, a form of existentialism, and a leader of the movement Renascença Portuguesa. In 1910 he launched in Porto the magazine *A Águia*, the main resource of the “saudosismo” movement .

9eec25bc-94a2-5050-bab0-40bc3334e90b.name: Creation of administrative districts
9eec25bc-94a2-5050-bab0-40bc3334e90b.description: Between 1866 and 1871 two administrative districts are created: *qada* (district) of Ajlun and *qada* of al-Salt. Ajlun is part of Hawran *mutasarrifiyyat* (province), while al-Salt is part of al-Balqa *mutasarrifiyyat*. In 1872 a new administrative region comprising al-Salt, Karak and al-Jawf (Tafila is integrated in 1892) is formed with Ma’an as the administrative centre, subsequently replaced by Karak in 1895.

9f11f880-c903-5d87-9639-e226caf1b7c8.name: Reform of economy
9f11f880-c903-5d87-9639-e226caf1b7c8.description: Khayr al-Din undertakes reform of the Tunisian economy.

9f47b81b-7e93-5cf1-a3f2-49c052046c7b.name: Orpheu magazine
9f47b81b-7e93-5cf1-a3f2-49c052046c7b.description: Publication of the only two issues of *Orpheu* magazine, thanks to the contribution of the most gifted figures of the modernist group. Without anything specifically programmatic, the magazine shows an iconoclastic irreverence, seeking notoriety by scandalising those holding traditional attitudes and customs.

9f6635a2-2594-5bb3-994b-1fd856f8b997.name: Birth of Mihai Eminescu
9f6635a2-2594-5bb3-994b-1fd856f8b997.description: January: the birth of Mihai Eminescu, who is considered to be the most important Romanian poet of the 19th century.

9f967f98-89d9-565b-b3e8-35244a172e12.name: The First World War
9f967f98-89d9-565b-b3e8-35244a172e12.description: The First World War, which left millions dead in France, leaves a lasting impact on society.

9fab67e6-7f7a-5411-aea1-b585f1068ba8.name: The new-born Italian state approves a Civil code that places women in a subordinate position in the family
9fab67e6-7f7a-5411-aea1-b585f1068ba8.description: The new-born Italian state approves a civil code that places women in a subordinate position in the family. Boys and girls can inherit equally, but married women need “marital authorisation” to manage their property. Male and female adultery are treated differently. The “defence of honour” is accepted as attenuating circumstance in murder cases.

9fb69e6a-703f-5a15-b4c2-c74d435a3aba.name: The foundation of the Academy of Science in Vienna
9fb69e6a-703f-5a15-b4c2-c74d435a3aba.description: Foundation of the Academy of Science in Vienna.

a00416f9-bacd-5434-af4e-2300882d3f35.name: The Constitution of 1876 is restored
a00416f9-bacd-5434-af4e-2300882d3f35.description: 23 July: The Constitution of 1876 is restored and the Committee of the Union and Congress (CUP) takes control over the administration.

a033389b-77f5-5fcd-ae0c-b62a86b5071d.name: The unpopular monopoly of the tobacco
a033389b-77f5-5fcd-ae0c-b62a86b5071d.description: The unpopular tobacco monopoly is ended by parliamentary law. Hereafter tobacco will be auctioned and exploited by those offering the best price to the state. Some of the main tobacco companies merge into bigger companies to ensure its exploration. The Companhia Lisbonense de Tabacos, founded in 1865, becomes a major player.

a05d226a-5c96-5025-a68a-5288e9c40fe4.name: Italy the first country to use a plane in war
a05d226a-5c96-5025-a68a-5288e9c40fe4.description: Italy is the first country to use a plane in war (the Italo-Turkish war, for the conquest of Libya). Planes cannot carry heavy weights, so the pilot carries in his pocket 1 kg bombs that he drops manually.

a07a35d3-517a-5733-a44e-ab15ff16e00b.name: Romanian independence and Russian-Ottoman war
a07a35d3-517a-5733-a44e-ab15ff16e00b.description: After Parliament declares Romania’s independence (May 1877), Romania participates alongside Russia in the Russian-Ottoman war. The Congress of Berlin (1878) recognises the independence of Romania, which receives the greater part of Dobruja, but cedes the south of Bessarabia to Russia. In March 1881 Romania is proclaimed a kingdom. Prince Carol and his wife Elizabeth are crowned as King and Queen of Romania in May in Bucharest.

a0ebd336-644e-5311-bbfa-bfb226f43990.name: The third initiative by Serpa Pinto and Augusto Cardoso
a0ebd336-644e-5311-bbfa-bfb226f43990.description: The third great expedition, undertaken by Serpa Pinto and Augusto Cardoso, aims to establish a trade corridor between the eastern region of lakes, and the coast of Mozambique. Major Serpa Pinto fell ill and was replaced by Augusto Cardoso who reached Quelimane after a journey of 2,500 km lasting 20 months, during which some agreements were signed with African chiefs.

a0ecd504-2cb6-56ff-b252-4c4058b96000.name: Foundation of the
a0ecd504-2cb6-56ff-b252-4c4058b96000.description: Foundation of the German field-workers central office (*Deutsche Feldarbeiter Zentralstelle*; later *Deutsche Arbeitszentrale*), initiated by the Prussian Ministry of Agriculture, in order to control work-based migration to Germany.

a0f5bf09-8965-5c37-bb04-4e2d20a8c144.name: Decree for the founding of the Commission of Public Monuments
a0f5bf09-8965-5c37-bb04-4e2d20a8c144.description: 18 April: decree for the founding of the Commission of Public Monuments to record the public monuments on Romanian territory and to ensure their conservation.

a1132be7-34b3-5b7f-b4a9-143b46694e91.name: 72,000 Muslims and Jews forced out of Bulgaria
a1132be7-34b3-5b7f-b4a9-143b46694e91.description: 72,000 Muslims and Jews are forced out of Bulgaria. Unlike earlier migrants, they are resettled in towns in Thrace as well as in rural areas of central and eastern Anatolia.

a14acba2-2890-5480-afc0-25ec75f925c0.name: The lost of the last overseas territories causes a big crisis
a14acba2-2890-5480-afc0-25ec75f925c0.description: The lost of the last overseas territories causes a big crisis. It is the moment for important writers and intellectuals such as Unamuno and Joaquin Costa, all members of what is called "Generación del ‘98” (Generation of ’98) to analyse the reasons for the crisis and look critically at Spain's past and its future.

a177a169-de1f-5568-9a64-abbc02dac4b6.name: Niepce's photograph
a177a169-de1f-5568-9a64-abbc02dac4b6.description: The inventor Nicéphore Niépce is credited with the creation of the first “photograph”.

a1d3b8ca-77df-511d-8701-fe0432208ed3.name: First educational mission of Egyptian students to Europe
a1d3b8ca-77df-511d-8701-fe0432208ed3.description: Muhammad ‘Ali sends the first educational “mission” of Egyptian students to Europe.

a243ad19-d20c-5f94-b415-81b04e7a6c36.name: Jordan was a part of the Ottoman Syria
a243ad19-d20c-5f94-b415-81b04e7a6c36.description: Jordan is a part of Ottoman Syria. Its importance lies in being a land bridge connecting Anatolia and Syria with north Arabia, Egypt and North Africa and hence the necessity of establishing Ottoman fortresses to guard the Syrian and Egyptian pilgrimage routes.

a2617605-242d-588c-96e8-184665651e7f.name: Having ascended to the throne too young, Mulay ‘Abd al ‘Aziz
a2617605-242d-588c-96e8-184665651e7f.description: Having ascended to the throne too young, Mulay ‘Abd al ‘Aziz must act under the regency of his father mulay al-Hasan I’s chamberlain for almost six years. Upon his father death in 1900, Mulay ‘Abd al ‘Aziz took up the reins of power and made clear his desire to restructure the governing institution of Morocco, the *Makhzen*. He worked on the modernisation of the army and stabilisation of the currency. He relaunched the project to ensure universal application of the *tartib* tax, which he wanted to apply to all foreigners and protégés. This project naturally displeased the consular corps.

a2702015-6ab1-5771-b009-e4198c1adc57.name: Giovanni Verga publishes the novel *I malavoglia*
a2702015-6ab1-5771-b009-e4198c1adc57.description: Giovanni Verga (1840–1922) publishes the novel *I malavoglia* (published in English as *The House by the Medlar-Tree*), which describes the life of a family of Sicilian fishermen. Verga was the most important author of the Italian realist school known as *verismo*.

a2795907-4197-5ad4-baba-569a07c686b0.name: The extension of Barcelona
a2795907-4197-5ad4-baba-569a07c686b0.description: Ildefonso Cerdá designs the "extension" of Barcelona in 1859. The orthogonal design of the streets creates a new neighbourhood: El Ensanche/L’Eixample. The development of wide streets such as Diagonal or Paseo de Gracia allows a new construction style, Modernismo/Modernisme, with buildings by Antonio Gaudí and Puig i Cadafalch.

a31fa56b-9aeb-5162-83f2-087d19ef0010.name: Internation Exhibition of 1900
a31fa56b-9aeb-5162-83f2-087d19ef0010.description: As if to compensate for its absence from the Paris 1878 and 1889 exhibitions, the Ottoman government spends a considerable sum on the pavilion for the Paris Internation Exhibition of 1900, designed by the French architect Adrien-René Dubuisson.

a3403bdb-9366-5d70-9205-71af2de3b129.name: Military actions in northern Morocco to prevent attacks by local tribesmen around Melilla
a3403bdb-9366-5d70-9205-71af2de3b129.description: Military actions in northern Morocco to prevent attacks by local tribesmen around Melilla are very unpopular in Spain because of forced levies. The levy decree of 1909 causes uprisings in Barcelona and other Catalonian cities known as Semana Trágica/Setmana Tràgica (Tragic Week). Spain is ultimately successful in the lengthy Rif War (1921–26) in preserving its rule over northern Morocco although in 1921 its army retreats with huge losses.

a348449d-edde-5555-b991-25dd0fa3c426.name: Digging of the Mahmudiya Canal
a348449d-edde-5555-b991-25dd0fa3c426.description: On 8 May Muhammad ‘Ali Pasha, the Ottoman Governor of Egypt, gives the order to start digging the Mahmudiya Canal, from the River Nile to Alexandria through al-Buhayra, to transport water and as a route for cargo ships.

a350beaf-f365-584b-bfae-cdf05e9206d6.name: Maternity fund for female workers established
a350beaf-f365-584b-bfae-cdf05e9206d6.description: Maternity fund for female workers established. Voluntary pension fund established.

a35c3a08-1043-5779-8a0d-9940207fc260.name: Associations of Macedonian emigrants
a35c3a08-1043-5779-8a0d-9940207fc260.description: A movement to awaken national awareness leads to the establishment of many independent associations of Macedonian emigrants, such as the Macedonian Literary Society established by Gjorgji Pulevski in Sofia in 1888.

a3abaf9f-7e5f-5f29-be43-6b3655322505.name: Diplomatic missions
a3abaf9f-7e5f-5f29-be43-6b3655322505.description: After his term as governor in Samos, Kostaki Musurus Paşa, a Phanariot Greek becomes the first Ottoman envoy to independent Athens (1840–47) followed by Vienna (1848) and London (1851–55).

a3b952aa-7896-589e-a630-83dca4c10ec5.name: he Austrian Emperor Franz Josef concluded a secret alliance
a3b952aa-7896-589e-a630-83dca4c10ec5.description: In October, the Austrian Emperor Franz Josef concludes a secret alliance with the Hohenzollern King of Romania, Carol I, against Russia.

a3e7092e-c0c7-59e1-b1f6-7b83df6c229a.name: With a thorough knowledge of the hinterland
a3e7092e-c0c7-59e1-b1f6-7b83df6c229a.description: With a thorough knowledge of the African hinterland, António da Silva Porto appeals to the Sociedade de Geografia to sponsor a plan for the scientific and commercial exploitation of Africa. The remote hinterland was about to be discovered by explorers and Africa’s boundaries defined by the colonial powers.

a3ec3a12-172e-5bee-ae59-d031004cb1f6.name: The Austrian Museum of Applied Art bought at the World Trade
a3ec3a12-172e-5bee-ae59-d031004cb1f6.description: At the World Trade Fair in Vienna, the Austrian Museum of Applied Art purchases a pair of jugs from Tunisia for the museum.

a434d1b0-8aa2-5792-809d-068b5cec4874.name: More than 5 million migrants from Russia and the Habsburg Empire
a434d1b0-8aa2-5792-809d-068b5cec4874.description: More than 5 million migrants from Russia and the Habsburg Empire journey through Germany on their way to America.

a4481df0-1f77-5e59-9bfe-89ceac191a0c.name: Treaty of Adrianople
a4481df0-1f77-5e59-9bfe-89ceac191a0c.description: 14 September: Treaty of Adrianople (present-day Edirne). This treaty secures Greek independence and strengthens the autonomy of Wallachia, Moldavia (Romania), and Serbia.

a4542f1a-532c-506f-a448-288128175770.name: Robert Koch discovers the agent tuberculosis
a4542f1a-532c-506f-a448-288128175770.description: Robert Koch discovers the cause of tuberculosis.

a4687fc0-1319-5f27-b029-2f55834032e5.name: Antonio Canova, acting on behalf of Pope Pio VII, recovers from France several pieces of art
a4687fc0-1319-5f27-b029-2f55834032e5.description: Antonio Canova, acting on behalf of Pope Pio VII, recovers from France several pieces of art belonging to the Papal States, which had been brought to Paris by Napoleon, including the Villa Borghese’s archaeological collection.

a47f8df6-a45d-5ec0-928a-8e7b5b7d7112.name: Archaeology Museum in Istanbul
a47f8df6-a45d-5ec0-928a-8e7b5b7d7112.description: 13 June: The Archaeology Museum in Istanbul is opened.

a49ea1de-a6ea-5f93-9947-d951ac3f847e.name: Women admitted at universities
a49ea1de-a6ea-5f93-9947-d951ac3f847e.description: Women are admitted to study at German universities.

a4b61adf-03b2-55b9-87a0-11237275dd61.name: The end of the race in the Mediterranean
a4b61adf-03b2-55b9-87a0-11237275dd61.description: The end of the race in the Mediterranean. For over 200 years the Regency of Tunis saw many free or enslaved Christians arrive from all over the Mediterranean Basin. The Oriental influx is due also to the presence of Turkish power.

a4c6ea9e-4c4a-5e24-861d-fe69c9556adc.name: The two Romanian pavilions at the International Exposition in Paris
a4c6ea9e-4c4a-5e24-861d-fe69c9556adc.description: The two Romanian pavilions at the International Exposition in Paris – a restaurant and a pavilion for wine tasting – are built by architect Ion Mincu, who uses elements of traditional rustic Romanian architecture.

a4fd0db5-c467-515f-b077-3bea6c1d456e.name: Cartilha Maternal
a4fd0db5-c467-515f-b077-3bea6c1d456e.description: Publication of Joao de Deus’s *Cartilha Maternal*, a beginner’s reading book that was to be in use for a long time. João de Deus was a follower of Maria Montessori’s pedagogical theories and founded in Portugal the “Escola Nova” movement.

a50276c4-b75d-57b9-af25-6310220e2d36.name: Osman Hamdi Bey excavates in Saida
a50276c4-b75d-57b9-af25-6310220e2d36.description: Osman Hamdi Bey excavates in Saida.

a50dfb42-5caf-54f0-8ae9-204eef7e7ed5.name: Allenby and Faysal I
a50dfb42-5caf-54f0-8ae9-204eef7e7ed5.description: British General Edmund Allenby and Faysal I, son of Sharif Husayn of Mecca, move into Palestine with British and Arab forces, thus opening the way for the occupation of Lebanon.

a55caa7c-6e95-5fe7-a176-330349f44e07.name: Slataper from Trieste published his autobiography
a55caa7c-6e95-5fe7-a176-330349f44e07.description: The Italian writer Scipio Slataper publishes his autobiography in which he describes the multinational character of the Littoral (the countryside around his home in Trieste).

a5687404-984c-5e41-b287-a1a213006a65.name: Colonial Exhibition in Paris
a5687404-984c-5e41-b287-a1a213006a65.description: Colonial Exhibition in Paris. After the success of the first international exhibition known as the Great Exhibition in London in 1851, international exhibitions become more specialised as colonial exhibitions from 1866. These exhibitions, held in European cities until 1948, depict life in the colonial territories.

a58c0fa7-568f-5142-a04a-ed1fe9cd0850.name: Sigmund Freud
a58c0fa7-568f-5142-a04a-ed1fe9cd0850.description: Sigmund Freud (1856–1939) is born in Moravia; he emigrates from Moravia to Vienna.

a59d4669-35e7-509e-9bc1-55df30d229ee.name: Exhibition of work by the members of the Omada Technis
a59d4669-35e7-509e-9bc1-55df30d229ee.description: An exhibition by members of the *Omada Technis* (Art Group), which includes Nikolaos Lytras, Konstantinos Parthenis, Konstantinos Malea and others, reacts to the conservative academicism of the Munich school.

a5c7a47a-535c-598e-a1fd-1c6cc68fcccc.name: Completion of Port of La Goulette
a5c7a47a-535c-598e-a1fd-1c6cc68fcccc.description: Completion of the Port of La Goulette; a large, modern complex accessible to large vessels, brings development to the city of Tunis.

a5d988c8-1826-5709-ad6c-746fc2245dc4.name: Mulay ‘Abd al ‘Aziz is deposed and replaced by his brother Mulay ‘Abd al-Hafiz
a5d988c8-1826-5709-ad6c-746fc2245dc4.description: Mulay ‘Abd al ‘Aziz is deposed and replaced by his brother Mulay ‘Abd al-Hafiz (1908–12), who is proclaimed ruler in Marrakesh on 6 August 1907. He was then obliged to sign the treaty establishing the protectorate in Fez on 20 March 1912.

a61cb492-551b-59fa-b57a-fcb158335d7e.name: Part of the Old Serail in Zahlé is used to house the local prison
a61cb492-551b-59fa-b57a-fcb158335d7e.description: Part of the Old Serail in Zahlé is used to house the local prison, with severe overcrowding. The prison was moved to a better location in 2009. Still known as the Old Serail, the restored monument today serves as the Town Hall and houses the offices of the municipality and a museum illustrating Zahlé’s history.

a6876571-f6b1-5dcf-a508-4157dc41b66b.name: Steamship arrived at Tagus river
a6876571-f6b1-5dcf-a508-4157dc41b66b.description: 14 October: The steamship *Conde de Palmela* arrives on the Tagus River. Built in Liverpool by Mottershead and Hays, it was commissioned by the Portuguese consul there. It is said to be the first ship to cross the Biscay, a journey of 1,000 miles, and the first steamship to be seen in Portugal.

a6950bb3-f487-5446-9fb0-97ad712b7855.name: Average annual number of Italian migrants to the United States of America, Argentina and Brazil
a6950bb3-f487-5446-9fb0-97ad712b7855.description: Italians who had migrated to the USA, Argentina and Brazil repatriate to Italy in large numbers during the 1900s: the annual average is 119,857 from the USA; 31,712 from Argentina; 19,864 from Brazil.

a6956e23-a78e-50dc-bd79-1348e429f77b.name: Law on State quinine
a6956e23-a78e-50dc-bd79-1348e429f77b.description: Law on “state quinine” passed: in order to fight malaria, the state will produce quinine and sell it at a low price not only in the 5,000 pharmacies, but also in the 27,000 tobacconists.

a715f17c-d9b6-5bb6-8b56-ca66ccacf6af.name: Giacomo Leopardi
a715f17c-d9b6-5bb6-8b56-ca66ccacf6af.description: Giacomo Leopardi (1798–1837), philosopher, scholar and one of the greatest Italian poets of all times, writes his first poem.

a71cd346-f488-5849-bcfc-f2e0c0fe9e33.name: Era of literature Romanticism
a71cd346-f488-5849-bcfc-f2e0c0fe9e33.description: The era of Romanticism or *Blaue Blume* in literature (i.e. the works of Tieck, von Kleist, Hebel, Hoffmann, the Brothers Grimm and von Eichendorff) is characterised by the desire for far-away places, and imbued with irony, passion, nocturnal mystery and mythical creatures.

a75d6153-1e59-576d-9f80-a5721ef89029.name: New agricultural villages in Transjordan
a75d6153-1e59-576d-9f80-a5721ef89029.description: Circassian and Chechen refugees settled by the Ottomans help to create new agricultural villages in Transjordan.
