Two waves of immigrants reach Jordan between 1878 and 1906. The first wave (1878–84) settles in Amman, Wadi al-Sir and Jerash, and the second wave (1901–06) in Na’ur, al-Zarqa, Sukhna, Rusayfa and Suwaylih. A Turkmen community founds a village at al-Rumman in the area of Jerash. Christian families from al-Salt establish new villages in al-Fuhays and Rumaymin while Christian settlers from Karak settle in Madaba. Palestinian and Damascene merchants to settle in al-Salt, Karak, Ajlun and, later, Amman.

a77ee7a1-daf8-5c7c-800b-c37f4fe77dc4.name: Telephones set up between cities
a77ee7a1-daf8-5c7c-800b-c37f4fe77dc4.description: Telephone communication is established between the cities of Piraeus and Syros (underwater), and Athens and Patras.

a8211209-405f-5026-bcd9-dae1898027a7.name: Museum Island Berlin
a8211209-405f-5026-bcd9-dae1898027a7.description: The building of Museumsinsel (Museum Island) in Berlin.

a82d8656-48f9-5319-a09b-fd380caeabf2.name: Sympathizers of Tawhidi movement
a82d8656-48f9-5319-a09b-fd380caeabf2.description: The British dismiss a former teacher of al-Taimiyyah School and a *Qadi* in Sharjah for sympathising publicly with the Tawhidi (Wahhabi) movement in Najd.

a8514a9b-6ee5-50c4-b0a3-fe039e11c9d5.name: Alexandria Futures Market
a8514a9b-6ee5-50c4-b0a3-fe039e11c9d5.description: Alexandria’s Futures Market is one of the oldest in the world. The first recorded local cotton transaction takes place in 1885 in Café de l’Europe on the Place des Consuls, later renamed Muhammad ‘Ali Square. It is here that cotton merchants meet and cut deals based on supply and demand for the long staple, Karnak and Menuf, or the short to medium staple, Ashmuni, Giza and Zagora. Over the years, deals extend to cottonseed varieties such as Hull, Afifi and Sakellaridis.

a88af4c8-ecc9-564a-b354-a2bf49e34b19.name: Archaeological finds given to France
a88af4c8-ecc9-564a-b354-a2bf49e34b19.description: Sultan Mahmud II gave some parts of the bas reliefs of the temple of Assos to France and he also authorises French archaeologist Charles Texier (1802–71) to take away parts of the frieze from the temple of Artemis in Magnesia ad Meandrum.

a8b2889d-7ab4-5e6c-a382-56b3681070d0.name: The beginning of the independence process in the Spanish territories in South America and Mexico
a8b2889d-7ab4-5e6c-a382-56b3681070d0.description: The beginning of the independence process in the Spanish territories in South America and Mexico, influenced by the American and French revolutions. The first Declaration of Independence is in Ecuador in 1809 and the American process ends in 1898 with Cuba, followed by the independence of the Philippines and the selling of the Carolinas and the Mariana islands to Germany in 1899.

a8e5165f-a4db-5b66-848b-fd0c11b47945.name: Alfredo da Silva refounded CUF
a8e5165f-a4db-5b66-848b-fd0c11b47945.description: Industrialist Alfredo da Silva refounds CUF (Companhia União Fabril), in Barreiro in the beginning of the 20th century. CUF produced soap, candles and vegetable oils, later becoming a leader of the fertilizer and other chemical products sector. Da Silva gave residential quarters and free education to all his employees nationwide.

a91de381-cb9a-50da-a509-59cf4f09cc26.name: The Karabagh carpet is bought by the Museum of Applied Arts in Istanbul
a91de381-cb9a-50da-a509-59cf4f09cc26.description: The Museum of Applied Arts in Vienna purchases the Karabakh carpet in Istanbul.

a93e0f2b-c9d0-5eb2-bc7e-9759a4c90308.name: War between Druse and Maronite
a93e0f2b-c9d0-5eb2-bc7e-9759a4c90308.description: A full-scale war erupts between Maronites and Druze. Napoleon III of France sends 7,000 troops to Beirut and helps impose a partition: Druze control of the territory is recognised as the fact on the ground, and the Maronites are forced into an enclave. This is ratified by the Concert of Europe in 1861.

a9417efe-ca91-5283-b61e-32fa5bc518c4.name: Notable increase in the activity of foreign powers
a9417efe-ca91-5283-b61e-32fa5bc518c4.description: There is a notable increase in the activity of foreign powers – especially Ottoman Turkey, France and Russia – in the Gulf region. Germany also makes its first appearance. The main interests for all of them are economic and geostrategic.

a9644ca1-7dd9-56ed-be69-b3e481da2cf8.name: Art Nouveau marks the city’s landscape
a9644ca1-7dd9-56ed-be69-b3e481da2cf8.description: Art Nouveau marks the city’s landscape.

a983f4a6-896f-5c3c-a978-78bc1685980b.name: Metro in Paris
a983f4a6-896f-5c3c-a978-78bc1685980b.description: The first line of the Paris Metro is built for the second Universal Exhibition.

a99eda35-9cd3-58df-9030-85aceacc8093.name: Decree freeing all slaves
a99eda35-9cd3-58df-9030-85aceacc8093.description: Ahmad Pasha Bey promulgates a decree freeing all black slaves in the country. Everyone born in Tunisia is declared free regardless of their parents’ origins.

a99f6680-69d3-56d2-8e9d-c9303027390a.name: Establishment of the Museum of the pre-Roman Antiquities of Latium
a99f6680-69d3-56d2-8e9d-c9303027390a.description: Establishment of the Museum of the pre-Roman Antiquities of Latium in the 16th-century Villa Giulia, in Rome. The museum would be later renamed the National Etruscan Museum.

a9df0e9e-1116-5283-9e9e-66c440301134.name: First public library
a9df0e9e-1116-5283-9e9e-66c440301134.description: 28 September: Bayezid Kütüphânesi, the first public library in İstanbul is founded.

aa6ba8ba-f1d0-5861-afc7-81e92149e8a2.name: Reign of Ahmad Pasha Bey
aa6ba8ba-f1d0-5861-afc7-81e92149e8a2.description: Ahmad Pasha Bey is known as the “Great Reformer” of modern Tunisia. Enlightened and open-minded, he tries to modernise both State and Army.

aa7927b7-dfd9-5c42-9c17-c073d35ade02.name: Mehmed Hüsrev Pasha
aa7927b7-dfd9-5c42-9c17-c073d35ade02.description: Mehmed Hüsrev Pasha commands 6,000 Turkish troops to assist the British in expelling the French from Rashid. For this he is assigned Governor of Egypt.

aa7e4844-6a13-5adb-b193-250d1dd40105.name: Rustam Pasha
aa7e4844-6a13-5adb-b193-250d1dd40105.description: Ottomans appoint Rustam Pasha as *mutasarrif* (governor). He is an equally firm and economical administrator.

aa85e5a8-c445-52e6-9644-eef9d6f86a45.name: Development of a railway network
aa85e5a8-c445-52e6-9644-eef9d6f86a45.description: Development of a railway network across the whole of Germany, much of which still exists today. The most important stations are developed during this period, including: Berlin Ostbahnhof (1842), Nürnberg Central Station (1844), Duisburg Central Station (1846) and Munich Central Station (1849).

aac8991d-b20e-5705-af71-191ca916a821.name: Francesco Hayez paints I Vespri Siciliani
aac8991d-b20e-5705-af71-191ca916a821.description: Francesco Hayez paints *I Vespri Siciliani*, a historical painting expressing the new revolutionary and independence ideas that are taking root in Italy.

ab290147-4a94-5e16-a451-56a1ecb76351.name: Building of the Bagdad Railway
ab290147-4a94-5e16-a451-56a1ecb76351.description: The Bagdadbahn (the so-called Bagdad Railway project) was built through a section of the Ottoman Empire (Turkey, Syria and Iran) and stretched for around 3,200 km. Together with the Hijaz Railway (opened 1908–closed 1920) it was constructed under the auspices of ‘Abd al-Hamid II, primarily to facilitate pilgrims wanting to travel directly from Damascus to Medina and Mecca. The German Empire was the main sponsor of this huge infrastructure project: the director of engineering was Heinrich August Meißner (responsible for several railways in the Ottoman Empire) and many German manufacturers (i.e. Friedrich von Krupp AG, and Borsig) grew as a result of its construction. However, while both railways strengthened the Sultan’s reputation, there were important military and economic uses as well, for the Ottomans were federates of the German Empire during World War I.

ab322bec-d1fc-5eb3-84e0-090e00ea5f7a.name: General Directorate of the Post and the Telegraph
ab322bec-d1fc-5eb3-84e0-090e00ea5f7a.description: 4 August: establishment of the General Directorate of the Post and the Telegraph in the United Principalities.

ab3e088e-acc4-555a-8ec6-e07e71f44e1f.name: White houses of Capri
ab3e088e-acc4-555a-8ec6-e07e71f44e1f.description: *White Houses of Capri* by naturalist painter António Carvalho da Silva Porto (1850–93) represents the new interest in travelling and other cultures.

ab497b71-c3dd-5089-844d-37d83d0946af.name: Hans Makart designed the parade to celebrate the silver wedding anniversary of the Imperial couple
ab497b71-c3dd-5089-844d-37d83d0946af.description: Hans Makart (1840–84) designs the “Makart Parade” to celebrate the Silver wedding anniversary of the Imperial couple, Emperor Franz Joseph I of Austria and Empress Elisabeth (“Sisi”).

ab511d69-3d0e-53f4-a0d4-85b5930f1d19.name: Centennial International Exhibition
ab511d69-3d0e-53f4-a0d4-85b5930f1d19.description: “Centennial International Exhibition” Philadelphia, USA. Support for visitors and accommodation of the Portuguese Commissariat were the main purposes of a stylish and exotic Portugal Pavilion.

abdb1545-3849-59f4-8947-3b57491be292.name: Treaty to prohibit the import of arms
abdb1545-3849-59f4-8947-3b57491be292.description: The Qawasim and other sheikhs of the Arab littoral agree by Treaty to prohibit the import of arms into their territories.

abe9e118-d955-57c3-bbc3-b740da850f61.name: The Banco Español de San Fernando
abe9e118-d955-57c3-bbc3-b740da850f61.description: The Banco Español de San Fernando absorbs the highly indebted Banco Nacional de San Carlos, founded in 1782, thus becoming in fact the first Spanish bank. The bank continues as such until 1856, when it becomes Banco de España, the central Bank of Spain.

ac1f568e-2f21-513e-8fa5-0c1a7b33c348.name: Creation of the first analytical laboratory
ac1f568e-2f21-513e-8fa5-0c1a7b33c348.description: Creation of the first analytical laboratory as part of the services that later became the Pasteur Institute, initially providing a rabies treatment service, and then offering a vaccination centre.

ac3dc28f-5bb6-5415-bf21-f8332ccf320c.name: 25 piaster notes and Government currency notes
ac3dc28f-5bb6-5415-bf21-f8332ccf320c.description: More paper currency enters circulation: the 25 piaster together with the five and 10 piaster.

ac6b6933-5006-5764-b55a-7c04c8eb0008.name: Carinthia remains within Austria
ac6b6933-5006-5764-b55a-7c04c8eb0008.description: The population of Carinthia in southernmost Austria votes in favour of remaining within Austria.

ac7675fd-3117-5c7d-99de-6c9f534988ea.name: Foundation of ministries
ac7675fd-3117-5c7d-99de-6c9f534988ea.description: Founding of the Ministry of Finance and formation of Sublime Council for Judicial Ordinances. The title “grand vizier” becomes “prime minister".

ac99116a-3419-5caf-9377-c64f40766267.name: Beginning of the Italian immigration in the Romanian countries
ac99116a-3419-5caf-9377-c64f40766267.description: The mid-19th century is the beginning of Italian immigration in the Romanian countries. For 1868, the presence of approximately 600 Italian workers in Romania is documented. Italian intellectuals and artists also settle in Romania, such as composer, director and music professor Alfons Castaldi.

acd7b46a-da0d-5060-a290-4a567127f7d4.name: The 1906 Intercalated Games or 1906 Olympic Games
acd7b46a-da0d-5060-a290-4a567127f7d4.description: The Intercalated or Olympic Games are held in Athens. An international multi-sport event, many people consider them to be the Olympic Games. The International Olympic Committee refers to them as the “Second International Olympic Games in Athens”.

acdb615f-e080-5378-9365-bdd0b4f90d4c.name: Giacchino Rossini puts on stage The Barber of Seville
acdb615f-e080-5378-9365-bdd0b4f90d4c.description: Gioachino Rossini (1795–1868), the young director of the San Carlo Theatre of Naples, the most important opera house at the time, puts on stage in Rome the *Barber of Seville*. The opera, thanks to its easy and passionate pacing, sets a new benchmark for the light operatic style, namely, the *opera buffa* (comic opera).

ad033b90-19bc-5a4f-b0ce-f37f0f11d2ac.name: Law on free distribution of quinine
ad033b90-19bc-5a4f-b0ce-f37f0f11d2ac.description: Law on free distribution of quinine to peasants and workers in malaria-infested areas.

ad4c3183-2adb-5e9a-ba27-00b15b3b2514.name: Abwehrpolitik law
ad4c3183-2adb-5e9a-ba27-00b15b3b2514.description: The Prussian policy of *Abwehrpolitik* sees Polish seasonal workers in agriculture forced to leave the German Empire during winter.

ad713ada-c48d-5aa8-96e1-650eb6f2149d.name: Indiana, by G. Sand
ad713ada-c48d-5aa8-96e1-650eb6f2149d.description: George Sand (Amantine Aurore Dupin) writes *Indiana*, a novel about a woman’s emotional journey.

add1b197-5410-508e-babd-58b1d2d33ea4.name: Promotion of Art Deco at the International Exhibition
add1b197-5410-508e-babd-58b1d2d33ea4.description: Promotion of Art Deco at the International Exhibition of Modern Industrial and Decorative Arts, Paris.

ae07e862-2c18-5bd3-8f59-5104be0220c2.name: Municipal town councils
ae07e862-2c18-5bd3-8f59-5104be0220c2.description: Under the reign of Muhammad Pasha Bey a major reform is carried out: the capital, Tunis, is established as a municipal town and a city council is elected. Further municipal towns were created in other parts of the country: Sfax, Sousse and Kairouan among others.

ae1b76a6-332c-5fac-8a65-054bacbd9137.name: O Alfageme de Santarém
ae1b76a6-332c-5fac-8a65-054bacbd9137.description: Publication of *O Alfageme de Santarém*, a drama by Almeida Garret (1799–1854). The subject is the dynastic crisis of 1383–85 when the Portuguese kingdom was invaded by Juan I of Castille, married to the heir to the Portuguese throne, Princess Beatriz. In 1385, acclaimed King João I of Avis with Lady Philippa of Lancaster created the dynasty of Avis, responsible for the era of the Discoveries.

ae1c679a-1d17-52a6-9aa6-57fcb1e6f233.name: Zionism
ae1c679a-1d17-52a6-9aa6-57fcb1e6f233.description: European Zionism initiates a small migration, mostly from Russia – especially after the pogroms – to Palestine. Among the Jewish community in Palestine are ancestors of Jewish migrants from the 15th and 16th centuries who fled the Iberian Peninsula after their expulsion by Ferdinand and Isabella.

aedb2eeb-e5a0-59d2-947d-9d0e59dca69e.name: Reorganization of the bureaucracy
aedb2eeb-e5a0-59d2-947d-9d0e59dca69e.description: Reorganisation of the bureaucracy and introduction of a new system of rank.

af01da1d-de65-5d2f-a86d-92ccceaac9ac.name: Owen Jones visits Granada and the Alhambra
af01da1d-de65-5d2f-a86d-92ccceaac9ac.description: During his Grand Tour, after visiting Italy, Greece and Egypt, Owen Jones visits Granada and the Alhambra. His six month stay in the Alhambra is very important in the development of his ideas about polychromy and design.

af124c7e-fd9a-500d-a091-42869d5c85b3.name: Sharjah town is surveyed by surveyors of the British Royal Navy
af124c7e-fd9a-500d-a091-42869d5c85b3.description: British Royal Navy surveyors visit Sharjah.

af28fca7-bb8c-5944-b735-7537a932742b.name: Foundation of Jerusalem Bishopric
af28fca7-bb8c-5944-b735-7537a932742b.description: Evangelists in Britain and Germany found the Jerusalem Protestant bishopric. There is an idea of converting Jews – the first bishop is a converted Jew – and the bishopric establishes a British cultural and educational interest in the Levant. It also stimulates archaeological work.

af5d9095-8c18-5bd0-8efc-728f6ddb2292.name: The Club Alpino Italiano is founded in Turin
af5d9095-8c18-5bd0-8efc-728f6ddb2292.description: The Club Alpino Italiano is founded in Turin. Its goal is “to promote the knowledge of mountains, and especially of Italian mountains, their ascent and scientific expeditions”. In 25 years, membership reaches 4,500 with 34 local branches. By 1900 it had built 57 mountain huts.

af80b5e5-a8f1-594b-a810-5cc82b711241.name: Brandenburg Gate was built
af80b5e5-a8f1-594b-a810-5cc82b711241.description: The Brandenburg Gate is built, today it a famous landmark of German reunification.

af812a99-2a85-58fb-8789-739affab7016.name: Emancipation of gypsy slaves
af812a99-2a85-58fb-8789-739affab7016.description: In Moldavia (22 December 1855) and then in Wallachia (20 February 1856) a law for the emancipation of the gypsy slaves of private owners is passed. Gypsies belonging to the church and to the state had already been liberated.

af92a6d2-d9c6-5177-992f-a62c4d3ddca0.name: Russo-Turco Treaty of St. Stefano
af92a6d2-d9c6-5177-992f-a62c4d3ddca0.description: 3 March: Russo-Turco Treaty of St Stefano defines Bulgaria, which includes present-day Bulgaria, present-day Macedonia and northern Greece.

af975ee3-471e-577c-9010-5d58e9226381.name: Bedrich Smetana's The Bartered Bride
af975ee3-471e-577c-9010-5d58e9226381.description: Bedrich Smetana's (1824–1884) opera *Verkaufte Braut* (*The Bartered Bride*) had its first performance in Prague.

afac2d2c-6e28-55f5-a0e2-c623909ca69b.name: Photography
afac2d2c-6e28-55f5-a0e2-c623909ca69b.description: The invention of photography by Nicéphore Niépce.

aff64a8c-5f93-555d-81d7-4232b4510f54.name: Beirut Water Works factory is founded
aff64a8c-5f93-555d-81d7-4232b4510f54.description: Beirut Water Works factory is founded, providing water for daily use by the Lebanese people, taking water from Nahr al-Kalb and distributing it through an extensive water network.

b014cbf3-daf2-5321-94e7-5cf348f045c9.name: Hijaz Railway
b014cbf3-daf2-5321-94e7-5cf348f045c9.description: Hijaz Railway is developed by ‘Abd al-Hamid II (1876–1908) for various reasons, not least of which is to strengthen the Empire’s control in an area that is the only window for the Ottomans to trade with the Far East after the British took control of the major international trade routes (Suez Canal and Arab-Persian Gulf). Supported by Germany, which is seeking control in this area to oppose the British, work on the project, and inauguration of stations coincides with the annual anniversary of the Sultan’s accession on 1 September. The line reaches Amman in 1903, Ma’an in 1904 and Mudawwara in 1906. The 1,450 km railway reaches Medina in 1908.

b09b3452-2f7f-5bb4-800f-901d12e43664.name: Modern education in Egypt with the School of Engineering
b09b3452-2f7f-5bb4-800f-901d12e43664.description: Modern education in Egypt starts with the School of Engineering, which is established by Muhammad ‘Ali in the Castle during 1816, to train and prepare specialists in that area.

b0b5bd20-8e75-53e2-b059-c6ce431df110.name: The Egyptian Exchange
b0b5bd20-8e75-53e2-b059-c6ce431df110.description: The Egyptian Exchange, one of the oldest stock markets in the Middle East, traces its origins to 1883 when the Alexandria Stock Exchange is established, followed by the Cairo Stock Exchange in 1903.

b0c4b588-f9ee-5151-a40a-e90c1cca7596.name: Avenida Ressano Garcia, a main residential area and development axe opens in the North of Lisbon
b0c4b588-f9ee-5151-a40a-e90c1cca7596.description: Avenida Ressano Garcia, a main residential area and development axis opens in the north of Lisbon as part of the “Avenidas Novas” plan. Part of a later phase of the Lisbon Improvements Plan, led by Frederico Ressano Garcia, it also included sanitation improvement. Today the street is known as Avenida da República.

b0e81bf6-717f-5f5d-8d95-fcd1234c335f.name: Bureaucracy is reorganised
b0e81bf6-717f-5f5d-8d95-fcd1234c335f.description: Bureaucracy is reorganised and a new rank system is introduced.

b0ecbe0e-4d3c-55b1-b6c6-c928acb19215.name: Celebrations of the 3rd Centenary of the death of Luís de Camões
b0ecbe0e-4d3c-55b1-b6c6-c928acb19215.description: Celebration of the third centenary of the death of Luís de Camões. His poetry is considered the epitome of Portuguese literature both for *The Lusiad*s, the epic national poem in which Vasco da Gama tells the history of Portugal to the Samorim (king) of Calcutta upon his arrival in India in 1498, and for his love sonnets.

b13a64f5-8c3a-54eb-a033-7631f1398912.name: The first tourism organisation
b13a64f5-8c3a-54eb-a033-7631f1398912.description: The first tourism organisation from Romania, called the Alpine Association of Transylvania, is founded in Braşov.

b174d992-c614-54a1-ae0c-aaa514cb2095.name: International exhibition on electricity
b174d992-c614-54a1-ae0c-aaa514cb2095.description: The Paris-based International Exhibition of Electricity presents the telephone and light bulbs.

b1c53a29-1dcf-5ccd-9208-caf0185f76d8.name: Pena Palace started to be built in Sintra
b1c53a29-1dcf-5ccd-9208-caf0185f76d8.description: Building of Pena Palace in Sintra, close to Lisbon, begins. This eclectic summer residence, commissioned by King Fernando II, combines Neo-Manueline, Neo-Islamic and Neo-Renaissance styles. The use of the Islamic decorative influences in a royal palace contributes to the Portuguese society’s acknowledgement of its Islamic past.

b1efa30e-4b5b-5234-9bdc-5093b0fab03b.name: Caffe Michelangelo and artists
b1efa30e-4b5b-5234-9bdc-5093b0fab03b.description: The Caffé Michelangelo in Florence becomes a meeting place for artists and republican intellectuals close to Giuseppe Mazzini, in opposition to academic and official environments.

b20a151f-3e49-5055-a747-5fb897245e37.name: The Regicide in 1908 was fomented
b20a151f-3e49-5055-a747-5fb897245e37.description: 1 February: The assassination of King Carlos I and his heir-apparent Prince Royal Luis Filipe in Terreiro do Paço in central Lisbon, fomented by, among other things, the King’s appointment of João Franco as head of government in 1906; with the King’s consent he set up a dictatorship one year later. Queen Amelia and Prince Manuel escape and the prince is enthroned as King Manuel II.

b2477e5d-3b31-5a12-9748-fd50b554f353.name: The Austrian glass manufacturing company Lobmayr made glass cups in the Oriental Style
b2477e5d-3b31-5a12-9748-fd50b554f353.description: The Austrian glass manufacture Lobmayr produces glass cups in the Oriental Style.

b260df93-74e4-5cce-b333-2c5f8343e1c1.name: Meisterwerke muhammedanischer Kunst
b260df93-74e4-5cce-b333-2c5f8343e1c1.description: “Meisterwerke muhammedanischer Kunst” (Masterpieces of Islamic Art) exhibition in Munich displaying more than 3,600 artefacts. The exhibition gives Islamic art and archaeology a new push in the academic world and is considered a turning point in the orientalist view of and romantic passion for Islamic art and culture.

b270bdbe-6be4-54c5-ada3-d9ad481b2a9f.name: Act of Union
b270bdbe-6be4-54c5-ada3-d9ad481b2a9f.description: The Irish Rebellion of 1798, which was intended to put an end to what Irish nationalists perceived as the subordination and dependency of Ireland on the British crown, instead contributes to the Irish parliament’s vote to join the union between the kingdoms of Great Britain and Ireland. On 1 January 1801, Britain, Scotland and Ireland sign the Act of Union and merge, to form the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland.

b27cfd88-ffee-5b6e-8860-fe7509eb8f3e.name: Building of a submarine
b27cfd88-ffee-5b6e-8860-fe7509eb8f3e.description: Building of a submarine (*aparato de profundidades*) designed by a naval officer, Isaac Peral. The boat (22 x 2.87 metres) is driven by electric engines and has a periscope and three torpedos. In spite of a successful test, the Spanish Navy decides not to put the prototype into production.

b28c9df7-14e9-5e9c-bf74-f08fcc4ae941.name: Treaty of Union
b28c9df7-14e9-5e9c-bf74-f08fcc4ae941.description: The Kingdom of Great Britain comes into being under the Treaty of Union of the kingdoms of England (which then included Wales) and Scotland on 1 May 1707. It lasts, controlled under a single parliament and government based at Westminster, up until 31 December 1800.

b29cf67a-af26-5552-a48f-3946ea0e3056.name: Roentgen ray is discovered
b29cf67a-af26-5552-a48f-3946ea0e3056.description: The Roentgen ray (X-Ray) is discovered by Wilhelm Conrad Roentgen.

b29dd523-6e79-59fb-a773-9e3eac627c94.name: The painters Dórdio Gomes
b29dd523-6e79-59fb-a773-9e3eac627c94.description: The painters Dórdio Gomes (1890–1976) and Guilherme de Santa Rita (1889–1918) introduce modernism in Portugal. Largely unaccepted by the critics, as was happening in other European countries, the main focus of the modernists was to fight against the conservatism of techniques and themes still cherished by Portuguese art consumers.

b2a49d14-c7cf-55e8-81da-570710cf8e5a.name: Phylloxera Commission created by the Government
b2a49d14-c7cf-55e8-81da-570710cf8e5a.description: Phylloxera Commission created by the government in order to protect vineyards from the disease. To combat the disease demands new methods of planting and production. New organisations of wine producers claim from central government the preservation of regional varieties as well as the definition and defence of Port and Douro wine “Denominação de Origem Controlada”.

b3b045d8-96dc-5a9a-a3f3-63b47e59464b.name: Diplomatic Conference of the Metre
b3b045d8-96dc-5a9a-a3f3-63b47e59464b.description: In 1875 the French government convenes the Diplomatic Conference of the Metre that proclaims the Metre Convention. Portugal receives the tenth copies of the metric and kilogram standards.

b3e2784a-9bf8-5139-bcdb-37585fe2ea43.name: Opening of the School of Fine Arts
b3e2784a-9bf8-5139-bcdb-37585fe2ea43.description: Opening of the School of Fine Arts (Sanâyi-i Nefise Mektebi) by Osman Hamdi Bey. It consists of sections for painting, sculpture and architecture.

b3e72002-c909-5f0c-b8ce-2a1b2f9f4036.name: Egypt political status under Ottomans
b3e72002-c909-5f0c-b8ce-2a1b2f9f4036.description: During this time Egypt is a legally nominal Ottoman province governed by a *wali* on behalf of the Ottoman Sultan, although *de facto* it is virtually independent, with its *wali*s styling themselves as Khedives. Despite their legally subservient status, Egypt’s walis enjoy far more political power than their descendants, who, decades later, rule the country as nominally independent sultans and kings.

b43814b3-16ee-51e3-ab11-64146056b54f.name: Stage of formation of modern tourism
b43814b3-16ee-51e3-ab11-64146056b54f.description: The formation of modern tourism grows in stages, first the nobility, then the educated middle classes and finally citizens of much more modest means. Karl Baedeker, who published the first successful travel book in 1827, was one of the innovators of modern mass tourism. The first group- and corporation-travel tours were inaugurated by the English firm Thomas Cook in 1840. In 1863 the first travel agency opened in Breslau, followed in 1869 by the founding of the German Alp Society, which opened up the Alps to tourism.

b4d649f4-2b11-52f4-9a82-117548a2cecd.name: The Massacre at Chios
b4d649f4-2b11-52f4-9a82-117548a2cecd.description: *The Massacre at Chios* by the Romantic painter Eugène Delacroix.

b5038372-f50f-5466-972e-b6ab40ff06fd.name: Pavilion of Turkish Tobacco
b5038372-f50f-5466-972e-b6ab40ff06fd.description: Although the Ottoman government does not participate in the 1889 Paris Exhibition, the architecture of the Sultan Ahmed Fountain (from the Vienna Exhibition in 1873) is recycled in the exhibition in the Pavilion of Turkish Tobacco.

b506e781-eb7a-5955-b769-f0cf8ee00ec0.name: Weber-rebellion
b506e781-eb7a-5955-b769-f0cf8ee00ec0.description: The first Proletariat uprising, the Weber Rebellion, witnesses 3,000 weavers in Silesia protesting against inhumane working conditions and exploitation. The uprising is quashed by the Prussian military – which murders them all.

b544b3d8-93e2-507e-b42e-78206606849e.name: Egyptian navy sunk by the European Allied fleet
b544b3d8-93e2-507e-b42e-78206606849e.description: When under the command of an Ottoman representative the entire Egyptian navy is sunk by the European Allied fleet, Muhammad ‘Ali asks for the territory of Syria in compensation.

b557dd5a-40a5-543a-9784-0422ebefad5a.name: The Naval Academy is founded for teaching and research within the Portuguese Tropical Medicine
b557dd5a-40a5-543a-9784-0422ebefad5a.description: The Naval Academy is founded for teaching and research on Portuguese tropical medicine. Its purpose is to provide access to tropical medicine for general medical students and as a specialty for naval doctors. The Academy had a small laboratory for some diagnostic tests.

b563f16c-2d05-56f9-9520-1d9277c6a420.name: The Archaeological Museum of Aegina
b563f16c-2d05-56f9-9520-1d9277c6a420.description: Ioannis Kapodistrias oversees the establishment of Greece’s first museum, the Archaeological Museum of Aegina.

b5a66fd3-718b-5c3f-b90b-fdd8a9e6803d.name: The Paris Peace Conference
b5a66fd3-718b-5c3f-b90b-fdd8a9e6803d.description: At the Paris Peace conference held after the end of the World War I, the Ottoman provinces of Basra, Baghdad and Mosul are unified into Iraq, governed by Britain, under a League of Nations mandate. Gertrude Bell helps found the Iraq Museum (1926) and draft antiquities laws.

b5d51b43-7ec9-5ddf-9819-f549b92204fa.name: Dome of Cologne is completed
b5d51b43-7ec9-5ddf-9819-f549b92204fa.description: The dome of Cologne is completed (construction began in 1248). It is the tallest church building in the world at the time.

b5ea70f2-44c4-54c9-9be0-fbf62b494e99.name: Donizetti dies and Verdi remains the only heir of the Italian melodrama
b5ea70f2-44c4-54c9-9be0-fbf62b494e99.description: Donizetti dies and Verdi remains the only heir to the Italian melodrama, which is increasingly identified with the Risorgimento movement, becoming a “sound track” of the Italian fight for independence and unification.

b638bda3-f06f-539a-b639-2c71a68703af.name: Nikola Martinoski
b638bda3-f06f-539a-b639-2c71a68703af.description: A founder of contemporary Macedonian art, Nikola Martinoski is born in Krushevo (d. 1973). He learned painting in the Skopje workshop of the icon painter Dimitar Andonov, and in Bucharest and Paris. His distinctive expressionist style depicts social themes and portraits, influenced by Macedonian frescos and the modern Parisian school. His outstanding work is the painting "Mother and Child".

b64c70c6-7190-5fd3-91f8-d792e406301d.name: Revolution in Moldavia and Wallachia
b64c70c6-7190-5fd3-91f8-d792e406301d.description: January 1821–July 1822: revolution in Moldavia and Wallachia against the Phanariotes (Greek rulers imposed by the Ottoman Empire since the beginning of the 18th century) and for social and economic measures to improve the lives of the people. After the suppression of the revolution the Empire appoints Romanian rulers in Moldavia (Ioniţă Sandu Sturdza) and Walachia (Grigore Dimitrie Ghica).

b675bdd5-a170-57da-8e04-60d39454fc93.name: The Realist movement
b675bdd5-a170-57da-8e04-60d39454fc93.description: The Realist movement, which emerges as a reaction to Classicism, focuses on the faithful reproduction of the “reality” of daily life in both town and country. This movement, which affected literature and painting in particular, shocked some people. Orientalism (i.e. the painters Fromentin, Ingres and Gérôme) favoured subjects inspired by travel to the Near East.

b74eb8da-0d1f-50e5-afa9-b3165ba07882.name: Spain's neutrality in World War I
b74eb8da-0d1f-50e5-afa9-b3165ba07882.description: Spain's neutrality in World War I brings important economic upturn.

b76ca99e-e559-5fdf-9a8b-04dce8d4dd75.name: Berlin Conference was called by Portugal to regulate European colonization and convened by German Chancellor Otto von Bismarck
b76ca99e-e559-5fdf-9a8b-04dce8d4dd75.description: Berlin Conference called by Portugal to regulate European colonisation and convened by German Chancellor Otto von Bismarck. The Portuguese government presents the "Pink Map”, a project uniting the colonies of Angola and Mozambique through the corridor of land that separates them. The proposal is rejected by England although endorsed by the majority of countries.

b773ab66-e009-50b9-8114-dde057434d4a.name: Physician Albert Einstein formulates theory of relativity
b773ab66-e009-50b9-8114-dde057434d4a.description: Physician Albert Einstein formulates his Theory and publishes *Relativity: The Special and General Theory*.

b777bbfc-18cb-55d1-a755-c261e4c273ac.name: National Exhibition of Agricultural and Industrial Products and Fine Arts
b777bbfc-18cb-55d1-a755-c261e4c273ac.description: First Italian National Exhibition of Agricultural and Industrial Products and Fine Arts opens in Florence.

b78d68d4-3bbc-513d-aefe-13fccca20a7e.name: Nikolaos Gyzis and Nikiphoros Lytras win scholarships to the Royal Academy of Fine Arts of Munich
b78d68d4-3bbc-513d-aefe-13fccca20a7e.description: Both Nikolaos Gyzis and Nikiphoros Lytras win scholarships to the Royal Academy of Fine Arts, Munich.

b7a08e47-5512-5512-af2b-f56caafc3040.name: The revival of the Olympic Games

b7fd5c17-8b89-5443-bbe7-6fdd6b9b80d9.name: Through the Paris Convention signed in August 1858 by Russia
b7fd5c17-8b89-5443-bbe7-6fdd6b9b80d9.description: Through the Paris Convention signed in August 1858 by Russia, the UK, France, Piedmont, Prussia, Austria and the Ottoman Empire the privileges and ranks of the Romanian aristocracy in Moldavia and Wallachia are abolished.

b8055e3c-6315-504d-bd7a-5f5204b991d5.name: Universal exhibition symbol of Belle Epoque
b8055e3c-6315-504d-bd7a-5f5204b991d5.description: The World Fair in Paris as the symbol of the Belle Époque with its theme “the balance of a century”. The exhibition bequeaths to Paris several buildings including the Petit Palais and the Grand Palais.

b8181239-b15b-5cf5-b5a4-62d21b07b9f3.name: Khedive Ismail and Egypt rule in Africa
b8181239-b15b-5cf5-b5a4-62d21b07b9f3.description: Khedive Isma‘il attempts to reduce slave trading and extends Egypt’s rule in Africa. Managing to annex Darfur in 1874, he is prevented from further expansion into Ethiopia when his army is defeated by the Emperor Yohannes IV.

b81fcb0a-2e0d-5a86-87e4-90f4e5b6e7ff.name: Poet António Nobre
b81fcb0a-2e0d-5a86-87e4-90f4e5b6e7ff.description: Birth of the poet António Nobre (1867–1900). *Só*, written during his exile in Paris (1892), is the only work published in his lifetime. The nostalgia of this work, a landmark of the symbolist movement, is tempered by a certain self-irony, alternating a symbolist refined vocabulary with a more colloquial one. He influenced the work of the main Portuguese modernists.

b820e375-1195-5a18-9270-6ff8f7e862ed.name: New comers to Transjordan
b820e375-1195-5a18-9270-6ff8f7e862ed.description: Newcomers to Transjordan, whether from neighbouring Arab countries such as Syria, Palestine and Hijaz or from further afield such as Caucasus, bring with them not only artefacts of their home culture, including personal ornaments, weapons, costumes and treasured items, but also the necessary skills and social habits that help them to adapt in their new homeland.

b8560f95-cd41-5a3b-b44c-6eaa38e60c11.name: Conclusion of Avenida da Liberdade
b8560f95-cd41-5a3b-b44c-6eaa38e60c11.description: Completion of the construction of Avenida da Liberdade in Lisbon. Engineer Frederico Ressano Garcia (1847–1911) followed Joseph Pezarat’s plans. Inspired by Haussmann’s Parisian boulevards, Avenida da Liberdade is testimony to the economic boom of the Fontismo period, with new residential areas built for investment and profit.

b866c80c-6101-513d-b43a-448219e41750.name: Al Qawasim attack British vessels
b866c80c-6101-513d-b43a-448219e41750.description: Between around 1790 and the early 1800s, threatened by increasing British inroads into traditional Gulf economies and politics, and supported by the Persians and Omanis, the Qawasim attack British vessels to defend their economic empire in the Lower Gulf.

b86a3692-b2ab-54f9-89a5-30a9c0900558.name: Hydroelectric power plants
b86a3692-b2ab-54f9-89a5-30a9c0900558.description: Hydroelectric power plants are built in Tivoli (1892) and Paderno d’Adda (1898) and the power they generated is transported to, respectively, Rome and Milan.

b8f28e6d-f013-537d-bcfc-21b127eddf79.name: Post and Telegraphs Office
b8f28e6d-f013-537d-bcfc-21b127eddf79.description: Establishment of the Tunisian Post and Telegraphs Office; during this time the first Tunisian postage stamp was issued and the Hôtel des postes (Post Office building) was inaugurated in Tunis.

b8f5ef09-f601-5ee3-ad78-dfac91656f62.name: Growth of the population of Sharjah town
b8f5ef09-f601-5ee3-ad78-dfac91656f62.description: The population of Sharjah has reached around 19,000 inhabitants. The suq boasts some 200 shops, with a multicultural mix of local and resident merchants, pearl traders, and trade-related professionals originating from as far away as India and East Africa. The Emirate of Sharjah as a whole is estimated as having around 45,500 inhabitants at this time.

b8fc760c-ed3f-5e93-aebc-2637943476b3.name: Bucharest city hall
b8fc760c-ed3f-5e93-aebc-2637943476b3.description: 19 August: establishment of Bucharest’s city hall. Bucharest had been the United Principalities’ capital since 1861.

b961d5ff-b3e0-5980-a68e-994c9a40c4a6.name: Ato Adicional de 1852
b961d5ff-b3e0-5980-a68e-994c9a40c4a6.description: Ato Adicional de 1852 (Additional Act) abolishes the death penalty for political crimes, which had not been enforced since 1834. In 1867, in the reign of King Luís I, the abolition of the death penalty is extended to all kinds of crime, except for those under military jurisdiction. Only in 1911 will total abolition be proclaimed by the Republican regime.

b9624a6c-c148-5059-aa97-bb75b8d4815e.name: Liberation wars
b9624a6c-c148-5059-aa97-bb75b8d4815e.description: The Liberation Wars (and the decisive Battle of Leipzig in 1913) were between Napoleon Bonaparte’s French troops and Central Europe; Napoleon is overthrown.

b967bdfa-8f6e-58fa-8661-5b682134ba90.name: The first railway in Spain
b967bdfa-8f6e-58fa-8661-5b682134ba90.description: The first railway in Spain is built between Barcelona and Mataró for the transport of goods and passengers. The first railway built by the Spaniards had been built in Cuba in 1837 linking Havana with Güines.

b9a87e8e-5b7d-5d47-9055-0ae4d2c050d6.name: A school for theatre
b9a87e8e-5b7d-5d47-9055-0ae4d2c050d6.description: A school for theatre (Dârülbedayi) is founded.

b9b1f643-0224-57dd-8f7d-675dba7cebf6.name: Khan Antun Bey
b9b1f643-0224-57dd-8f7d-675dba7cebf6.description: Antun Bey Najjar, a merchant who made his fortune in Constantinople, builds Khan Antun Bey in 1853. It becomes a great business center and the building served for many institutions such as Beirut’s foreign consulates, the Ottoman administration, postal services, merchants’ offices and Beirut’s first bank, Imperial Ottoman.

b9d3d3d6-717f-538a-b065-6e39318a6d1d.name: Italian and French settlements
b9d3d3d6-717f-538a-b065-6e39318a6d1d.description: Italian and French farmers settle in agricultural areas of the Regency of Tunis.

b9e3ad32-0b8a-590f-bb64-4a1e5f3e26ec.name: The Archaeological Museum of the American University
b9e3ad32-0b8a-590f-bb64-4a1e5f3e26ec.description: Foundation of the Archaeological Museum of the American University of Beirut after Luigi Palma di Cesnola gives a collection of Cypriot pottery to the newly formed university.

b9f3c4da-72a6-5963-a86e-8c41d7515200.name: Dreyfus Affair
b9f3c4da-72a6-5963-a86e-8c41d7515200.description: The Dreyfus Affair: Captain Dreyfus is unjustly accused of espionage, is militarily degraded, and then deported at the end of the trial. The writer Émile Zola denounces this situation in a pamphlet entitled *J’accuse*. The case divides France; it is recognised that Dreyfus is innocent.

ba46eb50-23ab-5fdc-9f9b-a947b2fd2b6c.name: First Phylloxera plague reaches Portugal countryside
ba46eb50-23ab-5fdc-9f9b-a947b2fd2b6c.description: First phylloxera disease reaches the Portugal countryside. Porto wine and Portuguese wine production in general is reduced dramatically. This disease causes economic, financial and social distress and leads to the abandonment of vineyard farms. The loss of revenues and unemployment increases emigration, especially to Brazil.

ba6c6031-6a7e-5d5c-bf15-193f3c6e7d85.name: Kaiser Wilhelm the second visited three times the Ottoman Empire
ba6c6031-6a7e-5d5c-bf15-193f3c6e7d85.description: Kaiser Wilhelm II visits the Ottoman Empire three times, in 1889, 1898 and 1917. On his second official tour he visits Constantinople, Haifa, Jaffa, Jerusalem, Beirut and Damascus, largely to show his support for Ottoman sultan ‘Abd al-Hamid II whose Empire was already unstable. The strong connection between the countries is further cemented by a gift from the Kaiser to ‘Abd al Hamid: a “German fountain” that stands in Jerusalem to this day.

ba837569-5a61-5c2b-8d6f-b9e06166bac9.name: Tell clock tower built in Tripoli
ba837569-5a61-5c2b-8d6f-b9e06166bac9.description: In celebration of the 30th year of ‘Abd al-Hamid II as sultan of the Ottoman Empire, the Tell Clock Tower is erected in Tripoli as a gift to the city. It is similar to the Jaffa Clock Tower and many others throughout the Empire.

baafca1d-35de-53ac-807d-9b3e839c2a4c.name: Liguria (the region of Genoa) is the Italian region with the highest number of foreigners
baafca1d-35de-53ac-807d-9b3e839c2a4c.description: Liguria (the region of Genoa) is the Italian region with the highest number of foreigners (12,000). It has a mild climate that attracts foreigners escaping north Europe’s harsh climate for health reasons. All through the 19th and early 20th centuries, many foreigners affected by tuberculosis and other illness resided in Italy for extended periods.

baec1701-9c46-5590-9106-8a167969b0db.name: Banco Nacional Ultramarino was established in Lisbon
baec1701-9c46-5590-9106-8a167969b0db.description: Banco Nacional Ultramarino is established in Lisbon, as the issuing bank for Portuguese overseas territories. BNU has a significant role in supporting the economic development of the country and the former colonies. Its savings, investment and issuing role facilitates the currency circulation throughout them.

baee97ec-f064-51af-a4c3-c0e8be60ff87.name: Public service of telegraph was available
baee97ec-f064-51af-a4c3-c0e8be60ff87.description: The public telegraph service becomes available, one year after its first official connection between the Royal Palace and the Parliament. The Morse telegraph system is also used in the international connection to the telegraphic network in Spain, on the border of Elvas and Badajoz.

baf914e8-5b00-5e35-947c-f123f5d225c2.name: First proletarian uprising
baf914e8-5b00-5e35-947c-f123f5d225c2.description: First proletarian uprising: 3000 weavers in Silesia are protesting against the inhumane working conditions and their exploitation. They are all being killed by the Prussian military.

bb041492-319e-5653-9660-c02e76c1dda1.name: Ibrahim Pasha expedition to Hijaz
bb041492-319e-5653-9660-c02e76c1dda1.description: Ibrahim Pasha leads Egypt’s expedition to Hijaz and crushes the Wahhabi Revolution.

bb07bd61-ec0d-57bf-82bd-d9f058ce7c91.name: Sanssouci
bb07bd61-ec0d-57bf-82bd-d9f058ce7c91.description: Prussian King Friedrick II commissions G. W. von Knobelsdorff to build Sanssouci Palace in Potsdam.

bb611188-8d8a-52d9-b54b-b22d3f63809a.name: King Abdulaziz ibn Abdulrahman startes unification of modern Saudi Arabia
bb611188-8d8a-52d9-b54b-b22d3f63809a.description: In 1902, age 19, King ‘Abd al-‘Aziz ibn ‘Abd al-Rahman, along with a small army, returns to Riyad to reclaim his family legacy. Managing to take Riyad, ‘Abd al-Rahman then begins to unify modern Saudi Arabia.

bb77f5b6-5bcc-5cd9-a222-02f6c589e792.name: *Os Maias*, novel
bb77f5b6-5bcc-5cd9-a222-02f6c589e792.description: Publication of *Os Maias* by Eça de Queirós. A mature romance and perhaps his best known. Focused on the saga of the Maia family through three generations, it debates the issue of the country’s destiny, in the context of the Constitutionalist ennobled bourgeoisie, whose good intentions end up capsizing.

bbc82c38-71ff-5652-8b27-fbc7ce8ecc61.name: A new neoclassical decorative grammar
bbc82c38-71ff-5652-8b27-fbc7ce8ecc61.description: Under Queen Maria I (1734–1816) and King João VI (1767–1826) a new neoclassical decorative grammar replaces the dominant rococo style. Besides French and English influences, the main features of the furniture are the carving of classical inspiration and the inlay work using various woods, creating both geometrical and floral compositions.

bc0e4cd3-9761-5240-abd6-ea5558b08009.name: Formation of Young Ottoman opposition
bc0e4cd3-9761-5240-abd6-ea5558b08009.description: Formation of Young Ottoman opposition against the bureaucratic domination of Ali Paşa and Fuad Paşa.

bc39c11d-9f3f-5033-95ec-4c15448480ce.name: Partido Histórico and Partido Reformista merged into Progressist Partyin September
bc39c11d-9f3f-5033-95ec-4c15448480ce.description: Partido Histórico and Partido Reformista merge into the Partido Progressista in September. Power alternation with the Partido Regenerador framed rotativism. They were able to carry out some urgent reforms but in the end the system soon degenerated into political conformism.

bc69adba-fadf-587e-b88b-db0f203864b6.name: Opening of the Egyptian Museum in Bulaq
bc69adba-fadf-587e-b88b-db0f203864b6.description: On 18 October, under the rule of Khedive Isma‘il, the Egyptian Museum opens in the Caireen district of Bulaq under the management of French Egyptologist Auguste Mariette, known as Mariette Pasha.

bc713dc9-b725-57d8-b484-0c2820e3c45c.name: Emperor Franz Joseph visits the Suez Canal
bc713dc9-b725-57d8-b484-0c2820e3c45c.description: Emperor Franz Joseph I of Austria attends the opening of the Suez Canal on 17 November.

bc7219ab-1b83-568c-82fd-beda1f35f11b.name: Vojadan Chernodrinski
bc7219ab-1b83-568c-82fd-beda1f35f11b.description: Beginnings of the Macedonian amateur theatre in Veles initiated by educator and playwright Jordan Hadzi Konstantinov-Dzinot (1821–82). Professional theatres open in the late 19th century. Vojadan Chernodrinski (1875–1951) is considered one of the founders of the Macedonian theatre. The premiere for his best-known play, the tragedy *Macedonian Bloody Wedding* was held in Sofia, Bulgaria, on 7 November 1900.

bc9c20b4-865e-53d0-b8f4-b45a9b1562d6.name: Dolmabahçe Mosque
bc9c20b4-865e-53d0-b8f4-b45a9b1562d6.description: The construction of Dolmabahçe Mosque by Agob Balian.

bcbbc343-aa29-5e92-aa5c-49eb361bafd7.name: Habsburg Emperor Francisc I and his wife Carolina visit the cities of Transilvania
bcbbc343-aa29-5e92-aa5c-49eb361bafd7.description: August–September: Habsburg Emperor Francis I and his wife Carolina visit the cities of Transylvania and are very well received by the population.

bd1c655d-7244-53aa-ad13-4b4a4ebef698.name: Portuguese inlander Silva Porto
bd1c655d-7244-53aa-ad13-4b4a4ebef698.description: Silva Porto, born in poverty in Portugal, trader, farmer and explorer, settles in Bié, Angola, from where he, with his *pombeiros* (long-distance trade agents), tours Central Africa between 1839 and 1890. The descriptions of his travels that he sent to Lisbon became legendary and a precious source of data.

bdf21882-4782-5ac5-bc06-9ad35c1e6d8f.name: The creation of the first Arbeiterkrankenversicherungsgesetz
bdf21882-4782-5ac5-bc06-9ad35c1e6d8f.description: Austria’s Legislation is passed for the mandatory insurance of workers (employees).

be727f32-2d07-5474-95c2-145cf901fcb8.name: Reforms of Ahmad Pasha Bey
be727f32-2d07-5474-95c2-145cf901fcb8.description: Rule of Ahmad Pasha Bey, known as the “Great Reformer” of modern Tunisia. His greatest achievements include modernisation of the army and the abolition of slavery.

be850d75-fcd6-5126-be68-53235953118e.name: Commercial operations in the Gulf
be850d75-fcd6-5126-be68-53235953118e.description: The Russian Steam Navigation and Trading Company begin commercial and passenger operations in the Gulf.

be85b1e1-ae64-5a92-92dc-e4ab61f96382.name: Neo-Mudéjar artistic movement
be85b1e1-ae64-5a92-92dc-e4ab61f96382.description: The style of the Neo-Mudéjar artistic movement is used in buildings and artworks, especially ceramic and metalware. These pieces are displayed in different international exhibitions (e.g. London 1851, Paris 1878).

bea391ae-add7-5eb6-be1f-142886ab46f0.name: The popular “Americanos” of Lisbon were replaced for more performant forms of traction
bea391ae-add7-5eb6-be1f-142886ab46f0.description: 31 August: Inauguration of the first electric tram route in Lisbon, connecting Cais do Sodré to Ribamar (Algés). The more efficient electric tramway, with tracks, overhead power lines and the construction of Santos Central Power Station, replaces the popular “Americanos” horse-drawn trams of Lisbon.

bef788ec-8f57-5749-b0fe-558bcd2befcc.name: Julius Stinde wrote the book
bef788ec-8f57-5749-b0fe-558bcd2befcc.description: Julius Stinde writes *Frau Buchholz im Orient*. He has already documented the cities of Cairo, Jerusalem, Athens, and Constantinople (now Istanbul, Turkey).

bf6d897a-8f4e-51ab-9a00-4279bd78d5d3.name: The IV International Congress of Tourism held in Lisbon was organized in collaboration with the Sociedade de Propaganda
bf6d897a-8f4e-51ab-9a00-4279bd78d5d3.description: 12–20 May: The 4th International Congress of Tourism is held in Lisbon organised in collaboration with the Sociedade de Propaganda (founded 1906). Before the end of the meeting (18 May), the provisional government of the newly proclaimed Portuguese Republic (5 October 1910) creates a Bureau of Tourism at the Ministério do Fomento (Ministry of Development).

bfac147f-bfa2-5f5b-a074-cf774ea13e0e.name: Guerra de la Independencia
bfac147f-bfa2-5f5b-a074-cf774ea13e0e.description: Guerra de la Independencia (Peninsular War) during the French occupation of the Iberian Peninsula and the rule of King Joseph-Napoleon Bonaparte.

bfbc29a0-ff84-5b94-bdf5-c6b1978a337b.name: Classicism
bfbc29a0-ff84-5b94-bdf5-c6b1978a337b.description: The painting by Johann Heinrich Wilhelm Tischbein, *Goethe in der Campagna* (1786/87), exemplifies Classicism in art at this time.

bfde45d1-a063-501f-a251-4b2f237b9bcd.name: Benlieue (suburbs)
bfde45d1-a063-501f-a251-4b2f237b9bcd.description: From 1870, the suburbs appear around major French cities such as Paris, Lyon, Bordeaux and Marseille.

c001ede9-bba7-5bb9-af69-7d48ac4e3587.name: The Austrian Museum of Applied Arts bought the Minbar of Ibn Tulun mosque
c001ede9-bba7-5bb9-af69-7d48ac4e3587.description: The Austrian Museum of Applied Arts purchases the *minbar* from the Ibn Tulun Mosque in Cairo.

c0106e4c-2ecb-5888-afb2-0580cffa31ad.name: Alexandru Ioan Cuza promulgates the first Romanian land reform
c0106e4c-2ecb-5888-afb2-0580cffa31ad.description: 26 August: Alexandru Ioan Cuza promulgates the first Romanian land reform, which transforms peasants into owners of the land on which they had been working on the estates of the aristocracy. Peasants are also freed from the duties they had to perform for the nobility.

c0314f11-af52-5c71-a304-645bde583f82.name: Formation of the North German Confederation
c0314f11-af52-5c71-a304-645bde583f82.description: Formation of the North German Confederation in 1866/7 sees a federation of the 22 independent states of northern Germany, with nearly 30 million inhabitants. It was the first modern German nation-state and the basis for the later German Empire (1871–1918).

c05c7d66-c994-5535-bf3d-f1dbb65a6028.name: War between Greece and the Ottoman Empire whereby the Greece attain their national indepence
c05c7d66-c994-5535-bf3d-f1dbb65a6028.description: The War between Greece and the Ottoman Empire concludes with Greece attaining its independence with the help of Russia and the Western nations.

c062fd02-58cb-58ba-a54d-bb5126db6142.name: The Ottoman steamship company Şirket-i Hayriyye
c062fd02-58cb-58ba-a54d-bb5126db6142.description: The Ottoman steamship company Şirket-i Hayriyye is founded. It provides regular and rapid transportation from Istanbul to points along the Bosporus, replacing the oar-drawn *kayık*s that had monopolised this traffic since the 18th century.

c066e5d0-ffd8-5b49-bb6e-67d6b13f5877.name: Ibrahim Pasha paid a visit to Western Europe
c066e5d0-ffd8-5b49-bb6e-67d6b13f5877.description: Ibrahim Pasha is received with respect and curiosity when he visits western Europe.

c08eb0a1-a4ce-5283-bf0c-cdbabc82fa25.name: Land register for the district of Ajlun
c08eb0a1-a4ce-5283-bf0c-cdbabc82fa25.description: In 1887 a land register is established for the district of Ajlun. In the district of al-Balqa communal land is converted to private ownership. In 1906 the land register is extended to southern regions including al-Salt, Karak, Tafila and Ma’an. As a consequence many agricultural villages are founded and re-founded in the area between Amman and Karak, leading to a significant increase in agricultural production, especially cereal crops.

c0a25d8b-040d-58a6-92aa-ca244470dc12.name: Zaki Nagjib Mahmud
c0a25d8b-040d-58a6-92aa-ca244470dc12.description: Zaki Najib Mahmud receives a Literary Distinction Award.

c0fd7a73-d8ef-54d3-acf7-1b95c60e99f0.name: Death of king Carol I
c0fd7a73-d8ef-54d3-acf7-1b95c60e99f0.description: Death of King Carol I. As he only had one daughter, who died at the age of three, Ferdinand, his fraternal nephew, had been designated heir to the Romanian throne in 1880.

c10fbdeb-1a4a-5e80-936b-8c3cc0ac5aea.name: The Greco-Roman Museum of Alexandria
c10fbdeb-1a4a-5e80-936b-8c3cc0ac5aea.description: The Greco-Roman Museum of Alexandria is created.

c11deb14-33da-5d43-8b81-5fe3ddcf9ad6.name: Other railways
c11deb14-33da-5d43-8b81-5fe3ddcf9ad6.description: While the Barcelona–Mataró railway is under construction, another line is in progress between Madrid and Aranjuez, opened in 1851, and a third between Langreo and Gijón, in Asturias. By the end of the 19th century most Spanish cities will be linked by train.

c12a3d56-3254-5e4a-bbe8-2633f4552dd2.name: First Serbian Uprising
c12a3d56-3254-5e4a-bbe8-2633f4552dd2.description: The First Serbian Uprising culminates in the first Serbian *Vožd* (Grand Leader), a progenitor of the Karađorđević Dynasty, Đorđe Petrović. He is elected, at a gathering of the Serbs at Orašac on the Feast of the Presentation, having won many famous victories against stronger and better-armed Turkish armies at Ivankovac, Mišar and Varvarin. Following the Treaty of Bucharest and the failure of the Uprising, Petrović flees to Austria in 1813, but soon after, eager to continue his efforts at expelling the Turks, he joins the Greek liberation movement. He secretly returns to Serbia in 1817 to discuss a joint plan of action with the Prince of Serbia Miloš Obrenović, but Miloš has him assassinated.

c13a723d-7b81-5b56-a0cc-8dcc79c014c0.name: The Ottoman Empire became bankrupt
c13a723d-7b81-5b56-a0cc-8dcc79c014c0.description: When the Ottoman Empire is declared bankrupt, an Ottoman Public Debt Commission is established made up of an international body – mainly British, French and German – to manage the Empire’s finances. This becomes a form of veiled European control of Turkey’s economy. This followed a similar imposition of financial control over Egypt’s finances.

c25adf5e-6ad0-5766-a615-183e44033911.name: Ion Georgescu, considered to be the first Romanian modern sculptor
c25adf5e-6ad0-5766-a615-183e44033911.description: Ion Georgescu, considered to be the first Romanian modern sculptor, studies in Paris, where he exhibits his first works.

c290c6fa-1364-5432-9f06-d5f177b9ae4d.name: Gas street lightning
c290c6fa-1364-5432-9f06-d5f177b9ae4d.description: Naples and Turin are the first Italian towns to have gas street lightning.

c2ac4726-0fb6-51b3-8e4b-75d99c1ed6ec.name: Rebellion of reactionaries against constitutional system
c2ac4726-0fb6-51b3-8e4b-75d99c1ed6ec.description: The 31 March Incident (31 Mart Vakası/Olayı or Hadisesi) is a rebellion on 13 April (31 March in official Rumi calendar) in Constantinople against restoration of the constitutional system. It is the culmination of the Ottoman countercoup that attempted to end the Second Constitutional Era in the empire and the newly established influence of the Committee of Union and Progress in order to reaffirm Abdülhamid II as absolute monarch.

c2c88cbc-fc5a-5b9b-9cc8-3ee3b2008264.name: Battle of Hernani
c2c88cbc-fc5a-5b9b-9cc8-3ee3b2008264.description: *Battle of Hernani*, a drama by Victor Hugo.

c32bd9a8-8493-559e-89e5-52e172af5eb0.name: The establishment of the Archaeological Society of Athens
c32bd9a8-8493-559e-89e5-52e172af5eb0.description: The Archaeological Society of Athens is established. Its aim is to encourage archaeological-excavation management of antiquities in Greece.

c32f45d9-fe37-5cfe-9118-145c10b0e78c.name: Fire in Beyoğlu
c32f45d9-fe37-5cfe-9118-145c10b0e78c.description: Fire in Beyoğlu (İstanbul) destroys about 3,000 houses; 80 people are killed. After that incident using brick and stone to build houses becomes obligatory.

c37a94d1-2fb7-5e1a-8af6-ba06119c9f46.name: Domitilia de Carvalho is the first woman studying in the University of Coimbra
c37a94d1-2fb7-5e1a-8af6-ba06119c9f46.description: October: Domitilia de Carvalho is the first woman to study at the University of Coimbra. She is obliged to wear black, sober costumes and a discreet hat to go unnoticed among her male colleagues. A brilliant student she graduated in mathematics (1894), philosophy (1895) and medicine (1904).

c38850cf-3090-56f5-87c0-8fac5fb6168b.name: Period of art beginning of Post-Imperialism and Symbolism
c38850cf-3090-56f5-87c0-8fac5fb6168b.description: The painting by Franz von Stuck, *Die Sünde* (1893), exemplifies the period in art known as Post-Imperialism and Symbolism.

c39be4a2-bb22-5a28-adb2-c3bf85c1967d.name: Grigore Tocilescu begins to research the remains of the Roman town Tropaeum Traiani
c39be4a2-bb22-5a28-adb2-c3bf85c1967d.description: Grigore Tocilescu begins to research the remains of the Roman town Tropaeum Traiani (modern Adamclisi in Dobruja).

c3a28ad6-290c-5c32-9152-5da9580fd8d4.name: Law establishing the telegraphic network in Spanish territory
c3a28ad6-290c-5c32-9152-5da9580fd8d4.description: The government introduces a law establishing the telegraphic network in Spanish territory, marking the beginning of telecommunications in Spain. Its objective is to link every important city and the provincial capitals.

c3f20652-9f73-55fe-91fb-de73d552475c.name: Introduction of the general and equal franchise in Austria
c3f20652-9f73-55fe-91fb-de73d552475c.description: Introduction of the general equal franchise means that all Austrian male citizens have the right to vote for members of the parliament; prior to 1907 only males paying a minimum amount of tax were allowed a vote.

c3f7899e-e183-573a-bfa6-a4a367ef01b7.name: Establishment of the first university in Berlin
c3f7899e-e183-573a-bfa6-a4a367ef01b7.description: Establishment of Berlin’s first university, the Humboldt-Universität.

c406621b-9a76-566c-ba99-a0f4b7affbca.name: Febo Moniz
c406621b-9a76-566c-ba99-a0f4b7affbca.description: *Febo Moniz* published by Joaquim Pedro de Oliveira Martins (1845–94). Subtitled "Romance Histórico Português do Século XVI", the action takes place in Lisbon in 1580. The protagonist is the prosecutor Febo Moniz, the sole representative of the state to protest against the acclamation of Philip II of Spain as King of Portugal.

c4bac57e-3dfb-5c99-99c6-ba9a65119190.name: Dimitrie Bolintineanu, the Minister of Cults and Public Instruction
c4bac57e-3dfb-5c99-99c6-ba9a65119190.description: Dimitrie Bolintineanu, the Minister of Religion and Public Instruction, organises in Bucharest an exhibition displaying works of contemporary Romanian artists, the most important of the time being painters Theodor Aman, Gheorghe Tattarescu and Carol Popp de Szathmari.

c4fca188-0ae7-547c-9f1e-181e0489d0f7.name: The Parliament approves a law on drainage of swamps
c4fca188-0ae7-547c-9f1e-181e0489d0f7.description: In order to fight malaria, Parliament approves a law on drainage of swamps. Malaria plagues about one-third of Italian territory, where 10 per cent of the population lives.

c51b0e9d-18ad-54ec-9c87-4472fe74b149.name: Construction of the residential blocks of Akaretler
c51b0e9d-18ad-54ec-9c87-4472fe74b149.description: Construction of the residential blocks of Akaretler (Istanbul) by the architect Agob Balian. They are built for the elite staff of the nearby Dolmabahçe Palace.

c536a089-587e-50f4-8a4a-fa095fd89c9b.name: The rulers of Moldavia and Wallachia
c536a089-587e-50f4-8a4a-fa095fd89c9b.description: The rulers of Moldavia and Wallachia, Mihail Sturdza and Gheorghe Bibescu, sign a convention that stipulates the abolishment of the customs between the two countries. The convention becomes effective in January 1847.

c55873b2-5f43-516d-9ea3-c2b923d68e62.name: Standardisation of Abitur
c55873b2-5f43-516d-9ea3-c2b923d68e62.description: Standardisation of the *Abitur* (equivalent to the A-Level system used elsewhere) which allows students to enter German universities.

c59402e5-b6a7-570c-a83d-ace14d78dbc7.name: The Head of a Sphinx of Sesostris
c59402e5-b6a7-570c-a83d-ace14d78dbc7.description: The Egyptian authorities give the head of a Sphinx of Sesostris III to the Kunsthistorisches Museum in Vienna.

c5f8bf3d-f0bd-52ab-9a90-27c7c5be6dc0.name: The internationalisation of the Danube
c5f8bf3d-f0bd-52ab-9a90-27c7c5be6dc0.description: The internationalisation of the Danube through the Treaty of Paris has a positive influence on the development of Romanian commerce.

c61a5b3a-b12b-5c2b-a169-6feb08ed2c4b.name: Bashir II breaks away from the Ottoman Empire
c61a5b3a-b12b-5c2b-a169-6feb08ed2c4b.description: Bashir II breaks away from the Ottoman Empire, allies with Muhammad ‘Ali Pasha of Egypt and assists his son Ibrahim Pasha in a siege of Acre. This siege lasts seven months before the fall of the city on 27 May 1832. They also conquer Damascus on 14 June 1832.

c63247a8-d0fd-5651-a251-2964e1cfed2d.name: Karl Richard Lepsius was an egyptologist and appointed director of an egypt expedition by Friedrich Wilhelm the forth
c63247a8-d0fd-5651-a251-2964e1cfed2d.description: The Egyptologist Karl Richard Lepsius is appointed director of an expedition to Egypt by Friedrich Wilhelm IV.

c673ff6f-a95e-5861-8c3d-9a61230152e7.name: Process of urbanisation
c673ff6f-a95e-5861-8c3d-9a61230152e7.description: The process of urbanisation begins: in 1907 Berlin had more than 2 million citizens of which around 40% are locals, 20% German immigrants and 40% foreign immigrants.

c69b7381-dd50-5e58-9541-019b879d1cc4.name: Average annual migration
c69b7381-dd50-5e58-9541-019b879d1cc4.description: The Italian population grows from 22 million in 1861 to almost 33 million in 1901, to 38.4 million in 1921. Part of the increases are due to annexations of new territories. During the same period average annual migration to European and Mediterranean countries is 99, 000 in the 1860s and170,000 in the 1910s, peaking in the 1900s at 251,000. Average annual migration to non-European countries is 22,000 in the 1860s and 213,000 in the 1910s, peaking in the 1900s at 351,000. (Figures, rounded to the nearest 1,000, include both permanent and temporary migration.

c6a41e21-7fd3-53ce-af3b-ed52c5d54b1e.name: Augusto Hilário
c6a41e21-7fd3-53ce-af3b-ed52c5d54b1e.description: Augusto Hilário (1864–96), the quintessential fado singer of Coimbra, enrols at the University of Coimbra and became a symbol of “Coimbra Serenade”. "Fado Hilário" is his best known work as a composer and writer.

c6d2af05-0e72-5505-89b7-7d832a73f501.name: Law on the abolition of religious bodies
c6d2af05-0e72-5505-89b7-7d832a73f501.description: Law on the abolition of religious bodies: the real estate properties of 25,000 religious bodies are auctioned.

c6ec15dd-3b1b-584c-849f-ae90f530cfe7.name: The opera of Joseph Strauss  Die Fledermaus
c6ec15dd-3b1b-584c-849f-ae90f530cfe7.description: Joseph Strauss composes the opera *Die Fledermaus*.

c6f4f9fc-5375-5a0b-b585-815e2286c460.name: Major growth of iron and steel industry
c6f4f9fc-5375-5a0b-b585-815e2286c460.description: Major growth of iron and steel industry: cast iron production rises from 9,000 tons in 1895 to 426,000 tons in 1913; steel production rises from 50,000 tons in 1895 to 933,000 tons in 1913.

c71c4a24-459b-5928-bcd6-e322eda62be2.name: First telegraph system
c71c4a24-459b-5928-bcd6-e322eda62be2.description: Following creation of, in the Regency of Tunis, the first mail-distribution system, the first aerial telegraph system is inaugurated connecting the Bardo, official headquarters of the Bey’s government, with Tunis and La Goulette.

c72db3bb-4974-5e13-a058-5660358351e7.name: Railway
c72db3bb-4974-5e13-a058-5660358351e7.description: Inauguration of the first passenger railway line in France to and from Paris and Saint-Germain-en-Laye.

c73db5de-1c18-5911-b54c-0964875b9034.name: Kostis Palamas published *Songs of My Fatherland*
c73db5de-1c18-5911-b54c-0964875b9034.description: The poet Kostis Palamas publishes his first collection of verse entitled the *Songs of My Fatherland*. A major figure on the Greek literary scene, Palamas writes the Olympic Anthem and is nominated for the Nobel Prize for Literature.

c75a9819-4fac-5fb8-b9ea-f60b264d5c5d.name: Demonstrations and riots against high bread price
c75a9819-4fac-5fb8-b9ea-f60b264d5c5d.description: Widespread demonstrations and riots against high bread price. The government uses the army to repress protests: in Milan 85 demonstrators are killed.

c777b4ee-0c1a-5320-b9b8-de82a8a0055f.name: Claudius Rich appointed East India Company Resident at Baghdad
c777b4ee-0c1a-5320-b9b8-de82a8a0055f.description: Claudius Rich is appointed East India Company Resident at Baghdad. His work at Babylon and Nineveh stimulates European interest in the archaeology of Iraq. East India Company men play a major role in the exploration and mapping of the Middle East.

c7affa80-67ee-523c-9282-f78edebeb07c.name: Austria had to cede the Venetian province
c7affa80-67ee-523c-9282-f78edebeb07c.description: Following defeat at the Battle of Königgrätz (3 October), at the Peace of Vienna, Austria is forced to cede the Venetian province to Italy.

c7cb156d-2fe6-5583-be01-87a6bbba696d.name: The Archaeological Museum of Sfax
c7cb156d-2fe6-5583-be01-87a6bbba696d.description: The Archaeological Museum of Sfax is established in one of the city’s hotels.

c8158950-aadd-5704-8c34-3fcb7dee5c20.name: The earliest railway line within the Empire
c8158950-aadd-5704-8c34-3fcb7dee5c20.description: The earliest railway line within the Empire is opened between Costanta and Cernovoda (in present-day Romania).

c81cfbb4-e2b7-5973-86fc-236d4d005bed.name: Throughout the 8300 km hinterland crossing
c81cfbb4-e2b7-5973-86fc-236d4d005bed.description: 21 June: the expedition of Roberto Ivens and Hermenegildo Capelo reaches Quelimane, Mozambique, after 14 months. Throughout their 8,300 km expedition across the African hinterland, Ivens wrote and drew sketches and maps, while Capelo collected specimens of plants, rocks and animals. The constant desertions and sickness and death of the bearers increased the danger and uncertainty.

c8237ae8-0e29-5625-bcad-e1a782a53f93.name: The beginning of the Greek Revolution
c8237ae8-0e29-5625-bcad-e1a782a53f93.description: The Greek Revolution against the Ottoman Empire begins.

c82b3d15-2f40-50e2-ad36-0eb84aa59e16.name: Foundation of the National Bank of Greece
c82b3d15-2f40-50e2-ad36-0eb84aa59e16.description: The National Bank of Greece is founded.

c836e9d1-b5eb-598f-a3d5-9682526c7a9c.name: Foundation of the University of Athens
c836e9d1-b5eb-598f-a3d5-9682526c7a9c.description: The University of Athens opens. It is the first university to be established in the eastern Mediterranean.

c8760a84-187f-5b53-8d7b-ee0367adc321.name: Transatlantic migration from Europe to America
c8760a84-187f-5b53-8d7b-ee0367adc321.description: Transatlantic migration from Europe, to America, Canada, Brazil, Argentina and Australia.

c8785913-b029-5fac-9130-7be3d5fcfb5b.name: The establishment of the Austrian Danube Steam Ship company
c8785913-b029-5fac-9130-7be3d5fcfb5b.description: The Austrian Danube Steamboat Shipping Company is established.

c8879751-cbb9-5312-8fde-0d74af8a1761.name: Teams of spinners are brought from France
c8879751-cbb9-5312-8fde-0d74af8a1761.description: Teams of spinners are brought from France to train young women. This was a real social revolution in this rural and traditional part of the country. According to G. Ducousso’s book *The Silk Industry in Syria and Lebanon* (1912), the French Consul in Beirut counted no fewer than 183 spinning mills in Lebanon.

c8d106a1-069e-5770-8abe-500dcb540ec3.name: Vasile Pârvan initiates archeological diggings at Histria
c8d106a1-069e-5770-8abe-500dcb540ec3.description: Vasile Pârvan initiates archaeological digs at Histria (Dobruja), the earliest documented city in the territory of Romania, and in 1915 discovers the ruins of the ancient Greek city Istros.

c8e8ed27-9021-561b-90ff-ba37d1d947f0.name: Teachers Seminary
c8e8ed27-9021-561b-90ff-ba37d1d947f0.description: The Teachers’ Seminary is founded in İstanbul.

c8f089bc-fb60-5555-8988-39f0aa37e639.name: Industrial development
c8f089bc-fb60-5555-8988-39f0aa37e639.description: The industrial boom is fuelled by technological innovations (i.e. electricity, cinema, the car and aeroplane). Advances in metallurgy results in construction of the Eiffel Tower in 1889.

c9195ae4-53be-5ffa-bdd7-8cbcb26314a0.name: Capitulations
c9195ae4-53be-5ffa-bdd7-8cbcb26314a0.description: Taking advantage of treaties known as Capitulations an increasing number of Europeans arrive to seek their fortune in the commerce and industry of the regency, in particular the Leghorn Jews, Italians and Maltese.

c925403d-920b-5ac2-8546-07bb434b5646.name: Egyptian television
c925403d-920b-5ac2-8546-07bb434b5646.description: Egyptian television begins to broadcast six hours daily on 21 July 1960.

c9e3bf24-ed2f-54bb-a9bc-687c1a28556a.name: Comedy: Marriage of a Poet
c9e3bf24-ed2f-54bb-a9bc-687c1a28556a.description: İbrahim Şinasi completes his stage comedy *Şâir Evlenmesi* (Marriage of a Poet), the first theatre play written by an Ottoman Turkish author.

c9e64df7-a4a6-55e8-9bfc-df092bbe6416.name: Egyptology
c9e64df7-a4a6-55e8-9bfc-df092bbe6416.description: The Chair in Egyptology at the Collège de France is created by a decree made by King Louis-Philippe of France on 12 March.

c9f9cbc9-18e4-58c6-a077-4082af4f9dda.name: Regulation of the activity of pearling
c9f9cbc9-18e4-58c6-a077-4082af4f9dda.description: Sheikh Abdullah bin Jassim regulates the activity of pearling. He issued and publishes the first written document on pearling activities identifying the start and the end dates of the season and the dividend rates of workers in pearling dhows.

ca06939c-633d-5559-8def-f15dca8d2588.name: Population density
ca06939c-633d-5559-8def-f15dca8d2588.description: By the 1860s, population density has decreased drastically. The border of the *sawn* cultivated land had been pushed westwards under the pressure of the nomadic tribes from the east. Several reasons are suggested for this decline, including maladministration and the taxation policies of the Ottoman Empire. Some of the regions south of Ajlun, including Amman area, and along the escarpment of the Jordan valley were almost completely abandoned. Recovery starts during the last quarter of the 19th century.

ca3b50cd-d9ec-535a-9be7-2b9f925653d8.name: Commission of Cartography
ca3b50cd-d9ec-535a-9be7-2b9f925653d8.description: A Commission of Cartography is created to prepare an atlas of all Portuguese colonies and map three expeditions to Africa. The first expedition (1884–85), undertaken by Roberto Ivens and Hermenegildo Capelo, starts in Moçâmedes in Angola (in present-day Namibia) aiming to reach to the east coast. The expedition members would face risks from hunger, cold, harsh nature, the wildlife and the tsetse fly.

ca4bbfeb-2f11-584f-a37e-0b846335dcc5.name: The poets Alexandros and Panayotis Soutsos
ca4bbfeb-2f11-584f-a37e-0b846335dcc5.description: The poets Alexandros and Panayotis Soutsos compile their first works, and introduce European Romanticism to a newly liberated Greece.

ca6a26ab-2207-53d8-af6f-4b16c3ebdd50.name: Al Qawasim demand tribute from the British East India
ca6a26ab-2207-53d8-af6f-4b16c3ebdd50.description: The Qawasim demand tribute from the British East India Company in exchange for navigational rights in the Gulf; the British then begin military interventions aimed at destroying the economic hegemony of the Qawasim in the Lower Gulf region.

ca8d6883-ec97-5b01-80d4-e10acaf8547c.name: Seven weeks after the death of King Ludwig II in 1886
ca8d6883-ec97-5b01-80d4-e10acaf8547c.description: Seven weeks after the death of King Ludwig II in 1886, Neuschwanstein Castle – built in order that the king could withdraw from public life – opened to the public.

cac1ca0d-4e34-528b-b7a3-e06c86276c20.name: Neoclassical, neo-Renaissance and Liberty in Rome
cac1ca0d-4e34-528b-b7a3-e06c86276c20.description: In Rome, inauguration of the neoclassical monument to King Victor Emanuel II (built after clearing the Capitol Hill area of medieval buildings) and of the new building for the National Gallery of Modern Art, built for the Fine Arts International Exhibitions, combining elements of different styles (neoclassical, neo-Renaissance, Liberty).

cac6949d-0d12-58d6-8db4-fcc05851282c.name: The French army invades Spain
cac6949d-0d12-58d6-8db4-fcc05851282c.description: The French army, known as “Los cien mil hijos de San Luis” (“the hundred thousand sons of St. Louis”), invades Spain to restore absolutism ending the Trienio Liberal (1820 –1823). In 1820 King Fernando VII had agreed to the Constitution, in spite of his opposition to a constitutional monarchy. The Congress of Verona in 1822 gave France a mandate to restore Fernando as absolute monarch.

cafcedd7-d08c-58c0-88a0-9afe6f78d930.name: Ibrahim Pasha was forced to retreat to Egypt
cafcedd7-d08c-58c0-88a0-9afe6f78d930.description: Bilad al-Sham (Greater Syria, including Jordan) is under Ibrahim Pasha who is ruling on behalf of his father, Muhammad 'Ali of Egypt. Ibrahim Pasha is forced to retreat to Egypt through Transjordan where the Egyptian army suffers severe casualties on its way back to Egypt.

cb06c89e-d5c7-5658-a42c-151ffd8645a5.name: The population of Sharjah town has risen to 13900
cb06c89e-d5c7-5658-a42c-151ffd8645a5.description: The population of Sharjah rises to 13,900 inhabitants, its urban features are now much more substantial in terms of its domestic, commercial and official architecture.

cb4464cc-8c8d-578a-8d5e-88f64da3f22e.name: Working day for minors reduced
cb4464cc-8c8d-578a-8d5e-88f64da3f22e.description: On 29 June, the working day for minors is reduced to eight hours.

cb54e3cd-42fa-5404-a4a4-5ac99b2f43dd.name: The Austrian Hungarian compromise
cb54e3cd-42fa-5404-a4a4-5ac99b2f43dd.description: The Austrian-Hungarian compromise creates a dual-monarchy that has common ministries only for foreign affairs, defence and public finance.

cb6847c8-037a-5657-ac66-7fd10dfd2940.name: Second industrial revolutuin and massive immigration
cb6847c8-037a-5657-ac66-7fd10dfd2940.description: The second Industrial Revolution sees massive immigration; the population rises from 41 to 65 million, and from only eight cities with no more than 100,000 inhabitants, more than 48 cities are formed.

cb7fb741-3fd7-5009-b922-47c78e524ec3.name: The Moorish style
cb7fb741-3fd7-5009-b922-47c78e524ec3.description: The so-called Moorish style recalls the Islamic art of Spain and North Africa between the 12th and 15th centuries, which it is said reached its zenith in the Alhambra. The style became fashionable in the 19th century for several reasons, but not least that technical progress and 19th-century industrialisation made a change in architectural styles both desirable and possible. As communications became easier and faster and people were exposed to other cultures, different styles and their functions were fused together in architecture, often to display their patron’s affluence as travel and education were still expensive. For example, the Dampfmaschinenhaus (the Steam Pump House) in Potsdam (1841–3) was designed by Ludwig Persius to resemble a mosque and the Moorish Villa (Wilhelma Park) in Stuttgart (1846) was probably built by Karl Ludwig van Zanth in the Moorish style for King Wilhelm I.

cb83792d-da25-5b3c-811d-c5ec269b098d.name: Lingah, on the Persian littoral of the Gulf
cb83792d-da25-5b3c-811d-c5ec269b098d.description: Lingah, on the Persian littoral of the Gulf, serves as a conduit for the Trucial Coast’s imports from British India, including cloth, coffee, flour and rice. It is governed as a free port under Qawasim administration.

cb9142b6-9429-5a60-aaee-71713630a01b.name: Greek Orthodox Church of Evangelismos built in in Vraila
cb9142b6-9429-5a60-aaee-71713630a01b.description: Construction of the Greek Orthodox Church of Evangelismos in Brăila, Romania.

cbd18771-753d-5d6e-bf1b-8647aded1955.name: Urban growth in Italy
cbd18771-753d-5d6e-bf1b-8647aded1955.description: Urban growth in Italy: Naples is the biggest city (1861: 447,000; 1921: 772,000), but population growth is higher in Rome, the “political capital city” (1871: 244,000; 1921: 692,000) and in Milan, the “industrial capital city” (1861: 96,000; 1921: 719,000). (Rounded to nearest 1,000.)

ccab5eb9-7be0-5c1a-9789-d378ef196b5d.name: Barbadinhos steam pumping station is inaugurated
ccab5eb9-7be0-5c1a-9789-d378ef196b5d.description: 3 October: Barbadinhos steam pumping station is inaugurated. The water from the Alviela Canal starts to be pumped thus increasing the water supply to Lisbon.

cccc2bda-a276-59ef-83e1-5fd09865f622.name: Northern Ireland
cccc2bda-a276-59ef-83e1-5fd09865f622.description: Following Ireland’s decision to secede from the United Kingdom, Northern Ireland immediately exercises its right to opt out of the new dominion and remain one of the four countries of the United Kingdom.

cd5309da-3a73-53e7-b55e-39151a57682c.name: By 1876 Beirut has increased 10–12 times its size
cd5309da-3a73-53e7-b55e-39151a57682c.description: By 1876 Beirut has increased 10–12 times its size in 1841. Eleven districts are added and Danish acting Consul Julius Loyvted draws the new map and presents it to Sultan ‘Abd al-Hamid II. Banks, quarantine office, quays, railway office, telegraph, post office, police stations and offices for foreign agencies are all established in the existing city centre.

cd5dedf4-98ce-5d07-8bfb-4ae4cb7022e5.name: 600,000 die because of the Spanish flue epidemic
cd5dedf4-98ce-5d07-8bfb-4ae4cb7022e5.description: 600,000 die in the Spanish influenza pandemic.

cd644d92-f13e-57ec-b63e-e58829780491.name: New banks
cd644d92-f13e-57ec-b63e-e58829780491.description: Foundation of numerous banks: the Crédit Industriel et Commercial (1859), the Credit Lyonnais (1863) and the Société générale (1864).

cd82c248-d129-5e7e-8dad-52f6b3518d9d.name: Second French Revolution of July
cd82c248-d129-5e7e-8dad-52f6b3518d9d.description: 27–29 July: the Second French Revolution of July 1830 results in the fall of Charles X, who is succeeded by his cousin Louis-Philippe.

cda107f7-6e3b-577b-9863-40194998e6b8.name: Gheorghe Asachi founds in Iaşi a lithographic printing press
cda107f7-6e3b-577b-9863-40194998e6b8.description: Gheorghe Asachi founds in Iaşi a lithographic printing press called Institutul Albinei (The Bee Institute).

cda45cdd-0f64-55cb-8dff-a45034cc8b04.name: Giuseppe Valadier project in Rome
cda45cdd-0f64-55cb-8dff-a45034cc8b04.description: Giuseppe Valadier’s neoclassical project for the area next to the Rome northern gate is completed: it encompasses Piazza del Popolo and a new scenographic access to the Pincio hill.
