This prompts the king to leave Riyad for Kuwait with his family.

f5674132-346d-525b-943a-ee84305f7d62.name: Mass Balkan migration
f5674132-346d-525b-943a-ee84305f7d62.description: Mass Balkan migration. After the Russo-Turkish War (called the ’93 War by Turks) between 1 and 1.5 million people are driven from the Balkans to the Ottoman heartlands.

f588864f-8174-5479-a4a6-3714bb28a3a7.name: Monumental architecture in the Napoleonic age
f588864f-8174-5479-a4a6-3714bb28a3a7.description: In the Napoleonic age, monumental architecture is intended to celebrate the glory of the new regime. An example of that is the Foro Bonaparte, in the area around the Sforza’s Castle in Milan (a project by Giovanni Antonio Antolini).

f5b24ebd-4e72-5d72-9531-10375759e93b.name: Industrial Exhibitions in Turin
f5b24ebd-4e72-5d72-9531-10375759e93b.description: An industrial exhibition is held in Turin.

f60cbe19-2d58-5300-a081-fe527d52244c.name: Centrally positioned in the northern part of Jordan at the edge
f60cbe19-2d58-5300-a081-fe527d52244c.description: Centrally positioned in the northern part of Jordan at the edge of the cultivated lands and the desert, thus having access to both ecological zones and demographies, Amman is the perfect choice for the capital of the Emirate of Transjordan. It develops rapidly from small village to relatively big town within a few decades. Being one of the important stations on the Hijaz Railway adds to its geopolitical and economic significance.

f6486cbf-833b-5a9a-b1e5-b99bdf7b38d6.name: The Government of British India administers the Trucial Coast
f6486cbf-833b-5a9a-b1e5-b99bdf7b38d6.description: The government of British India administers the Trucial Coast.

f65f9a3c-d213-52ee-84e0-9808bbb65b51.name: The National Bank of Egypt introduced notes
f65f9a3c-d213-52ee-84e0-9808bbb65b51.description: The National Bank of Egypt introduces notes in denominations of 50 piasters, and one, five, ten, 50 and 100 Egyptian pounds.

f67805d7-7484-52fe-bbb6-90a821ef664c.name: Inauguration of the Vatican Museums’ “Braccio Nuovo”
f67805d7-7484-52fe-bbb6-90a821ef664c.description: Inauguration of the Vatican Museums’ Braccio Nuovo (new wing), which completes the Chiaramonti Museum, whose construction had started in 1807, under the impulse of Pope Pius VII (Barnaba Chiaramonti). The Museum’s collection was set up by the sculptor Antonio Canova and included a large body of archaeological items.

f7641cd0-b685-5ff0-9b99-0b98db7893cd.name: Period of art Jugendstil
f7641cd0-b685-5ff0-9b99-0b98db7893cd.description: The paintings by Heinrich Vogeler, *Das Konzert (Sommerabend)* (1893), and Gustav Klimt, *Der Kuss* (1908), exemplify the period in art known as *Jugendstil* or Art Nouveau.

f7a361bb-feb0-547f-9701-6c1221e98c74.name: Foundation of the Stock Market
f7a361bb-feb0-547f-9701-6c1221e98c74.description: Foundation of the Greek Stock Market.

f7ad0a81-305e-5b10-b5f6-c75411717446.name: Railways in Italy on the eve of unification
f7ad0a81-305e-5b10-b5f6-c75411717446.description: On the eve of Italian national unification, Italy has only 1,758 km of railways (Piedmont 803 km, Lombardy and Veneto 500 km, Tuscany 256 km, Papal States 101 km, Kingdom of Two Sicilies 98 km). After unification in 1860, there is great development of railways, which by 1902 total 15,613 km.

f81f60e8-4b8c-5d37-af44-829a47dc02fb.name: First Republican Constitution enacted in April
f81f60e8-4b8c-5d37-af44-829a47dc02fb.description: April: First Republican Constitution enacted. Manuel de Arriaga is elected as the first President. It is believed that the Republic will address the economic crisis and promote progress. Though bringing together political forces, the regime is too vague to achieve the necessary economic and social reforms and soon ends up in political fragmentation and infighting.

f825be5e-2187-5142-a098-b4609fb91d10.name: Electoral reform
f825be5e-2187-5142-a098-b4609fb91d10.description: Electoral reform: the right to vote is extended to 7 per cent of the Italian population, by lowering the age limit (from 25 to 21) and the level of income required.

f855cdcb-be5a-54b3-b782-e0cb35a612f3.name: Period of art Biedermeier
f855cdcb-be5a-54b3-b782-e0cb35a612f3.description: The painting by Carl Spitzweg, *Der Sonntagsspaziergang* (The Sunday Walk, 1841), exemplifies the Biedermeier era (an expression of the popular present reality) in art at this time. Incidentally, Spitzweg’s painting *Der arme Poet* (The Poor Poet) was the most popular painting in Germany in the 19th century.

f8730320-0e3e-5937-b189-f09959de44be.name: Hariclea Darclée makes her debut at the Paris Opéra
f8730320-0e3e-5937-b189-f09959de44be.description: 8 May: The renowned Romanian soprano Hariclea Darclée makes her debut at the Paris Opéra, as Marguerite in Charles Gounod’s *Faust*.

f87da016-a804-5431-8c72-8d82de9fb5b0.name: Urban expansion after the unification of Italy
f87da016-a804-5431-8c72-8d82de9fb5b0.description: The unification of Italy leads to urban expansion outside the old city walls, which have lost their defensive value. Medieval urban buildings are often demolished in order to build monumental architecture.

f8996915-8dc8-59b7-9c61-2f9e5f25f5b6.name: Major Sidónio Pais takes power on 5 December and is elected President on 21 April 1918
f8996915-8dc8-59b7-9c61-2f9e5f25f5b6.description: Major Sidónio Pais takes power on 5 December and is elected President on 21 April 1918. Continuous unrest leads to a military coup by General Gomes da Costa in 1926 followed by a dictatorship. António de Oliveira Salazar become Finance Minister (1928–32) and then Prime Minister until 1968. The Estado Novo dictatorship lasted for 48 years.

f8ad3db8-26e2-51c9-9ca5-7c7536c1963b.name: Ayşe Sıdıka
f8ad3db8-26e2-51c9-9ca5-7c7536c1963b.description: Ayşe Sıdıka (d.1903), the first female Ottoman pedagogue, publishes *Usûl-i Talim ve Terbiye Dersleri* (Lectures on Methods of Teaching and Education). She was the instructor for courses in geography, ethics and handicrafts at the Female Teachers’ Seminary in İstanbul.

f8c7e5da-6d78-510f-8f1d-b4526794f8c1.name: Foundling wheels for babies left anonymously to be cared
f8c7e5da-6d78-510f-8f1d-b4526794f8c1.description: Foundling wheels for babies left anonymously to be cared for were used between the 15th and the 19th century. From 1867 they are gradually abolished and replaced by asylums for orphans, foundlings and abandoned older children. Organised childcare is promoted from 1870 through the foundation of childcare centres and public support for families.

f8ca83bf-b030-561d-af93-3d8341ae7145.name: Oskar Barnack invents compact camera
f8ca83bf-b030-561d-af93-3d8341ae7145.description: Oskar Barnack invents the compact camera.

f8d81374-5620-5e3d-bb9d-30e82b60b78c.name: State monopoly of life insurances
f8d81374-5620-5e3d-bb9d-30e82b60b78c.description: Law establishes state monopoly of life insurance and creates the Istituto nazionale delle assicurazioni (INA).

f910eef0-e547-5e8e-95a6-3094db5ccd38.name: Building of the Museum of Fine Arts in Vienna
f910eef0-e547-5e8e-95a6-3094db5ccd38.description: The Kunsthistorisches Museum (Museum of Fine Arts) in Vienna is built.

f917ddc8-de1d-51b2-9905-b4f08200b9a4.name: Planning project
f917ddc8-de1d-51b2-9905-b4f08200b9a4.description: Planning project for Galata and Karaköy in İstanbul. They are important centres for international trade.

f972ade6-cd1e-5d58-a347-9bd342cb7291.name: School of Account
f972ade6-cd1e-5d58-a347-9bd342cb7291.description: The year sees the founding of Egypt’s oldest commercial science study centre, when the School of Account is established during Muhammad ‘Ali’s Era.

f9a791eb-2667-5700-b132-34e2d2ed5b79.name: First art exhibition
f9a791eb-2667-5700-b132-34e2d2ed5b79.description: First art exhibition in İstanbul, organised by Şeker Ahmed Paşa.

f9d06f35-e6e9-591b-bfb0-b9bebea912d2.name: The Palestinian Mandate
f9d06f35-e6e9-591b-bfb0-b9bebea912d2.description: The letter from the British Foreign Secretary, Arthur Balfour, to Lord Rothschild in November 1917 offers British support to Zionist aspirations for Palestine to be a national home for Jews. This is internationally confirmed by the League of Nations handing over Palestine to Britain as a Mandate.

f9ebf377-c2aa-53e8-aa7c-bf5477f8eb26.name: The Great Exhibition of All Nations in London
f9ebf377-c2aa-53e8-aa7c-bf5477f8eb26.description: When the Great Exhibition of All Nations opens in London, as well as showcasing technological progress, it also exposes the public to Egyptian, Mesopotamian and other ancient cultures, thus fostering an appetite for museums.

fa119f31-9239-5d2e-a208-5ea8d5c0d653.name: Father Delattre and excavations
fa119f31-9239-5d2e-a208-5ea8d5c0d653.description: Abbot Bourgade and Father Delattre excavate the Punic and Roman ruins of Carthage and then set up the first archaeological collections of the Saint Louis Museum in Carthage and the Alaoui Museum in Bardo.

fa1fc484-23d4-57e8-9336-c23e958ab49e.name: Karl Krauss
fa1fc484-23d4-57e8-9336-c23e958ab49e.description: Karl Krauss (1874–1936) is born in Jičín in Bohemia; he emigrates from Bohemia to Vienna in 1877, where his famous journal *Die Fackel* (The Torch) is published in 1898.

fa4c55fc-4ec4-5bed-ad66-a7f450bc52d4.name: Inauguration of a new Bridge
fa4c55fc-4ec4-5bed-ad66-a7f450bc52d4.description: Bulaq Abu-l-‘Ala Bridge is inaugurated during the reign of Khedive ‘Abbas Hilmi II. It is seen as an architectural marvel that will link Cairo with Zamalek Island.

fa4d0398-1705-5236-aa78-74e51579bf1a.name: Stock Exchange
fa4d0398-1705-5236-aa78-74e51579bf1a.description: The rise of the Stock Exchange in Paris, the financial capital of Europe.

fa79aecd-b56d-5431-8a5a-44436fc2a3b0.name: Rosenstein
fa79aecd-b56d-5431-8a5a-44436fc2a3b0.description: Rosenstein Palace is built by Giovanni Salucci under Wilhelm I; it has been a public museum since 1954.

fa9ef10e-e8a7-5499-ae06-f444f5c5a2d9.name: The first comprehensive physics textbook
fa9ef10e-e8a7-5499-ae06-f444f5c5a2d9.description: The first comprehensive physics textbook in Turkish, Mehmed Emin Derviş Paşa’s (1817–79) *Usul-i Hikmet-i Tabiiyye* (Elements of physics) is published in Istanbul.

facd773d-80b9-5148-adec-97157a1feabe.name: Ottoman Academy of Sciences
facd773d-80b9-5148-adec-97157a1feabe.description: Ottoman Academy of Sciences (Encümen-i Danış) opens.

fadadc9b-3b97-54f7-94a0-a1547fd8001d.name: Ottoman General Exhibition
fadadc9b-3b97-54f7-94a0-a1547fd8001d.description: Sergi-i Umumi-I Osmani (Ottoman General Exhibition), its format borrowed from Western exhibitions, is opened in İstanbul.

fb4279cc-2a2e-5097-8bb9-f0b9e415b75a.name: The right to vote is reserved to a small elite of men
fb4279cc-2a2e-5097-8bb9-f0b9e415b75a.description: The right to vote is reserved for a small elite of men who have certain levels of income and education: only 2.2% of the Italians can vote.

fb5a0884-b054-5f4a-a14f-3d4e7b987d06.name: Ottoman investment in infrastructure
fb5a0884-b054-5f4a-a14f-3d4e7b987d06.description: After centuries of neglect the creation of new administrative units late in the 19th century strengthens the Ottoman presence in Transjordan. This trend materialises in the construction of administrative buildings in newly established or re-established towns and investment in infrastructure. New towns mean new roads: Amman, Jerash and Madaba are linked by paved roads and in 1906 Madaba is linked with Karak. Construction of the Hijaz Railway and lines of communication results in extensive urban development along the railway. However, it also creates social disparities and tensions.

fb6a6feb-4b81-54fa-a622-5bf064b584eb.name: Gjorgji Zografski
fb6a6feb-4b81-54fa-a622-5bf064b584eb.description: Gjorgji Zografski paints what is considered to be the earliest depiction of an actual historic event. It shows the plundering raid on the village of Papradishte near Veles that occurred in 1884.

fbcc3ee8-e97b-5528-a939-e175a1a0e43c.name: Migration and the new Kingdom of Greece
fbcc3ee8-e97b-5528-a939-e175a1a0e43c.description:
With the new Kingdom of Greece, guaranteed by Britain, some Greeks migrate to Athens and the new state, while others migrate from Greece to Constantinople, which has a huge Greek community. Relations between Turks and Greeks suffer during the 19th century, leading to a slow cantonisation of the region, culminating with the exchange of populations (Greeks from Turkey to Greece and Turks from Greece to Turkey) after World War I.  
From the same period, expansion of the old Hellenic port of Alexandria witnesses a mass migration of Greeks, mostly from the Aegean islands to the city, making them, by the end of the century, the wealthiest and most influential community in Alexandria.

fbe0a31d-bc06-5d89-b4f0-90a03bed5fba.name: Introduction of the Legitimationszwang
fbe0a31d-bc06-5d89-b4f0-90a03bed5fba.description: Introduction of the *Legitimationszwang* in Prussia allows police to tag foreign workers and their German employers.

fc02aa53-3bce-5481-9e33-e59f86b70d0e.name: The National Theater (Burgtheater) moved from its former place
fc02aa53-3bce-5481-9e33-e59f86b70d0e.description: The Burgtheater (National Theatre) moves from its former residence at the Hofburg (Imperial Castle) to purpose-built premises at the Ringstrasse.

fc44168d-c62c-5e83-8680-6a122d61c014.name: Italian migration reaches its peak
fc44168d-c62c-5e83-8680-6a122d61c014.description: Italian migration reaches its peak: 870,000 Italians migrate abroad.

fc496410-2e8b-51f5-9388-1129f3ed1a9d.name: The *Cavalleria rusticana* by Pietro Mascagni
fc496410-2e8b-51f5-9388-1129f3ed1a9d.description: The *Cavalleria rusticana* by Pietro Mascagni (1863–1945) has a great success, marking the beginning of *verismo* (Italian realism) in music, which intends to portray the world of peasants and the poor through strong and passionate drama. The singing style changes radically, leaving behind the aesthetics of bel canto and turning to reciting, even shouting, and spoken parts in the most exciting dramatic moments.

fc55a7ea-0951-5473-9917-61e4a389d10c.name: Abdallah Salah al-Mutawa
fc55a7ea-0951-5473-9917-61e4a389d10c.description: The first Emirati historian Abdullah Saleh al-Mutawa’ is born in Sharjah.

fc7c4891-6269-51f5-8856-b5a25af7f494.name: Gottlieb Daimler develops petrol engine and Rudolf Diesel invents diesel engine
fc7c4891-6269-51f5-8856-b5a25af7f494.description: Gottlieb Daimler develops the petrol engine and Rudolf Diesel invents the diesel engine.

fcb94a02-8f53-5b37-b82a-5f6c9c869311.name: The ban on emigration to America is lifted
fcb94a02-8f53-5b37-b82a-5f6c9c869311.description: The ban on emigration to America is lifted. Under the Constitution of 1869 free emigration for all the inhabitants is recognised on payment of a fee, which remains until 1873.

fcf9f34c-4efd-58ab-bc9e-2dbc223c1ccc.name: Second half of the 19th century
fcf9f34c-4efd-58ab-bc9e-2dbc223c1ccc.description: The majority of fezzes worn as modern headgear in the Ottoman Empire during the second half of the 19th century are produced in the Austrian Empire.

fd06f4ad-3881-56f7-8aad-965c006e1f48.name: Monetary reform
fd06f4ad-3881-56f7-8aad-965c006e1f48.description: Monetary reform: the administration of the protectorate decides to replace the Tunisian monetary unit the “piastre” with the French Franc.

fd8ff9f3-3eb3-5b23-a152-983d1d2dc1d4.name: Madrid extensions
fd8ff9f3-3eb3-5b23-a152-983d1d2dc1d4.description: Madrid has two "extensions": the first had been designed by the Marquis of Salamanca in 1860; the second, in 1882, is a modern design by Arturo Soria known as “Ciudad Lineal” (linear city), a plan for an elongated urban formation. The city will consist of a series of functionally specialised parallel sectors.

fdd6043f-9476-59fe-8544-285619bce23f.name: Imperial Chancellor Otto von Bismarck initiates German social laws
fdd6043f-9476-59fe-8544-285619bce23f.description: Imperial Chancellor Otto von Bismarck initiates German social laws and the basic system for a modern social state.

fdfc7f4c-1c72-5224-96a7-78eb9ba3e0d3.name: In Naples, inauguration of the Royal Bourbon Museum
fdfc7f4c-1c72-5224-96a7-78eb9ba3e0d3.description: In Naples, inauguration of the Royal Bourbon Museum, whose holdings include the rich collection of archaeological items belonged to Elisabetta Farnese and the pieces excavated in Pompei during the 18th century. All such holdings are personal properties of the king.

fe06110c-3724-5f7f-81f6-122b5c83203f.name: At the National Theatre of Bucharest the comedy *A stormy night*
fe06110c-3724-5f7f-81f6-122b5c83203f.description: 18–20 January: the National Theatre of Bucharest premieres the comedy *A Stormy Night* by Ion Luca Caragiale, the greatest Romanian playwright. It is Caragiale’s first staged play and is a great public success.

fe1a928b-600b-5496-ade5-cdef3be9c8cc.name: Mechanisation of the textile industry
fe1a928b-600b-5496-ade5-cdef3be9c8cc.description: Mechanisation of the textile industry in Catalonia with the introduction of steam-powered machines. Progress in the textile industry continues in Catalonia until the 1920 crisis.

fe23bf96-3929-5f22-88f9-80c3800efe11.name: The German Empire
fe23bf96-3929-5f22-88f9-80c3800efe11.description: The German Empire, a union of sovereign states and free cities, is established under Prussian leadership.

fe708ba3-6893-570b-984e-86d1f7ebca0d.name: School of Irrigation and Architecture
fe708ba3-6893-570b-984e-86d1f7ebca0d.description: In 1866 the School of Irrigation and Architecture is inaugurated at al-Za‘faran Saray in ‘Abbasiyya in Cairo; it then transfers to Mustafa Fadil Saray at Darb al-Jama‘iz in 1867. The School provides a study programme of five years: a preparatory year followed by a further four years; two years respectively specialising in irrigation and architecture.

fe927624-eeb2-5119-bf29-e127a692b83c.name: The Touring Club d’Italia is founded
fe927624-eeb2-5119-bf29-e127a692b83c.description: The Touring Club d’Italia is founded. Its main goal is “to make Italians know Italy”. It conceives of tourism as a tool for the cultural growth and modernisation of the country.

fec50ca8-f190-5a0f-a1bd-5c02ba7bfeb6.name: John Lewis Burckhardt  from Swizerland was doing journeys to the Orient
fec50ca8-f190-5a0f-a1bd-5c02ba7bfeb6.description: John Lewis Burckhardt from Switzerland journeyed to the “Orient”, especially to Aleppo in Syria, to study the Near East and Islam. While there, under the pseudonym Sheikh Ibrahim ibn ‘Abd-Allah and living as a Muslim businessman, he not only translated from English to Arabic Daniel Defoe’s *Robinson Crusoe*, but also rediscovered the city of Petra (Jordan) in 1812.

fef1795a-eb7a-50b5-a91f-aee18a80087d.name: Description de Egypte
fef1795a-eb7a-50b5-a91f-aee18a80087d.description: *Description de l'Egypte* first appears in 1809 and continues to be published as a series until the final volume appears in 1829. It offers a comprehensive scientific description of ancient and modern Egypt as well as its natural history.

fefc1366-5626-53be-b0c0-3772ea387ee4.name: Development of seaside resorts
fefc1366-5626-53be-b0c0-3772ea387ee4.description: Development of resorts and the creation of the seaside resort of Arcachon on the Atlantic in south-west France, which is inaugurated by Emperor Napoleon III and Empress Eugénie.

feff9707-bc08-5a5c-9a28-b8b8d72a641a.name: In Rome, Luigi Pigorini founds the National Prehistoric Ethnographic Museum
feff9707-bc08-5a5c-9a28-b8b8d72a641a.description: In Rome, Luigi Pigorini founds the National Prehistoric Ethnographic Museum, enriching with new acquisitions the ethnographic and prehistoric collection previously belonging to the Kircher Museum, founded in the 17th century.

ff513241-e32b-5b81-a894-322b95dc3362.name: Cuza is forced to abdicate
ff513241-e32b-5b81-a894-322b95dc3362.description: February: because of his authoritative regime, Cuza is forced to abdicate by a coalition of conservative and liberal-radical politicians.

ff5227d8-b063-54b1-9bac-ab22b34ecd46.name: Foundation of the National Confederation of Workers
ff5227d8-b063-54b1-9bac-ab22b34ecd46.description: The General Confederation of Greek Workers (GSEE) is founded.

ff79c393-ce02-5149-ae84-39f665dd178b.name: Grazia Deledda publishes the novel *Canne al vento*
ff79c393-ce02-5149-ae84-39f665dd178b.description: Grazia Deledda (1871–1936) publishes the novel *Canne al vento*. Thirteen years later, she will be awarded the Nobel Prize (the second woman to be Nobel laureate in literature).

ff7f51e0-58bb-5194-a656-67846e502b66.name: The opening of the Suez canal
ff7f51e0-58bb-5194-a656-67846e502b66.description: The opening of the Suez Canal sparks a second burst of British popular interest in ancient Egypt.

ff998929-e3b9-506e-8d46-da147a9b3fdb.name: Improved public health services and living conditions
ff998929-e3b9-506e-8d46-da147a9b3fdb.description: Thanks to improved public health services and living conditions there has been a strong decrease in the annual number of deaths by disease since 1887 (e.g. deaths from measles have decreased by 73 percent; from diptheria by 86 per cent; from smallpox by 99 per cent).

ffa6f2e4-356c-5bf6-bdf8-3ea92106a64f.name: Completion of Port of La Goulette
ffa6f2e4-356c-5bf6-bdf8-3ea92106a64f.description: Completion of the Port of La Goulette. After five years in construction, the port complex opens to trade on 28 May 1893.
